      <title>DataVisor: Senior Account Executive - Payment</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>Strategic Thinking, Salesforce, and Contract Negotiation</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> California City, California, United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://jobs.workable.com/company/tF9SQQtDXuW4nppTkpUXKP/jobs-at-datavisor">https://jobs.workable.com/company/tF9SQQtDXuW4nppTkpUXKP/jobs-at-datavisor</a>
</p>

<p>About DataVisor:</p><p>DataVisor is the world’s leading AI-powered Fraud and Risk Platform that delivers the best overall detection coverage in the industry. With an open SaaS platform that supports easy consolidation and enrichment of any data, DataVisor's solution scales infinitely and enables organizations to act on fast-evolving fraud and money laundering activities in real time. Its patented unsupervised machine learning technology, advanced device intelligence, powerful decision engine, and investigation tools work together to provide guaranteed performance lift from day one. DataVisor's platform is architected to support multiple use cases multiple financial services use cases with flexibly, dramatically lowering total cost of ownership compared to legacy point solutions. DataVisor is recognized as an industry leader and has been adopted by many scalable financial service companies across the globe.</p><p>Our award-winning software platform is powered by a team of world-class experts in AI, machine learning, security, big data, and scalable infrastructure. Our culture is open, positive, collaborative, and results-driven. Come join us!</p><p>Summary:</p><p>As a Senior Account Executive – Payments, you will be responsible for hunting and securing new accounts within a defined Payments sector target list. This is a visible quota-based position and is critical role aligning to the forecasted growth of the company. This candidate will drive the sales cycle from end-to-end as the “quarterback” of the deal, driving the supporting sales engineers, data scientists, delivery etc. &nbsp; The candidate will need to partner with marketing, represent the organization at conferences, and take all measures to build a healthy new opportunity pipeline, and drive opportunities to closure.&nbsp; The ideal candidate will have experience succeeding in a line positions within the payment industry, have exposure to SaaS solutions, fraud, and success leading enterprise sales.&nbsp; They will have good technical knowledge of the payment transaction eco-system and be able to interact and influence the c-suite, product leaders, risk leaders and technology leaders.&nbsp;<br></p><p>Responsibilities:</p><ul><li>Identify and drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline within the payments segment.</li><li>Understand the payments ecosystem, including a strong technical acumen of the segment.</li><li>Be able to communicate the challenges facing providers in the payment segment.&nbsp;</li><li>Have a working knowledge of fraud risk.</li><li>Understand SaaS solutions.</li><li>Be a thought leader and build relationships at all levels within product, technology, and risk organizations.</li><li>Understand and be able to communicate the company value story, and the ROI story aligning to the dynamics in the payment segment in parallel to influencing technical feasibility.&nbsp;</li><li>Drive the sales cycle from end-to-end.&nbsp;</li><li>Collaborate with internal teams including marketing, sales engineering, system architects, delivery, finance, and legal.</li><li>Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Salesforce.com.</li><li>Lead contract negotiations to closure with time-sensitive urgency.</li></ul>
<ul><li>15+ years total experience across a combination of payments, fraud, SaaS, and Sales.</li><li>History excelling in a quota driven environment.</li><li>Strong executive presence, and the ability to engage with C-level and VP-level executives.</li><li>Demonstrated ability to drive the sales process from end-to-end. Formal methodology training is a plus.</li><li>Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.</li><li>Strategic thinker with the ability to develop and execute territory and close plans.</li><li>Experience with contract negotiations.</li><li>Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams both internally and within our client’s organizations.</li><li>Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.</li><li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.</li></ul>
<p>Compensation range:  $160K-$175K base salary per year, OTE $320 -$350K, uncapped and negotiable</p><p>Health Insurance, Stock options, 401k, PTO</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/datavisor-senior-account-executive-payment">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/datavisor-senior-account-executive-payment</a></p>
</description>

      <title>WiseTech Global: E2open - US Area Sales Director (CPG) - Texas</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>Salesforce, Cross-Selling, and Upselling</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://wisetechglobal.com">https://wisetechglobal.com</a>
</p>

<div><p></p><h2>Company Description</h2></div><div><p>WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000&nbsp;logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders&nbsp;worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers.</p></div><div><p></p><h2>Job Description</h2></div><div><p><strong>A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now</strong></p><p>In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business.</p><p>WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place.</p><p>Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale.</p><p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p><p>We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit.</p><p>This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.</p><p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p><ul><li>Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.</li><li>Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.</li><li>Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high.</li><li>Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level.</li><li>Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals.</li><li>Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics.</li><li>Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.</li></ul><p><strong>Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission</strong></p></div><div><p></p><h2>Qualifications</h2></div><div><p><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></p><ul><li>8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&amp;OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).</li><li>Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.</li><li>Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.</li><li>Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.</li><li>Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges.</li><li>Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.</li><li>Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently.</li><li>Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.</li></ul></div><div><p></p><h2>Additional Information</h2></div><div><p>When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture.</p><p>Creativity is in our DNA. We favor principles over policy, encourage open communication, and prioritize results over busywork. Our global team&nbsp;is united by our mission: to change the world by creating breakthrough products that enable and empower those that own and operate the supply chains of the world. Join us in shaping the future of logistics.</p><div></div><p><strong>Before You Apply&nbsp;</strong></p><p><em>From time to time, WiseTech Global may use external service providers to assist us with assessing applications, including testing and background checks, on our behalf. Accordingly, by applying for this role and providing your personal information to WiseTech Global, you consent to WiseTech Global providing this information to our external service providers who are required to treat such information with strict confidentiality in line with privacy and data protection laws and regulations.</em></p></div><li> Compensation: USD <span>100000</span> - USD <span>150000</span> - yearly</li>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wisetech-global-e2open-us-area-sales-director-cpg-texas">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wisetech-global-e2open-us-area-sales-director-cpg-texas</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Anchour: Marketing Designer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Alabama</state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6726/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 199 Lisbon St Lewiston,ME 04240
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://anchour.com">http://anchour.com</a>
</p>

<h2><strong>Overview</strong></h2>
<p>We are looking for a driven and passionate Marketing Designer to join our creative team at our agency. In this role, you will be responsible for designing high-quality, visually appealing digital assets and campaigns for a variety of clients. Your designs will be used across a range of platforms, including compelling static and animated social ads, marketing emails, and landing pages for a variety of exciting brands.</p>
<p>You are a creative powerhouse with a deep understanding of digital platforms, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to push boundaries while meeting client objectives. As a Marketing Designer, you will take ownership of your work—from concept to execution—and collaborate closely with strategy, content, and digital teams to bring bold, effective ideas to life.</p>
<h2><strong>About Anchour</strong></h2>
<p>Anchour is a creative agency of 38 and growing, focused on building unforgettable brands and digital experiences that help businesses punch above their weight. Headquartered in Maine, we specialize in serving SMBs and startups across industries like consumer goods, home services, financial services, retail, and professional services.</p>
<p>As a full-service agency, we offer strategy, branding, website design, development, copywriting, and performance marketing solutions. At Anchour, we believe in cultivating an inclusive environment where creativity, curiosity, and collaboration thrive.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2>
<p><strong>Create Scroll-Stopping Ads</strong>: Develop innovative and high-performing static and animated Meta ads that captivate audiences and drive conversions, using tools like Figma, CapCut, Canva, and After Effects.</p>
<p><strong>Ideate &amp; Conceptualize</strong>: Collaborate with strategists and marketers to brainstorm and execute fresh, bold creative ideas for ads and campaigns that stand out in crowded digital spaces.</p>
<p><strong>Craft Engaging Emails</strong>: Design visually compelling email templates and campaigns, ensuring they align with best practices for performance and user engagement.</p>
<p><strong>Support Multi-Channel Campaigns: </strong>Design assets for additional platforms like Google Display and landing pages, ensuring consistency and alignment with brand guidelines.</p>
<p><strong>Keep Creative Fresh: </strong>Regularly refresh and optimize high-performing creative based on campaign performance data, ensuring ads and emails remain relevant and effective.</p>
<p><strong>Collaborate Across Teams</strong>: Work closely with strategists, copywriters, and marketers to align creative direction with campaign goals and audience needs.</p>
<p><strong>Bring Motion to Life</strong>: Add animation and motion to ads and creative assets, leveraging tools like CapCut, Figma, Canva, and After Effects to bring dynamic ideas to life.</p>
<p><strong>Experiment &amp; Innovate</strong>: Test new concepts, visual styles, and creative approaches to discover what resonates with audiences and drives results.</p>
<p><strong>Present &amp; Refine Designs</strong>: Confidently share your creative work with clients, articulate your thinking, and incorporate feedback to deliver polished final assets.</p>
<p><strong>Manage Your Workflow: </strong>Stay organized and manage your time effectively to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.</p>
<p><strong>Stay Ahead of Trends: </strong>Keep up with design and platform trends, exploring new creative ideas that elevate our work and push boundaries.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>What We’d Like To See</strong></h2>
<ul class="editor-list-ul">
<li class="editor-listitem"><strong>Proven Expertise: </strong>3+ years of experience in a design role focused on Meta ads, email marketing, or performance-driven campaigns, preferably in an agency or for high-performing brands.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem"><strong>Figma Mastery:</strong> Extensive experience designing in Figma, including creating templates, prototypes, and layouts for both ads and emails.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem"><strong>CapCut Proficiency: </strong>Familiarity with CapCut to create and refine light animations for Meta ads and short-form digital content.</li>

      <title>Mitratech: Associate Product Marketing Manager – GRC</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>Compliance, Data Analysis, Market Research, Product Marketing, Project Management, SaaS, Go-to-Market Strategy, and Sales Enablement</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Franklin Parish, Louisiana, United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://www.mitratech.com">http://www.mitratech.com</a>
</p>

<p>At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in a diverse, inclusive culture centered on great people practices, learning opportunities, and fun! Our culture blends entrepreneurial spirit with enterprise investment, giving you the chance to move quickly with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.</p>
<p>For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.</p>
<p>As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!</p>
<h4>This role is based in the US and operates as a key member of a globally distributed marketing team, collaborating closely with colleagues across the US, CAD, UK, and EMEA to deliver consistent, high-performing digital programs at scale.</h4>
<h2>Job Overview</h2>
<p>The Associate Product Marketing Manager, GRC will support the go-to-market strategy and execution for select products in Mitratech's GRC portfolio. This role will focus on positioning and messaging, competitive intelligence, product launches, and sales enablement, working closely with Product Marketing, Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, and Customer Marketing. We're looking for a hands-on marketer who can own defined projects, turn complex product and market information into clear, customer-facing messaging, and collaborate effectively across teams. The ideal candidate is curious, proactive, organized, and comfortable using data and AI tools to make marketing work more efficient.</p>
<h3>Essential Duties &amp; Responsibilities</h3>
<h4>Launch &amp; GTM Execution</h4>
<ul>
<li>Support go-to-market activities for new products, capabilities, and feature releases.</li>
<li>Translate product updates into launch messaging, sales materials, presentations, and other customer-facing assets.</li>
<li>Coordinate with Product Management, Demand Generation, Customer Marketing, and Sales to support launch execution.</li>
<li>Support cross-sell and upsell initiatives by developing messaging and materials that help customers understand the value of additional products and capabilities.</li>
<li>Help ensure product positioning is consistently represented across relevant marketing and sales channels.</li>
</ul>
<h4>Sales Enablement</h4>
<ul>
<li>Develop and maintain sales enablement materials including buyer's guides, competitive guides, presentations, FAQs, objection-handling resources, and product messaging.</li>
<li>Manage the internal sales enablement tool and sales asset repository and act as primary administrator&nbsp;</li>
<li>Support sales training and internal communications around new products, releases, positioning, and competitive insights.</li>
<li>Provide timely support for sales requests related to product messaging, competitive information, and deal-specific needs.</li>
</ul>
<h4>AI-Enabled Workflows</h4>
<ul>
<li>Use AI tools to streamline research, competitive monitoring, content development, and other repetitive marketing workflows.</li>
<li>Help test, improve, and maintain AI-assisted workflows while ensuring outputs remain accurate and aligned with business needs.</li>
<li>Come up with new ways to use AI in the PMM lifecycle and build skills and agents to assist</li>
</ul>
<h4>Competitive Intelligence &amp; Win/Loss</h4>
<ul>
<li>Monitor competitors, market trends, customer needs, and developments across the GRC landscape.</li>
<li>Support the development and ongoing maintenance of competitive battlecards and sales resources for assigned products.</li>
<li>Support win/loss analysis by organizing feedback and identifying trends.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Requirements &amp; Skills:&nbsp;</h3>
<ul>
<li>2-3 years of relevant experience in product marketing, B2B technology, SaaS, risk, compliance, or a related field.</li>
<li>Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing, or Customer teams.</li>
<li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex products and concepts for different audiences.</li>
<li>Experience creating marketing and sales enablement materials for B2B audiences.</li>
<li>Comfortable conducting market and competitive research and turning findings into practical insights and assets.</li>
<li>Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.</li>
<li>Comfortable working with marketing or business metrics and using data to inform decisions.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve research, content creation, analysis, or marketing workflows.</li>
<li>Experience in GRC, risk, compliance, cybersecurity, legal technology, or enterprise SaaS is an asset.</li>
<li>Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is an asset.</li>
</ul>
<p>What Success Looks Like Within the first 6–12 months, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Develop a strong understanding of Mitratech's GRC portfolio, customers, personas, and competitive landscape.</li>
<li>Become a reliable partner to Product Management and Sales on product messaging and go-to-market execution for assigned products.</li>
<li>Deliver high-quality positioning, launch, competitive, and sales enablement materials with increasing independence.</li>
<li>Contribute meaningful competitive and win/loss insights that improve messaging and sales effectiveness.</li>
<li>Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to make Product Marketing workflows more efficient.</li>
<li>Build strong relationships across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer teams.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><span>This role can be performed 100% remote anywhere in the US. Given the need for team collaboration and meeting overlap, candidates who can align with <strong>Eastern Time Zone business hours are strongly preferred</strong>. Anticipated <strong>Pay Range: 70,000-80,000 USD Annually.&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<p><em><strong> <strong><em>Mitratech is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, national or ethnic origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, family status, disability, or veteran status. Mitratech will work with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process. Please email <a href="mailto:Recruiting@mitratech.com">Recruiting@mitratech.com</a> to request an accommodation.</em></strong></strong></em></p>

      <title>Elavate: UGC Coordinator</title>
      <region>Latin America Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>Data Analysis, Project Management, Storyboarding, and Negotiation</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://elavate.teamtailor.com">https://elavate.teamtailor.com</a>
</p>

<h2>About Elavate</h2><p>Elavate is a multi-collagen supplement brand for women 40+, built around the changes that come with perimenopause and menopause. Our founder, Alex Philip, started it after getting fed up buying overpriced, low-quality, bad-tasting collagen for his mum.</p><p>Since launching in 2024 we've become one of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the UK, with over 35,000 five-star reviews. We launched in the US in 2026, and it's now our biggest focus for growth.</p><p>Our growth runs on video ads: UGC, influencer and celebrity talent content, made with an in-house team of creative strategists and video editors. The better the creators and the content, the faster we grow. That's where you come in.<br></p><h2>The role<br></h2><p>Our creative strategists write the scripts and our editors turn footage into ads. You're the person in the middle who makes the content happen: finding the right creators, briefing and storyboarding every script, running influencer and high-production shoots with our agency partners, and making sure every video that comes back is right.</p><p>You'll handle two kinds of content:</p><ul><li><p><strong>UGC:</strong> creators film themselves at home from our briefs, so the brief has to do all the directing</p></li><li><p><strong>Influencer and high-production shoots:</strong> the two go hand in hand. We film well-known influencers and TV personalities with a professional crew, at a location picked for the look, with lighting, a teleprompter and make-up. These shoots make our long-form direct response ads, plus the hooks, product shots and B-roll that go with them</p></li></ul><p>You'll work across both markets, the UK and the US, alongside our founder and creative team.</p><p>This is a communications, creators and systems role. You want to be in it every day: talking to creators, getting content made and getting deals done. Strategy experience is a plus, not a requirement.<br></p><h2>What you'll own<br></h2><p><strong>Find and sign the best creators in the UK and US</strong></p><ul><li><p>Source new UGC creators every week, mostly women 40+ who come across as natural, expressive and believable on camera</p></li><li><p>Vet properly before anyone gets a brief: watch their content, judge their delivery, setting and camera skills, and only put forward people you'd bet on</p></li><li><p>Get in touch fast and keep every conversation moving. The best creators get booked up quickly, so speed wins the deal</p></li><li><p>Negotiate good deals: strong rates, the right usage and whitelisting terms, and every deliverable written in (videos, hooks, raw files, B-roll)</p></li><li><p>Keep the pipeline full so our strategists never wait on talent</p></li></ul><p><strong>Build and run our creator database</strong></p><ul><li><p>Build a database of the best UGC creators in the UK and US, and keep it up to date every week</p></li><li><p>Log every creator after every job: contact details, rates, niche, past jobs, how their content performed, delivery quality and whether we'd rebook them</p></li><li><p>Keep a bench of proven creators we can rebook at short notice</p></li><li><p>Keep an eye on creative performance in Motion, so you know which creators and videos are winning and can find, rebook and brief more like them</p></li><li><p>Run product sendouts: get product out as soon as a deal is signed and confirm it's arrived</p></li></ul><p><strong>Brief and storyboard every script</strong></p><ul><li><p>Turn finished scripts from our strategists into briefs a creator can film without guessing: a scene-by-scene storyboard, B-roll, visual direction, setting, outfits and props</p></li><li><p>Lock every brief before it goes out: one final version, a clear deadline, a reference video and links you've tested</p></li><li><p>Run a quick test clip before each full batch, so problems get caught before they cost us a refilm</p></li></ul><p><strong>Coordinate our influencer and high-production shoots</strong></p><ul><li><p>Work hand in hand with our content agency and shoot production agency: they run the day-to-day logistics on our crewed shoots, you make sure nothing gets missed</p></li><li><p>Run the threads with agents and talent managers on scheduling, call times and riders</p></li><li><p>Own the details: locations, props, product on set and a checklist to the crew before every shoot</p></li></ul><p><strong>Check content and get it live</strong></p><ul><li><p>Check every delivery against the script within 24 hours of filming: every hook, every section, resolution, lighting, framing and product shots</p></li><li><p>Post a written verdict for the team on what's good and exactly what's wrong (a thumbs-up isn't a check), so refilm calls get made fast</p></li><li><p>Once content is approved, get sign-off from the talent side, secure whitelisting access and hand clean files to our editors<br></p></li></ul><h2>How we work (read this part properly)<br></h2><p>This is what makes or breaks the role, so we're being specific.</p><ul><li><p><strong>You're very responsive and active on Slack.</strong> This is one of the most important parts of the role. When you're online, messages get a reply in minutes, not hours, even if it's just "on it, back to you by 4pm". Slow replies are how things slip and shoots go wrong.</p></li><li><p><strong>You own it end to end.</strong> Some of our shoots cost thousands, so you treat every one like it's your own money. Nobody checks behind you: if something's about to fall through the cracks, you catch it first.</p></li><li><p><strong>You confirm, you don't assume.</strong> A CC isn't a confirmation. When a time, location or script changes, you confirm it directly with every person involved.</p></li><li><p><strong>You take in the full context.</strong> You listen to the whole voice note, watch the whole Loom and read the whole thread before you act. Then you ask the questions that matter.</p></li><li><p><strong>You close loops.</strong> Sign-offs, follow-ups and tracker updates don't sit with you. If something's blocked, you flag it before anyone has to chase you.</p></li><li><p><strong>You turn up.</strong> Every call, on time and prepared.</p></li><li><p><strong>You ship, then improve.</strong> A solid brief out today beats a beautiful one next week.</p></li><li><p><strong>You build systems.</strong> If you're doing the same manual task twice, you build a workflow for it (Notion, templates, AI) so the third time is faster.</p></li><li><p><strong>You're there when it's live.</strong> On shoot days and urgent threads, you jump online outside your normal hours if something needs doing.</p></li><li><p><strong>You take feedback well.</strong> Direct feedback, no ego, acted on the same day.<br></p></li></ul><h2>Who you are<br></h2><p><strong>Must-haves</strong></p><ul><li><p>2+ years in UGC, creator or influencer coordination, at a DTC brand, a UGC or performance creative agency, or an influencer or talent agency</p></li><li><p>Fluent written and spoken English: you'll talk to UK and US creators, agents and talent managers all day, so your messages are quick, clear and polite</p></li><li><p>You can read a video script and storyboard it scene by scene, with B-roll and visual direction (we'll ask you to show us)</p></li><li><p>An eye for talent: you can tell from a creator's content whether they'll work in a direct response ad</p></li><li><p>A strong negotiator who enjoys the people side: you get good rates and the right terms, and creators still want to work with you again</p></li><li><p>You know performance marketing metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS), can read an ad account audit, and have used Motion or a similar tool to review creative performance</p></li><li><p>Confident in Frame.io and Notion</p></li><li><p>Seriously organised: calendars, trackers and checklists are your thing, and nothing gets lost with you</p></li><li><p>AI-first: you use tools like Claude and ChatGPT every day to work faster, and you know how to build simple workflows that save the team time</p></li><li><p>Sharp and quick: you pick things up first time and don't need to be shown twice</p></li></ul><p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p><ul><li><p>Creative strategy or direct response experience: writing scripts and hooks, or turning ad data into new concepts</p></li><li><p>Experience with health, wellness, beauty or supplement brands</p></li><li><p>You've coordinated crewed shoots or worked with talent agents and managers</p></li><li><p>You've built something of your own: a side business, a creator account or an agency<br></p></li></ul><h2>Pay, hours and perks<br></h2><ul><li><p><strong>$30,000 USD a year</strong> (about $2,500 a month), full-time, as an independent contractor</p></li><li><p><strong>3-month review</strong> against clear goals, with a pay step-up when you hit them, plus clear pay tiers so you always know what the next level takes</p></li><li><p><strong>Remote from Latin America</strong>, with core hours agreed before you start that overlap the UK afternoon and the US working day</p></li><li><p><strong>28 days paid time off</strong> a year</p></li><li><p><strong>Work directly with our founder</strong> and senior creative team, on content with well-known UK and US talent</p></li><li><p><strong>A path into creative strategy</strong> if that's where you want to grow<br></p></li></ul><h2>How to apply<br></h2><p>Apply with your CV. In a short note or cover letter, tell us about the best creator you've ever found and why they worked. Start it with the word "storyboard" so we know you've read this far.</p><p>Our process:</p><ol><li><p>Screening call</p></li><li><p>Interview</p></li><li><p>Paid test task, based on the real job</p></li><li><p>Final interview</p></li></ol><p>We move fast. If this sounds like you, apply today.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/elavate-ugc-coordinator">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/elavate-ugc-coordinator</a></p>
</description>

<div><p></p><h2>Company Description</h2></div><div><p>This is a REMOTE role available in LATAM. You must have a strong C1 English level. If this isn’t you, please DO NOT apply.</p><p>ARE YOU READY TO BUILD THE MARKETING ENGINE OF AN AI-POWERED LEARNING COMPANY FROM THE GROUND UP?</p><p>THIS IS A HANDS-ON, HIGH-OWNERSHIP OPPORTUNITY FOR A CREATIVE, COMMERCIALLY MINDED BUILDER WHO TURNS IDEAS INTO MEASURABLE RESULTS.</p><p>Our client is an early-stage, AI-powered learning company focused on making learning more personal, engaging, accessible, and meaningful. Their flagship offering lets users create short, narrated, visually engaging learning videos in minutes, and their broader platform supports personalized learning experiences across multiple formats.</p><p>They are building a company around a larger belief: learning should help people develop the skills, knowledge, and understanding to become who they want to be. They are now entering their commercial growth stage, with creative agencies as the first priority market, followed by independent trainers, learning consultants, and other organizations.</p><p><strong>Company Culture</strong></p><p>Our client is looking for someone who can think strategically and execute independently in an early-stage startup environment. If you are resourceful, take ownership, and enjoy working closely with founders and a collaborative team, this is the right place for you. Benefits of working with our client include:</p><ul><li>Founding-level marketing ownership with direct collaboration with the founder and business development lead</li><li>Purpose-driven, multicultural team in a fast-scaling EdTech environment</li></ul><p><strong>Benefits</strong></p><ul><li>Remote work</li><li>PTO</li><li>Weekends off</li><li>USD monthly payment</li><li>Growth opportunities</li></ul></div><div><p></p><h2>Job Description</h2></div><div><p>Our client is hiring a Marketing Lead to build and execute their marketing strategy, establish market awareness, generate qualified leads, and support revenue growth. This is a hands-on role, not a purely strategic one. You will work closely with the founder, the business development lead, and existing marketing contributors, and you will be expected to move from strategy to execution independently.</p><p>The ideal candidate is a creative, commercially minded, resourceful builder who understands both brand storytelling and customer acquisition. You will be especially valuable if you understand how creative agencies operate, what drives their purchasing decisions, and how the platform can help them expand their capabilities and create new value for their clients.</p><p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li>Develop and execute the B2B marketing and go-to-market strategy, beginning with creative agencies</li><li>Build demand-generation campaigns that produce qualified leads and sales opportunities</li><li>Develop compelling brand positioning, messaging, and content that differentiates the company in the market</li><li>Showcase the flagship product through campaigns, demonstrations, and real-world use cases</li><li>Collaborate closely with business development on targeting, campaigns, sales materials, and pipeline growth</li><li>Manage marketing channels, including LinkedIn, email, website, and other relevant digital platforms</li><li>Establish marketing priorities, performance metrics, and processes that support sustainable growth</li></ul></div><div><p></p><h2>Qualifications</h2></div><div><ul><li>3+ years of experience as a Marketing Lead. EdTech background&nbsp;strongly preferred.</li><li>Strong understanding of the creative agency market, ideally from working within agencies or marketing products and services to them</li><li>Proven B2B marketing experience, particularly in demand generation, positioning, and go-to-market execution</li><li>Demonstrated ability to connect marketing efforts to qualified leads and revenue</li><li>Excellent storytelling, writing, and creative campaign development skills</li><li>Experience in early-stage startups or building marketing programs with limited resources</li><li>Comfortable working hands-on across strategy, content, campaigns, and analytics</li><li>Strong written and verbal English communication skills (C1 or above)</li><li>Familiarity with AI tools, creative technology, or content production is a plus</li><li>Experience in learning and development or educational technology is a plus</li></ul></div><div><p></p><h2>Additional Information</h2></div><div><p><strong>About SaaS Talent</strong></p><p>SaaS Talent is more than just a recruiting company. We're your hiring, business development and growth partner with 20+ years of experience in SaaS and Hi-Tech that helps you scale and transform your business. We've worked with 100+ companies and helped them achieve their goals. From streamlining sales, marketing, and operations to hiring ideal talent and getting funding, if you're struggling to grow, we're an ideal choice.</p><p>Reach out to us at&nbsp;<strong>www.saas-talent.com</strong>&nbsp;to learn more about how we can help you<strong>.</strong></p><p><strong><em>SMS Communication Consent Disclaimer</em></strong></p><p><em>By applying for this position, you agree to receive text message updates from SaaS Talent related to job opportunities. Standard message and data rates may apply, and messaging frequency varies. Text HELP for help and STOP to cancel.</em><em>Learn more about our opt-in SMS Communication consent policy here:&nbsp;</em><em>https://www.saas-talent.com/opt-in-sms-communication-consent</em></p></div><li> Compensation: USD <span>2500</span> - USD <span>3000</span> - monthly</li>

      <region>Latin America Only</region>
      <country></country>

      <skills>Operations Management, Problem Solving, and Process Improvement</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6714/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Argentina
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://jobs.workable.com/company/693tUBuhUB5i4ApXSEJJhA/jobs-at-drop-zero-digital">https://jobs.workable.com/company/693tUBuhUB5i4ApXSEJJhA/jobs-at-drop-zero-digital</a>
</p>

Grow our AI image service.<p>Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. Answers that could be about any company will not pass.</p>The role<p>We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.</p><p>You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:</p><li>The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.</li><li>Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.</li><p>Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.</p><p>This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.</p><p>We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.</p>What we are looking for<li>You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.</li><li>You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.</li><li>You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.</li><li>You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.</li><li>You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.</li><li>You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.</li>On experience<p>We do not ask for a number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.</p><p>Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.</p>How the process works, and we tell you all of it now<li>Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.</li><li>A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.</li><li>A 15 minute call with the founder.</li><li>A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.</li><li>Aptitude tests. These inform us, they do not decide.</li><li>A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.</li><p>The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.</p>
<li>Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.</li><li>Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.</li><li>Strong written English.</li><li>Based in Argentina.</li><li>You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.</li>
<p>2100 USD per month from day one, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.</p><p>On top of that:</p><li>A one-month annual bonus.</li><li>15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.</li><li>Paid sick leave.</li><li>A health allowance.</li><li>A coworking allowance.</li><p>Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/drop-zero-digital-operations-associate-hiring-or-client-delivery">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/drop-zero-digital-operations-associate-hiring-or-client-delivery</a></p>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0144/2748/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> SANTA ANA, CA
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://acestainless.com">https://acestainless.com</a>
</p>



<p class="codex-docx-preview_title">Ecommerce and Digital Marketing Manager</p>
<p>ACE STAINLESS SUPPLY</p>
<p>Full-time | Fully remote | Worldwide<br>$10,000–$25,000 USD annually, depending on experience<br>Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM Pacific Time</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_heading1">Build a website that earns its place in the business</p>
<p>Help us turn a ready product catalog into a working carbon steel storefront—and turn our digital marketing into qualified inquiries, orders, and repeat customers.</p>
<p>ACE Stainless Supply distributes stainless steel pipe, valves, fittings, bar, and sheet, serving customers through our Santa Ana, California, and Caldwell, Idaho, operations. We are expanding our digital business with AceCarbonSteel.com, and we want someone who can help build it, launch it, and grow it.</p>
<p>You will report to Erica Biscocho, Director of E-Commerce and Digital Operations. You will work alongside Hafsa in e-commerce and our marketing team, coordinate product information with Funmi, and partner with sales and our technical providers. This is a hands-on role: you will create content, make website improvements, run campaigns, and move launch work through to completion.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_heading1">Your first major deliverable</p>
<p>Launch design of AceCarbonSteel.com as an operational customer-facing website on January 1, 2027.</p>
<p>Our clean product data is ready. Your work is to transfer it accurately, propose the branding and design, build the shopping experience with the team, and prove that customers can use it successfully. You must bring practical website implementation experience as well as marketing skills.</p>
<p>The January 1 launch takes priority within your first 90 days. Our accelerated launch milestones are:</p>
<p>By November 20, 2026 — Present branding and design proposals for Erica’s approval: visual direction, homepage, category and product page concepts, navigation, mobile layouts, and a dated implementation plan with owners and dependencies.</p>
<p>By December 15, 2026 — Complete the approved design and catalog migration in staging. Configure search, filters, product pages, quote and purchase paths, and measurement tools with the appropriate team members.</p>
<p>By December 30, 2026 — Complete testing and corrections. Submit a documented launch checklist, test results, and outstanding issues for Erica’s go-live approval.</p>
<p>January 1, 2027 — Launch the approved site with working customer journeys, verified inquiry and order routing, and a launch campaign ready to run.</p>
<p>Through the remainder of your first 90 days, monitor the live site, resolve issues, and use actual customer behavior and sales results to prioritize improvements.</p>




<p class="codex-docx-preview_heading1">What launch ready means</p>
<p>You will own the launch checklist and coordinate technical dependencies early. Before release, the team must verify:</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Catalog accuracy: reconcile source and destination record counts; validate product identifiers, descriptions, sizes, materials, units of measure, weights, categories, and approved pricing. Resolve discrepancies with Funmi before publishing.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Customer experience: test navigation, product search and filters, mobile layouts, images, downloads, account access where applicable, and clear paths to request a quote or place an order.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Transactions and handoffs: test quote forms and notifications; validate applicable cart, checkout, payment, tax, freight, and order-confirmation flows with the responsible providers. Confirm that inquiries and orders reach the right Ace team.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Search and measurement: verify page titles, metadata, crawl and indexing settings, sitemap, redirects where needed, and analytics events for product views, inquiries, and purchases. Confirm that staging restrictions are removed at launch.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Operations: document how the team maintains the site, manages incoming inquiries and orders, and reports defects. Complete Erica’s final review before going live.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_heading1">What you will own after launch</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_heading2">SEO and website conversion</p>
<p>Build keyword and competitor research around how contractors, fabricators, and purchasing teams actually search. Improve category pages, product pages, metadata, internal links, and useful educational content. Use Google Search Console to identify indexing and search issues; use GA4 to find where customers abandon inquiry or purchase paths. Maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and complete approved changes.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_heading2">Social media and content</p>
<p>Own a practical publishing calendar for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. Create product features, application explainers, branch updates, customer stories with permission, and promotional content. Produce two YouTube videos per month and repurpose them into shorter clips and posts. Coordinate original footage with branch staff and verify technical claims with the product team.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_heading2">Email and sales support</p>
<p>Build and execute two Mailchimp campaigns each week, on Monday and Thursday. Segment audiences, maintain contact lists, test links and mobile layouts, and direct customers to relevant products or quote forms. Keep line cards, branch marketing materials, and website promotions current. Work with sales to connect campaign inquiries to follow-up and results.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_heading2">Brand consistency and execution</p>
<p>Keep messaging, visuals, product information, and calls to action consistent across websites, email, and social channels. Bring concepts and recommendations to Erica, obtain required approvals, and carry approved work through publication. Maintain a shared task board with deadlines, owners, blockers, and next actions.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<div class="popcorn-paged-annotation popcorn-paged-annotation-layer">&nbsp;</div>



<p class="codex-docx-preview_heading1">How we will measure success</p>
<p>Send a concise performance report every Monday by 10:00 AM Pacific Time. Show what changed, what it produced, and what you will do next. Establish baselines and agree on numeric growth targets with Erica during onboarding.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Website revenue and orders by site, with campaign attribution where tracking supports it.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Qualified web inquiries and quote requests; quote-to-order conversion in partnership with sales.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Organic search clicks, relevant search visibility, and progress on indexing or technical issues.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Conversion rates and customer drop-off across product, inquiry, and purchase journeys.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Email clicks, qualified inquiries, and attributable sales; social engagement and referral traffic as supporting measures.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Launch milestones, completed improvements, unresolved blockers, and the next week’s priorities.</p>
<p>Pricing follows Ace’s approved matrix and management direction. You will improve how we present and sell products, coordinating pricing or source-data changes with the people responsible for them.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_heading1">What you should bring</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Examples of websites or e-commerce projects you helped launch, including your actual role in catalog migration, page setup, testing, and release.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Proven SEO and digital marketing work with results you can explain: starting point, actions, timeframe, and business impact.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Hands-on ability in website content management, GA4, Google Search Console, Mailchimp or a comparable platform, and SEO research tools.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Strong written English, visual design judgment, and the ability to create useful graphics and edit video.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Comfort working with structured product data and spreadsheets while protecting specifications, units of measure, and approved pricing.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Clear remote communication, dependable availability during the stated Pacific Time schedule, and the ability to organize several workstreams.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Practical use of AI tools, with human review for product accuracy, brand quality, and original thinking.</p>
<p>Experience with B2B distribution, industrial products, Shopify, ERP-connected storefronts, or INxSQL is a plus. You can learn our products; you should arrive knowing how to execute digital work and demonstrate results.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_heading1">Why this opportunity</p>
<p>You will work directly with the leader responsible for digital growth, have a prepared catalog to build from, and see your work become a live sales channel. We value people who spot opportunities, propose a solution, follow through, and are candid when something needs attention.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_heading1">How to apply</p>
<p>Email your résumé and portfolio to tom@acestainless.com with the subject line: ACE Digital Marketing and Ecommerce —&nbsp; Erica will help review candidates and assess the working fit.&nbsp; Erica will be your direct report.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Please include:</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Two relevant examples of your work, describing what you personally built or managed and the results.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">A short note with three specific opportunities you see for AceStainless.com or the AceCarbonSteel.com launch. Brief bullets are enough.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">A brief outline of how you would approach the January 1 launch, including the support you would need and any timing risks.</p>
<p class="codex-docx-preview_listbullet codex-docx-preview-num-1-0">Your location, earliest start date, and confirmation that you can work the stated Pacific Time schedule.</p>

<p class="ql-align-justify">CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.</p><p class="ql-align-justify">At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.</p><p class="ql-align-justify"><br></p><p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>Role overview</strong></p><p class="ql-align-justify">We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.&nbsp;</p><p class="ql-align-justify">You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.</p><p class="ql-align-justify">Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.</p><p class="ql-align-justify">You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.</p><p class="ql-align-justify"><br></p><p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>What you will work on</strong></p><ul><li>Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;</li><li>Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;</li><li>Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;</li><li>Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;</li><li>Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;</li><li>Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;</li><li>Run regular R&amp;D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;</li><li>Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;</li><li>Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;</li><li>Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.</li></ul><p><br></p> <p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>Your must-haves</strong></p><p class="ql-align-justify"><em>You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.</em></p><ul><li>5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);</li><li>Mature Leader &amp; Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;</li><li>Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;</li><li>Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;</li><li>Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;</li><li>AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.</li><li>Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;</li><li>Fluency in English - both spoken and written.</li></ul><p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>Nice to have</strong></p><ul><li>A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;</li><li>Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);</li><li>Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;</li><li>Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.</li></ul><p><br></p><p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>What we offer</strong></p><ul><li>Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.</li><li>Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.</li><li>Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.</li><li>Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.</li><li>Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.</li><li>Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.</li><li>Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.</li></ul>

  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://convertibles.dev">http://convertibles.dev</a>
</p>

<div class="col col-xs-7 description">
<p><strong>About us</strong></p><p>Convertibles is a CRO and Shopify development agency for 8 and 9 figure D2C brands. We've just brought Google and YouTube ads in-house under the same roof, run by our co-founder Clay. He's been doing Google Ads for ecommerce since 2013: built and exited his own brand on Google Ads and CRO, then ran Google and YouTube for brands spending $50k to $500k+ a month on Google alone. The ads book today is around seven brands across the US, UK, EU and Australia, and it's growing.</p><p><strong>The role</strong></p><p>This is an apprenticeship with a real job attached. You work directly with Clay (x @ecomclay), learn how he runs accounts, and within 90 days you're running the weekly cycle on your first accounts yourself.</p><p>The weekly cycle, concretely:</p><ul><li>Monday: pull last week's numbers (Google Ads platform side plus the client's attribution tool - Triple Whale, Converge or Northbeam), update the reporting workbook, write the client update, produce the actions list. Exact campaign, exact change, why.</li><li>Through the week: make the changes, watch pacing, check feeds and Merchant Center, build new campaigns (Search, Shopping, PMax, YouTube / Demand Gen).</li><li>Client calls: sit in first, then run them.</li></ul><p><strong>How we work, so you know what you're signing up for</strong></p><ul><li>YouTube and Demand Gen are the main event, not a side channel. We take a brand's winning Meta ads, recut them for YouTube, and scale. Accounts have gone from YouTube at 6-12% of media mix to 13-22%, at a return that held for over a year.</li><li>Attribution-tool numbers decide YouTube, not platform numbers. If you've only ever judged campaigns on what Google Ads says, you'll learn a different lens.</li><li>Everything gets a number. "Performance improved" is not a finding. "NC-CPA went from £38 to £30 on the same spend" is.</li><li>AI is part of the workflow. Reporting workbooks, data pulls and first drafts are built with Claude. You don't need to be a developer, but you need to be comfortable working this way.</li><li>There's a dev, CRO, QA and design team behind the ads. When a landing page or a feed needs fixing, someone fixes it.</li></ul><p><strong>Who fits</strong></p><ul><li>2-4 years hands-on in Google Ads for ecommerce. Your hands on the account, not managing someone whose hands are.</li><li>You've run Search, Shopping and PMax on real budgets (at least one account at $20k+/month). You've at least touched YouTube or Demand Gen and want to go deep on it.</li><li>Comfortable in Google Sheets / Excel. You can look at eight weeks of campaign data and tell me what changed and why.</li><li>You know what a Merchant Center disapproval is and how to fix it.</li><li>You write clearly in English. You'll be writing to clients by week five.</li><li>Curious, direct, not precious about being told you're wrong.</li></ul><p>Not a fit: agency account managers who relay what the specialist did. Meta buyers who "also do Google". Anyone who needs the basics explained.</p><p><strong>Hours</strong></p><p>Full-time, 40h/wk. Your morning overlaps with Clay (he's UTC+8), your afternoon overlaps with UK/EU clients and the US East Coast. Flexible beyond that.</p><p><strong>First 90 days</strong></p><ul><li>Weeks 1-4: shadow. Pull the data, build the workbooks, sit on every call.</li><li>Weeks 5-8: draft the Monday updates and actions lists for two accounts. Clay reviews before they go out.</li><li>Weeks 9-12: own the weekly cycle and the check-in call on your first account.</li></ul><p>Comp is reviewed at 90 days. The per-account bonus starts when you own an account.</p><p><strong>What you get</strong></p><p>Direct training from someone who's done this for 13 years, on his own money and then on clients'. A team behind you. A real path: run accounts, then lead the Google / YouTube lane.</p><p><strong>How to apply</strong></p><p>Keep it short. Answer the questions in the form with numbers, not adjectives. Shortlisted people do a paid 2-3 hour test task, then a call with Clay.</p> </div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/convertibles-google-youtube-ads-specialist-ecommerce-remote-full-time-asia">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/convertibles-google-youtube-ads-specialist-ecommerce-remote-full-time-asia</a></p>

<div class="content"><div class="section-wrapper page-full-width"><div class="section page-centered"><div>
<p><strong>This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Google Ads Media Buyer – Worldwide at Growth Agency based in Estonia.</strong></p>
<p>As a Google Ads Media Buyer, you will take ownership of paid advertising strategies and campaign performance for direct-to-consumer (DTC) eCommerce brands. You will manage Google Ads accounts end-to-end, from strategic planning and budget allocation to execution, testing, and continuous optimization. Your primary focus will be driving sustainable business growth and maximizing actual profitability rather than simply improving in-platform metrics. Working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment, you will have significant responsibility and the opportunity to make independent decisions from an early stage. You will collaborate with experienced professionals, contribute to structured experimentation, and develop your technical and analytical expertise. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on accountability, continuous learning, and measurable results.</p>
</div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>Accountabilities</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list"><div><div>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Manage Google Ads accounts end-to-end, taking ownership of campaign strategy, execution, optimization, budgets, and platform-specific client communications.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Develop and implement performance-driven advertising strategies focused on generating sustainable profit and business growth rather than relying solely on high in-platform ROAS.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Create, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads formats, including Search, Display, Shopping, and Performance Max.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Optimize shopping feeds and collaborate closely with the dedicated feed management specialist to improve campaign efficiency and performance.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Conduct creative and copy testing, write compelling ad copy, contribute to creative briefs, and implement structured testing frameworks.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Analyze campaign performance beyond in-platform metrics, identify trends and opportunities, and translate data into actionable optimization strategies.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Monitor budgets, campaign efficiency, and profitability to ensure advertising investments deliver measurable business outcomes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Communicate campaign developments, performance insights, and strategic recommendations to clients through Slack and regular meetings.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Maintain detailed notes during strategy discussions, actively seek feedback, ask insightful questions, and continuously deepen your understanding of campaign performance and advertising strategy.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Take ownership of results, proactively identify improvement opportunities, and continuously refine campaign approaches through experimentation and data analysis.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Requirements:</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>At least 1–2 years of hands-on Google Ads experience, preferably managing campaigns for DTC eCommerce brands or similar businesses.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Fluent English communication skills, with the confidence to interact professionally with clients and internal stakeholders.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong understanding of profit-focused advertising strategies, with the ability to optimize for actual business profitability rather than vanity metrics or platform-reported performance alone.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Practical experience with Google Ads campaign types, including Search, Display, Shopping, and Performance Max.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Genuine curiosity about the technical aspects of digital advertising, including feed management, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), conversion tracking, and attribution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to interpret performance data, identify patterns, and make informed decisions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Independent working style, strong sense of ownership, and confidence in managing responsibilities without constant supervision.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Growth mindset, intellectual curiosity, and motivation to continuously improve technical and strategic expertise.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Openness to constructive criticism, direct feedback, and challenging professional discussions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ability to adapt to a fast-paced environment where priorities, strategies, and responsibilities may evolve.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Located within a European time zone or willing to work according to EU time-zone requirements.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>This role is particularly suited to candidates who:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Enjoy taking responsibility and making independent decisions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are motivated by measurable results and real business impact.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Welcome challenges, accountability, and continuous professional development.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Prefer an environment that encourages initiative rather than step-by-step supervision.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are committed to developing deep expertise in performance marketing rather than spreading their efforts across too many areas.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>A specific academic degree is not required. Practical skills, mindset, analytical thinking, and motivation are the primary selection criteria.</p>
<h2>Benefits:</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>100% remote working environment, offering flexibility to work from anywhere.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Flexible working hours, with core availability aligned with European time zones.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Performance-based salary structure, with compensation increases linked to individual results and performance rather than length of service.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Performance bonuses rewarding strong contributions and measurable achievements.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Mentorship opportunities and a clear professional development path, with transparent expectations for career progression.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Personal development budget covering courses, certifications, and professional tools.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Private healthcare coverage.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Company-provided technology and additional work-related benefits.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Direct communication and honest, constructive feedback in both directions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Collaborative team environment with engaging and enjoyable team meetings.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Opportunity to take ownership of campaigns, work with DTC eCommerce brands, and accelerate your growth in performance marketing.</p>
</li>
</ul>
