      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/3794/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Australia
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://zandahealth.com/eu/">https://zandahealth.com/eu/</a>
</p>

<h1>Paid Media Coordinator</h1>
<p>Are you someone who loves building relationships, spotting new opportunities, and bringing great ideas to life? We're looking for a Paid Media Coordinator to help grow Zanda's reach and connect more health professionals with the tools they need to run successful practices.</p>
<p>In this hands-on role, you'll manage our advertising, sponsorship, and association partnerships across international markets. From discovering new opportunities to promote Zanda and negotiating great deals to coordinating the deliverables and measuring their impact, you'll play an important part in how we grow. You'll work within our Marketing team while having the autonomy to make things happen.</p>
<h2>What You’ll Be Doing</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Build and own relationships with associations, publishers, media partners, agencies, and vendors across our key international markets.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Identify and pursue new opportunities for advertising, sponsorships, and partnerships that increase Zanda's brand awareness and reach.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Evaluate and negotiate advertising opportunities, securing competitive rates, valuable placements, and partnerships that deliver results.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Coordinate campaigns from start to finish, working with internal teams and external partners to keep creative assets, approvals, tracking, and deadlines on track.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Manage Programmatic Advertising across channels such as Paid Social and Display, and support opportunities in Paid Search and emerging advertising platforms.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Manage campaign operations, including advertising calendars, budgets, pipelines, and vendor coordination.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Track and evaluate performance, using campaign data and insights to identify what's working, recommend improvements, and maximize the value of our advertising investments.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>What You’ll Bring to the Team</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>2-3+ years of relevant experience in marketing, media, partnerships, sponsorships, or campaign management.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with external partners, vendors, agencies, or stakeholders.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the confidence to explore opportunities, discuss terms, and secure mutually beneficial outcomes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience coordinating campaigns or partnerships end-to-end, balancing multiple stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A good understanding of campaign performance and the ability to use data to evaluate results and make practical recommendations, alongside experience supporting creative briefs, advertising copy, or landing-page improvements.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Bonus Points If You Have:</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Experience working with professional associations, publishers, sponsorships, or media partnerships across international markets.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Familiarity with Paid Social, Display, Paid Search, or emerging advertising channels.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or project management platforms.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>An understanding of marketing metrics such as CAC, CPA, ROAS, attribution, or UTM tracking.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience in SaaS, HealthTech, or using AI and automation tools to improve marketing workflows.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Who You Are</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>A natural relationship builder. You enjoy connecting with people, creating genuine partnerships, and aren't afraid to negotiate or ask for a better deal.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Proactive and resourceful. You spot opportunities, take initiative, and find ways to move things forward without waiting to be asked.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Organized and detail-oriented. You can juggle multiple moving pieces while keeping track of the small details that make a big difference.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Someone who takes ownership. You're comfortable making decisions, following through on commitments, and being accountable for outcomes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Adaptable and collaborative. You enjoy working with different people, navigating changing priorities and company direction, and finding solutions along the way.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Why You’ll Love Working With Us</h2>
<p>✅ Work from Anywhere<br>We’ve been a fully distributed team from the start - no offices, no commute, just great people from all over the world doing meaningful work together.<br>✅ Flexibility &amp; Autonomy<br>We care about outcomes, not clock-watching. Outside of agreed core hours that align to your role, your time is yours - whether that’s doing the school run or squeezing in a midday gym class.<br>✅ Generous Paid Time Off<br>Balance matters. We offer paid time off and expect you to take it - because rest fuels great work.<br>✅ High Trust, Results Driven<br>We strip away red tape so you can focus on impact. No pointless meetings or rigid hierarchies -&nbsp; just space to move fast, solve problems, and make a difference.<br>✅ Growth &amp; Innovation<br>You’ll be encouraged to experiment, stretch your skills, and bring YOUR bold ideas to the table. Everyone at Zanda contributes to shaping what’s next.<br>✅ Inspiring Teammates<br>You’ll work alongside passionate, curious people who support and cheer each other on - even across time zones. Collaboration is how we win.<br>✅ Meaningful Impact<br>Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Your work will directly improve lives.<br>✅ Competitive Pay<br>We hire the best people - wherever they are - and we make sure they feel valued and well-rewarded for the work they do.</p>
<h2>About Zanda</h2>
<p>Zanda is a fast-growing, globally loved practice management platform that helps health professionals run smooth, efficient practices - and spend more time caring for their patients. We’re used by thousands of clinics across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, the US, and Canada, and we’re just getting started.</p>
<p>Our mission is simple: make health practice management easy and enjoyable.<br>To do that, we need brilliant, passionate people who are excited by innovation, love solving complex problems, and thrive in fast-moving environments.</p>
<p>At Zanda, you’ll join a globally distributed team that’s small enough to move fast and think big - and driven enough to deliver work that makes a real impact. We live our values every day:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Growth: We stretch ourselves, learn constantly, and support each other’s development.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Reliability: We follow through on our commitments and show up for our team and customers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Impact: Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Teamwork: We win together -&nbsp; celebrating wins, sharing ideas, and having each other’s backs.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Zanda collects and processes your personal data for the purposes of managing employment candidate application and recruitment-related activities as well as for organisational planning purposes, for further detail, please refer to the<a href="https://zandahealth.com/privacy-policy/"> Zanda Health Privacy Policy</a>.</p>
<p><br>This is an exciting time to join Zanda. We’re self-funded, scaling quickly, and building something that truly changes lives. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a meaningful difference - we’d love to hear from you.</p>

product.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>What you need</strong></p><ul><li><p><strong>4+ years as a quota-carrying Account Executive</strong><span> </span>closing new business in B2B SaaS, with a push deals to a decision rather than letting them drift. Intro call</p><p>2. Conversation with our founder</p><p>3. Pitch us. Run us through a pitch for your current company’s product, the way you’d do it on a real first call.</p><p>4. Paid take-home exercise We give you a list of companies; you show us how you'd prioritize them and draft your first outreach.</p><p>5. Team session. Walk us through your exercise, then work through a few real buyer scenarios with the team.<br></p>

<p>

    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://welltech.com">http://welltech.com</a>
</p>

<p><strong>Who Are We?</strong></p><p>Welltech is a global wellness technology company with Ukrainian roots. Our mission is <strong>to build and scale wellness apps globally through state-of-the-art, tech-driven performance marketing.</strong><br><br>We are one of the most established players in the wellness app space, and we are accelerating. Over <strong>25.5 million</strong> people across the world use our apps — <strong>Muscle Booster, Yoga-Go, and WalkFit</strong> — to build healthier habits, move more, and feel better every day. Every subscription represents a real person making a real change in their life, and we take that seriously.<br><br>With <strong>500+ people</strong> across hubs in <strong>Cyprus, Ukraine, Poland, Spain, and the UK</strong>, we combine the scale of a market leader and the drive of a team that's just getting started.<br></p><p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p><p>As a <strong>Growth Product Manager</strong>, you will own and optimise acquisition funnels for one of our apps while leading complex, high-impact growth initiatives. You will combine advanced experimentation, strong commercial judgment, creativity, and deep user insight to develop innovative funnel experiences that drive subscription conversion, ARPU, and sustainable growth at scale.</p><p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p><ul><li><p>Own the performance and experimentation roadmap for your acquisition funnels, proactively identifying and prioritising the highest-impact growth opportunities.</p></li><li><p>Independently tackle complex and ambiguous growth challenges, translating them into clear strategies, actionable hypotheses, and experimentation plans.</p></li><li><p>Design and lead sophisticated experiments across areas such as pricing, personalisation, monetisation, and new funnel architectures, balancing learning speed with commercial risk.</p></li><li><p>Go beyond standard funnel metrics to uncover root causes, size opportunities, and evaluate the broader business impact of your experiments, including downstream monetisation and LTV.</p></li><li><p>Develop innovative funnel concepts that go beyond existing templates, leveraging audience psychology, user research, emerging trends, and creative experimentation.</p></li><li><p>Lead high-impact cross-functional initiatives, aligning design, engineering, analytics, acquisition, content, and product teams to bring complex ideas to life.</p></li><li><p>Apply strong experimentation methodology and statistical judgment to ensure reliable results, challenge assumptions, and make sound decisions even when data is inconclusive.</p></li><li><p>Translate experiment results into strategic insights, identifying patterns and building on learnings to inform future growth opportunities.</p></li><li><p>Build coherent acquisition experiences that connect advertising creatives, funnel messaging, monetisation, and product value propositions.</p></li><li><p>Leverage AI and automation to develop reusable workflows that improve the speed and quality of research, ideation, and experimentation.</p></li></ul><p><strong>Your professional qualities</strong></p><ul><li><p>5+ years of experience in Growth, Product, Product Marketing, or CRO/Experimentation roles, with a demonstrated track record of delivering measurable business impact.</p></li><li><p>Advanced experimentation expertise, including strong knowledge of A/B testing methodology, statistical concepts, and complex experiment design.</p></li><li><p>Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to connect conversion performance to monetisation, LTV, and broader business outcomes.</p></li><li><p>Deep understanding of UX, audience psychology, user research, and conversion optimisation.</p></li><li><p>Proven ability to independently navigate ambiguous problems, develop strategies, and drive complex initiatives from ideation through execution.</p></li><li><p>Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and lead projects without formal authority.</p></li><li><p>Creative and innovative mindset, with the ability to challenge conventional approaches and develop original growth ideas.</p></li><li><p>English proficiency B2+.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>Candidate Journey</strong></p><p>️⭕️ Recruiter Call → ⭕️ Meet a team member → ️⭕️ Skills Assessment → ️⭕️ Leadership Interviews <br></p><p><strong>Check Out Some of Our Products</strong><br><a class="c-link" href="https://musclebooster.fitness/">Muscle Booster</a> </p><p><a class="c-link" href="https://yoga-go.io/">Yoga-Go</a> </p><p><a class="c-link" href="http://walkfit.pro/">WalkFit</a></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/welltech-product-growth-manager-acquisition-funnels">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/welltech-product-growth-manager-acquisition-funnels</a></p>

quality, player cohorts, retention trends, and LTV across affiliate partners.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Make commercial recommendations based on performance data and market opportunities.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Establish KPI frameworks for affiliate performance and partner profitability.</span></p></li></ul><h3>Requirements:</h3><ul><li><p><span>Minimum 5+ years’ experience in affiliate management within iGaming, with proven success in the online casino vertical.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Established network of affiliates and media partners across regulated, emerging, and pre-regulated markets.</span></p></li><li><p><span>In-depth understanding of affiliate KPIs, commercial deal structures, and performance optimisation.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Experience launching, scaling, and optimising affiliate programmes across emerging and newly regulated markets.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Strong understanding of market-entry strategies, player acquisition economics, and traffic diversification across multiple jurisdictions.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with the ability to combine performance data, player value metrics, and market insights to drive strategic decisions.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Entrepreneurial approach, self-starter mentality, and comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Experience working closely with BI and CRM teams to evaluate traffic quality and long-term player value.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Proven ability to identify and capitalize on new growth opportunities in markets with varying levels of regulatory maturity.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Extensive experience negotiating and managing commercial agreements with a broad range of affiliate and media partners.</span></p></li></ul><p>This is an exceptional opportunity to apply your expertise and contribute to the success of a high-performing organisation with a global presence.</p><h3>What we offer:</h3><p>Competitive Compensation: You will receive a highly competitive compensation package, flexible working arrangements, recognising that achieving your best in your career requires a healthy balance between work and personal life.</p><p></p>

      <title>CapsLock: Creative Design Team Lead (AI & Performance Marketing)</title>
      <region>Remote</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>Adobe Creative Suite, Analytics, Community Growth, Architect, Architecture, Blog Writing, Analytics Tools,  Editing, Audio Editing, and Brand Identity Design</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Chișinău, Remote, Anguilla
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://capslock.global">http://capslock.global</a>
</p>

<p class="ql-align-justify">CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.</p><p class="ql-align-justify">At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.</p><p class="ql-align-justify"><br></p><p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>Role overview</strong></p><p class="ql-align-justify">We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.&nbsp;</p><p class="ql-align-justify">You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.</p><p class="ql-align-justify">Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.</p><p class="ql-align-justify">You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.</p><p class="ql-align-justify"><br></p><p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>What you will work on</strong></p><ul><li>Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;</li><li>Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;</li><li>Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;</li><li>Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;</li><li>Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;</li><li>Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;</li><li>Run regular R&amp;D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;</li><li>Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;</li><li>Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;</li><li>Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.</li></ul><p><br></p> <p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>Your must-haves</strong></p><p class="ql-align-justify"><em>You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.</em></p><ul><li>5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);</li><li>Mature Leader &amp; Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;</li><li>Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;</li><li>Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;</li><li>Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;</li><li>AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.</li><li>Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;</li><li>Fluency in English - both spoken and written.</li></ul><p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>Nice to have</strong></p><ul><li>A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;</li><li>Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);</li><li>Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;</li><li>Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.</li></ul><p><br></p><p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>What we offer</strong></p><ul><li>Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.</li><li>Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.</li><li>Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.</li><li>Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.</li><li>Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.</li><li>Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.</li><li>Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.</li></ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/capslock-creative-design-team-lead-ai-performance-marketing">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/capslock-creative-design-team-lead-ai-performance-marketing</a></p>
</description>

This is not an entry-level role - we are looking for someone who understands marketing strategy, executes at a high level, and brings ideas forward - not just deliverables.</p><p>In Teamswell, every team member has an instrumental role and impact on the success of our business and our clients’ success, so we seek to have highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced work environment, who are intelligent, eager to work hard, reliable, and able to communicate effectively with all levels of an organization. We value people who are good communicators, quick learners, scrappy about finding creative solutions to problems, and conscious of their work quality. We expect all our team members to deliver excellence in both technical expertise as well as in their everyday relationships with their team.</p><p>RESPONSIBILITIES</p><ul><li>Execute marketing campaigns for chapter events, programs, and initiatives from concept through delivery</li><li>Develop and manage content across social media and digital platforms</li><li>Create newsletters, flyers, PDFs, and promotional materials that are polished, engaging, and on-brand</li><li>Manage and grow social media presence across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn</li><li>Design high-quality visual content using Canva or equivalent tools</li><li>Maintain and update website content as needed (event pages, announcements, resources)</li><li>Use CRM/marketing tools such as Pipedrive to support campaign execution and tracking</li><li>Monitor engagement and performance metrics and provide insights and recommendations</li><li>Ensure full brand consistency across all communications and platforms</li></ul><br><br><strong>Requirements</strong><br><p></p><p>REQUIREMENTS &amp; QUALIFICATIONS</p><ul><li>Proven experience in digital marketing, content strategy, and campaign execution (not hobby-level or occasional freelance work)</li><li>Strong portfolio of work across social media, email marketing, and digital campaigns</li><li>Advanced design capability using Canva or similar tools (high-quality flyers, PDFs, and social creative)</li><li>Hands-on experience managing brand accounts on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn</li><li>Demonstrated ability to create and execute email newsletters and campaign content</li><li>Experience with CRM or marketing automation tools (Pipedrive preferred, or equivalent such as HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, etc.)</li><li>Comfort managing and updating website content (WordPress or similar platforms)</li><li>Exceptional attention to detail and strong sense of brand consistency</li><li>Excellent communication skills with a proactive, solution-oriented approach</li><li>Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities</li></ul>

      <title>ClickGUARD Inc.: RevOps Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Virginia</state>
      <skills>Data Analysis, HubSpot, Revenue Management, Sales, and Workflow Description Language</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Contract</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0074/4123/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.clickguard.com/">https://www.clickguard.com/</a>
</p>

<p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next.</span></p>
<p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers.</span></p>
<p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency.</span></p>
<p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><strong><span>What You'll Own</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced.</span></li>
<li>
<p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery.</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><strong><span>You're a Fit If</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>You've personally rebuilt a CRM</span><span> that a revenue team relied on, and you can show the before and after: workflows fixed, fields retired, duplicate records merged, and reports leadership started to trust.</span></li>
<li><span>You have built real AI-powered workflows</span><span> and can show what you built, where AI sat in the workflow, what it automated or augmented, and the measurable impact it created.</span></li>
<li><span>You understand subscription revenue</span><span> well enough to reconcile MRR between Stripe and the CRM, and to explain why the two numbers differ</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Hands-on with HubSpot (Operations Hub or equivalent), SQL, CLI, API’s, Webhooks, n8n/Make, and Claude Code or Codex</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>You can explain lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, and attribution models without Googling</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>You treat product usage as revenue data: trial activity, connected ad accounts, and plan limits feed scoring and routing</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><strong><span>You're Not a Fit If</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Your experience is mostly building dashboards on top of data someone else had to fix</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>You measure success in workflows built and tickets closed rather than conversion and revenue</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>You need a team around you; this role is the builder for our foundation</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Required Skills &amp; Experience</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><span>3-5+ Years in RevOps or Revenue Systems: </span></strong><span>Proven experience owning the CRM and revenue data for a B2B SaaS company, ideally one with a self-serve trial or product-led motion. You can show the numbers: data completeness, workflow reliability, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and time saved.</span></li>
<li><strong><span>CRM Architecture: </span></strong><span>Concrete experience designing an object model, lifecycle stages, and pipelines from scratch, or rebuilding a broken one, including migrations that keep the history intact. You document every field you create and retire the ones nobody uses.</span></li>
<li><strong><span>Data Ownership: </span></strong><span>You have personally owned the path from source system to report: event tracking, warehouse tables, SQL, and reconciliation against billing. When two systems disagree, you find out why before anyone reports the number.</span></li>
<li><strong><span>AI-Native Execution: </span></strong><span>You have personally built AI-powered systems inside a revenue workflow, including enrichment, scoring, routing, classification, data cleanup, forecasting, or agentic workflows. You can clearly explain what you built, why you built it, how it worked, and what measurable result it produced in terms of pipeline, revenue, productivity, speed, quality, or reduced manual work.</span></li>
<li><strong><span>Full-Funnel Accountability: </span></strong><span>You measure your work through the full chain from signup → trial → qualified account → paid → renewal → expansion. You can show examples where a process you built moved conversion or retention. You are comfortable killing your own workflows when the data says they are not helping.</span></li>
<li><strong><span>Cross-Team Range:</span></strong><span> Ability to work with sales, customer success, marketing, finance, and engineering: you write specs an engineer can build from and processes a sales rep will follow.</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><strong><span>Technical Proficiency</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>HubSpot CRM Ecosystem:</span><span> (Expert Level) Custom objects, associations, workflows, lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, lists, permissions, and the HubSpot API.</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>SQL &amp; Product Analytics:</span><span> (Working Level) Comfortable writing SQL against a warehouse (PostHog or equivalent) and joining product events with billing and CRM data.</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Billing Systems:</span><span> Working fluency with Stripe: subscriptions, invoices, coupons, failed payments, and how each one shows up in MRR.</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Enrichment &amp; Data APIs:</span><span> Clay or equivalent, people and company data providers, and comfort consuming REST APIs and webhooks directly.</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Automation Engineering:</span><span> Strong execution knowledge of workflow automation (n8n, Make, or native AI-agent integrations) and AI coding tools (Claude Code or Codex), connecting the stack without engineering support.</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><strong><span>Logistics</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Remote, async-first team culture.</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Must have overlapping availability for live syncs between </span><span>7 AM and 2 PM EST</span><span>.</span></li>
<li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Full-time, long-term position.</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177">&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clickguard-inc-revops-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clickguard-inc-revops-manager</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Socure: Technical Content Marketing Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state>California</state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6678/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.socure.com/">https://www.socure.com/</a>
</p>

<p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>This is an employment marketing role for someone who can make exceptional engineers want to work at Socure. Socure is building AI-native infrastructure for identity, fraud prevention, and trust, and we need your help getting that engineering story out to the places where great technical talent discovers ideas, follows builders, and finds its next challenge.</p>
<p>You will work closely with engineers, technical leaders, recruiting, and marketing to turn APIs, machine learning models, identity graphs, and decisioning workflows into a compelling case for joining the team. Your work will show software engineers the problems they can solve here, the systems they can help build, and the ambition behind Socure's mission.</p>
<p><strong>Why this role matters</strong></p>
<p>The best engineers are not looking for generic employer branding. They are looking for hard technical problems, strong peers, meaningful architecture, and a mission worth their time. You will make those things visible - in the communities, publications, developer platforms, social channels, and other talent-rich spaces where engineers actually pay attention.</p>
<p><strong>What you will do</strong></p>
<p><strong>Tell the engineering story</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Interview engineers and technical leaders, learn how the platform works, and turn real technical work into stories that make top engineers lean in.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Write technical content - including engineering blogs, deep dives, architecture stories, technical whitepapers, and recruiting-facing website copy - that makes the work at Socure tangible.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Reach engineers where they are</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Own an employment-marketing content calendar built around the channels and communities where software engineers discover work, exchange ideas, and decide which companies deserve their attention.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Adapt and distribute stories across developer platforms, technical publications, engineering communities, social channels, and other high-signal places where the best talent gathers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Partner with recruiting and employer brand to connect content to talent goals, strengthen candidate interest, and support hard-to-fill engineering hiring.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Make difficult technology compelling</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Translate APIs, machine learning models, identity graphs, decisioning workflows, and cloud-based architectures into accurate, engaging stories for technical audiences.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Show why the problems matter, what makes Socure's approach distinctive, and what an engineer could help build next.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Build real subject matter depth</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Develop enough understanding of Socure's products and platform to write with authority, ask sharp questions, and earn the trust of technical experts.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Stay current on AI, fraud, identity, security, and infrastructure trends, and turn them into timely points of view that attract the right people.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>How you will work</strong></p>
<p><strong>Collaborate across the company</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Work with engineering, recruiting, employer brand, product marketing, and technical subject matter experts to find the strongest stories and get them ready for the right audiences.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Partner with design, social, and distribution teams to package and place content for reach, credibility, and candidate action.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Build a repeatable feedback loop with engineers so the content stays technically honest and genuinely representative of the work.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Raise the bar</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Protect a high editorial standard for clarity, accuracy, voice, and consistency across every channel.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Edit and proofread content from other contributors, and help maintain Socure's content style guide.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Use AI thoughtfully</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Use AI tools such as ChatGPT's Deep Research to accelerate research, drafting, and technical enablement while keeping human judgment, verification, and editorial quality at the center.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you bring</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Demonstrable experience in content writing, technical writing, employer brand, recruiting marketing, or content marketing, ideally in identity verification, fraud, cybersecurity, fintech, infrastructure, or another technical B2B SaaS environment.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong technical curiosity and the ability to learn and write accurately about APIs, machine learning, and cloud-based architectures.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with a talent for making complex technical work clear, credible, and exciting to software engineers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A portfolio of published technical, engineering, employer-brand, or recruiting content, such as blogs, deep dives, whitepapers, case studies, or similar work.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience partnering cross-functionally with engineering, recruiting, employer brand, product marketing, and subject matter experts.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong editorial and distribution instincts, with comfort owning a content calendar, finding the right audience and channel, giving and receiving feedback, and maintaining a consistent voice.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience using AI tools for research, drafting, and content production is a plus.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>If you can understand ambitious engineering work, find the audience that will appreciate it, and make great engineers curious enough to start a conversation, we want to hear from you.</p>
<p><em>Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company.       <title>Forward Push Law Firm Marketing: Marketing Specialist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Georgia</state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/2071/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://forwardpush.com/">https://forwardpush.com/</a>
</p>

<p><strong>Marketing Specialist</strong></p>
<p>Remote Worldwide · Full-Time · 8:00am to 5:00pm Eastern Time · 90-Day Paid Trial to Start</p>
<p><strong>Required:</strong> 4+ years at a marketing agency (a company that serves multiple clients; in-house or freelance-only experience does not count) and fluent English (C1 or above).</p>
<p><strong>The Role: </strong>We are hiring a Marketing Specialist to work across both client and Forward Push marketing priorities, taking approved strategy, content, and direction and turning it into accurate, polished work that is executed correctly. That includes creating brand and web assets from approved direction.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on, proactive role. Our AI agents and automations handle more of the repetitive work every month, so this role is not about copying and pasting or scheduling posts. You will run and quality-check our AI-assisted marketing workflows, keep us ahead of what is changing in marketing and AI, test new tools and models, and tell us what we should be doing differently. In your first few months you will also handle hands-on execution, such as publishing, onboarding, and QA. As we automate those tasks, your role grows toward strategy and ideas.</p>
<p>We do not expect you to know everything. We do expect you to know how to find the answer, test what you learn, document it, and know when a question is needed before moving forward.</p>
<p>This is not an entry-level marketing position. We are looking for someone with enough experience to know what good marketing execution looks like and enough judgment to catch problems before they become rework. Most of all, we want someone who is frustrated that their knowledge is going to waste at their current job and who can’t see room to advance there. You can see how fast technology is changing marketing, and you want to be the person who puts it to work.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p>
<p>Industry Intelligence &amp; AI Testing</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Monitor industry news daily and flag updates that affect Forward Push or our clients, such as AI model releases, Google and algorithm changes, platform updates, and pricing changes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Test new AI models and tools against what we use today, such as comparing models on the same task or trying a new video or image tool, and document what worked, what did not, and what it cost. You will have room to experiment.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Challenge the team with ideas. We want someone who says “did you hear about this?” before we do.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Marketing Execution &amp; Publishing</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Run our AI-assisted publishing workflows to schedule and publish client and Forward Push social media content across major platforms, including bulk scheduling in GoHighLevel.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Publish YouTube, podcast, blog, and other approved content, then confirm formatting, links, images, titles, descriptions, and other details are correct.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Perform final QA before and after publication so the right content, image, account, platform, and schedule are being used.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Review images for quality and audience fit, and create graphics or AI-generated images when needed.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Coordinate approved ad creative and copy with the team members responsible for managing paid campaigns on other platforms.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Build and maintain branded image templates for each client (Meta, Google Business Profile, YouTube thumbnails, Shorts, press releases), then produce finished images from them.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Format, finalize and publish press releases from approved copy, confirming images, links and distribution details are correct.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Create and edit professional headshots from client photos, making sure the likeness is accurate and approved by the client.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Write and enter meta titles and descriptions for new website pages and published content.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Client Onboarding &amp; Platform Setup</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Own assigned onboarding tasks, including Google Business Profile setup and optimization, social platform setup, YouTube configuration, and Google Drive organization.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Research platform requirements and best practices when something is unfamiliar, then complete the work accurately or confirm questions with Operations before proceeding.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Write profile bios and “about” descriptions when setting up social and platform profiles.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Handle Google Business Profile support issues, including verification problems, suspensions, support tickets and follow-up replies, until they are resolved.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Set up Yelp business pages and Yelp ad campaigns for clients, working from approved direction and budgets.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Gather and organize the client files and assets our web developer needs for quotes and builds.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Website, Brand &amp; Web Content</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Help setting up websites for new client, following Forward Push’s SOPs.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Create logos and basic brand identity assets (logo, colors, typography) for new clients from approved direction.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Create website copy by drafting and editing page copy from AI-generated first drafts and client information, then passing it to the Marketing Quality Lead for review.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Create attorney bios by reviewing client intake answers, researching bio layouts for the practice area, and drafting, editing and publishing the bios.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Proofread approved website copy for errors, consistency and tone.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>QA staging websites for copy, links, images, forms and formatting, and give clear written or video feedback to Operations and Web Development.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Update client privacy policies, following our SOP, and escalate any legal questions rather than making judgment calls.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>AI Video &amp; Voice Production</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Become Forward Push's internal expert for AI avatars and voices to help out our video editors whenever issues arise.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own setup, testing, troubleshooting, quality control, documentation, and staying current on new features and capabilities in both platforms.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Create and refine client avatars and voices, and support the video production team in getting the best possible output from these tools.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Reporting &amp; QA</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Review client reporting data for accuracy, unusual activity, inconsistencies, or items that need further investigation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Review and edit AI-generated report summaries so they reflect Forward Push's voice, focus on what matters, and are ready for the client-facing team.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Forward Push Marketing &amp; Sales Support</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Support Forward Push marketing priorities as assigned through Operations, including publishing, content support, and marketing asset creation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Support Sales by assembling and polishing sales decks, proposal materials, case studies, service overviews, conference materials, leave-behinds, and results visuals from existing content and direction.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Turn existing information into professional, consistent, presentation-ready materials without needing to own the sales strategy behind them.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Project &amp; Workflow Management</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Use our Project Management Software to keep assigned tasks accurate and current, and manage deadlines independently.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Proactively flag missing information, access issues, blockers, or questions to Operations before they affect a deadline.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Research unfamiliar tasks, test when appropriate, and build or improve SOPs so what you learn becomes part of the Forward Push process.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>How We Use AI</strong></p>
<p>AI is part of how we work every day. Our AI agents create much of the first-draft content, our Marketing Quality Lead reviews and improves that work, and this role uses AI across images, video, voice, research, and everyday execution.</p>
<p>Your job is not to blindly accept what an AI tool, agent, or another team member gives you. You are still responsible for the finished work. If an image is obviously wrong, a post is scheduled to the wrong account, a voice sounds unnatural, or an avatar does not represent the client well, we expect you to notice.</p>
<p>We want someone who uses AI to work faster and better without allowing it to replace thinking, judgment, or attention to detail.</p>
<p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p>
<p>Our perfect candidate for this role is someone already working at a marketing agency and doing great work, but feels limited by how much they can own, learn, influence or earn.&nbsp;</p>
<p>At Forward Push, we don’t allow that to happen to our team members. We believe in giving you ownership, autonomy, platform expertise, and responsibility. This is an environment where you decide what to do based on what’s best for the client.</p>
<p><strong>Must-Haves</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>4+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience at a marketing agency (a company that provides marketing services to multiple clients; in-house or freelance-only experience does not count).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Marketing experience across areas such as social media, local marketing, websites, content, reporting, and digital platforms.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Fluent written and spoken English (C1 or above).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong familiarity with all the following platforms and tools: Google Business Profile, Meta Business Suite, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Canva, CapCut, GoHighLevel or similar CRM, WordPress publishing and basic site setup.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience using AI tools as part of your work and the ability to learn new platforms deeply enough to become an internal resource.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Active follower of marketing and AI industry news, with the curiosity to test new tools and share what you learn.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ability to research unfamiliar marketing questions and determine whether the information you find is reliable and applicable.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong attention to detail and a willingness to perform final QA instead of assuming someone else already checked the work.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Comfort working independently while still asking questions when clarification will prevent mistakes or rework.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong organization and time management, including managing work through a project-management platform.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Willing and able to work 8:00 am to 5:00 pm. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, regardless of where you are located.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Strongly Preferred</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Familiarity with marketing reporting and analytics platforms.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with AI video and voice platforms.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience using AI image-generation tools such as Nano Banana or similar platforms.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience creating and improving marketing SOPs.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with website hosting.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Basic logo and brand design skills in Canva or Adobe tools.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Web copywriting experience, ideally with AI-assisted drafting.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with Google Ads, Meta, Ads, and Yelp advertising.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice-to-Haves</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Previous legal marketing, professional services, or other regulated-industry experience.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p>
<div>




<p>At 30 days:</p>
<p>You are successfully completing assigned client and Forward Push publishing, onboarding, and QA work accurately and on time. You keep our Project &amp; Commitments current and flag blockers early. When you encounter something unfamiliar, you research it, verify what you find, and come back with an answer or an intelligent question instead of guessing. You have created or improved missing SOPs based on your research, testing, and questions. You are learning the clients you support well enough to recognize when content, imagery, setup, or execution does not fit. You have set up at least one client website install and completed staging QA on a client site. You are producing branded image templates and finished images for your assigned clients. You have logged and researched industry updates and delivered at least one tested recommendation.</p>




</div>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<div>




<p>At 90 days:</p>
<p>You independently own the mix of client and Forward Push marketing execution assigned to you. Your commitments stay current, deadlines are met, and blockers are raised early. You are the go-to internal resource for our videos, including setup, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and quality control for client video production. You can assemble polished sales and marketing materials from existing direction, and Operations, the client-facing team, and the video team trust that when work passes through you, the details have been checked and the execution has been handled correctly. You handle website setup, staging QA, web copy support and brand asset creation for new clients with minimal rework. You are the person the team turns to for what is changing in marketing and AI, and your recommendations have changed how we work.</p>




</div>
<p><strong>How We Hire</strong></p>
<p>We do not make permanent decisions based on interviews. Qualified candidates will begin with a paid 90-day trial, where you will do real work with our team.</p>
<p>If we meet multiple qualified candidates, we may bring more than one person into the paid trial at the same time. At the end of the trial, we will make a permanent full-time offer to the person who best demonstrates the judgment, execution, communication, attention to detail, and ownership this role requires.</p>
<p>We know this is unconventional. It is also honest. You get to see exactly what the work is before committing. We get to see exactly how you perform before committing. Everyone wins.</p>
<p>Compensation is based on experience.</p>
<p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>10 days of paid time off during your first year, increasing to 15 days beginning in Year 2. PTO begins accruing immediately and may be used after your first 90 days.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Paid U.S. holidays when Forward Push is closed.&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Paid holiday shutdown from Christmas Eve through New Year’s Day, provided in addition to PTO. You are not required to use PTO during this time.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Health stipend available for U.S.-based team members.&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Professional development support, including approved books, courses, and training that help you grow your skills.&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Fully remote work with the opportunity to take on greater ownership, autonomy, and responsibility as Forward Push grows.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Small team, fast-moving company. Strong performers can move into broader marketing leadership quickly.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>How to Apply</strong><br><br>Do not send a resume as your first step.</p>
<p>Visit the provided link and complete the application. You will be asked to:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Answer a short set of qualification questions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Record a short video in English answering a few questions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Complete a practical test project.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>We are looking for people who follow instructions, notice details, and show initiative. We look forward to hearing from you!</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/forward-push-law-firm-marketing-marketing-specialist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/forward-push-law-firm-marketing-marketing-specialist</a></p>
</description>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>Position:&nbsp;</strong>Sales Account Manager - Water Solutions</p>
<p><strong>Primary Location:&nbsp;</strong>Home Based -&nbsp; Texas</p>
<p><strong>Schedule:&nbsp;</strong>Monday to Friday, necessary travel</p>
<p><strong>Reports To:&nbsp;</strong>Sales Director</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>At Chemtrade, we deliver innovative solutions focusing on safety, sustainability, and environmental stewardship. <p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About This Role and You</strong></p>
<p>The Account Manager is responsible for developing, managing, and optimizing sales of water chemicals in the Central south of United States (Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana). <p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p>

 <li>Degree in Chemistry, Engineering or Environmental Sciences with a minimum 5-10 years' of experience in chemical sales and marketing, preferably within the Water and/or Paper Industry. MBA would be considered a strong asset.</li>
 <li>Proven verbal and interpersonal communication skills </li>
 <li>Valid driver’s license is required</li>

 <li>Independently develop/implement specific account by account tactical strategy to exceed contribution/margin plan, focusing on key criteria of volume and selling price.</li>
 <li>Develop, analyze, and negotiate sales agreements at strategic accounts with input from management in order to meet corporate objectives.</li>
 <li>Answer customer’s requests regarding their operation problems related directly or indirectly to the use of our products.&nbsp;</li>

<p><strong>Communications:</strong></p>

<p><strong>Other:</strong></p>
<ul>
 <li>Proactively cooperate with operations, distribution, customer service, technical and quality functions to resolve customer issues and successfully implement business strategy.</li>
 <li>Understands all costs components which impact cost of doing business with the customer.</li>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://figure.com">https://figure.com</a>
</p>

<p><strong>About Figure</strong></p>
<p>Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.<br><br>Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&amp;P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.<br><br>We’re proud to be recognized as one of <a href="https://www.forbes.com/lists/fintech50/">Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies</a> and <a href="https://www.cnbc.com/worlds-top-fintech-companies-2026/">CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies</a>.</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>As the Licensed Partnerships Account Manager, you will be the primary point of contact for key private-label lending partners across the mortgage, banking, and fintech sectors. In this role, you will manage strategic partner relationships, track performance, and identify opportunities to expand adoption, engagement, and volume across Figure platforms. You will translate data and insights into meaningful recommendations, guide partners through initiatives and integrations, and collaborate cross-functionally to support execution, resolve issues, and drive growth. You will lead partner touchpoints, including QBRs, escalations, and roadmap discussions, while maintaining strong operational rigor and helping partners achieve measurable results.</p>
<p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Manage relationships with key private-label lending partners across mortgage, banking, and fintech</li>
<li>Track and interpret performance metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and risks</li>
<li>Collaborate with finance, legal, product, marketing, credit, and technical teams to support partner needs</li>
<li>Guide partners through integration, implementation, and ongoing adoption initiatives</li>
<li>Lead QBRs and partner discussions that clearly tie goals to measurable outcomes</li>
<li>Serve as a trusted advisor for partner leadership, providing insights and strategic recommendations</li>
<li>Support escalations and coordinate with internal teams to drive resolutions</li>
<li>Identify opportunities to increase engagement, expand use cases, and grow revenue</li>
<li>Maintain strong CRM hygiene, operational consistency, and clear partner documentation</li>
<li>Represent partnerships at events and leverage industry touchpoints to strengthen relationships</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What We Look For</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of experience in enterprise customer success, relationship management, or account management</li>
<li>High technical aptitude with the ability to learn Figure’s applications and understand mortgage-related workflows</li>
<li>Strong written and verbal communication, presentation skills, and relationship-building ability</li>
<li>Solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights</li>
<li>Proven success achieving and exceeding performance targets</li>
<li>Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail</li>
<li>Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with multiple priorities</li>
<li>Operational rigor with strong CRM discipline and dependable follow-through</li>
<li>Ability to travel up to 15%</li>
<li>Plus: experience in mortgage, blockchain, and/or fintech environments</li>
<li>Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.</li>
<li>Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.</li>
<li>Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Salary</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Base Compensation Range: $96,400 - $144,600/yr</li>
<li>30% variable</li>
<li>Company equity in the form of RSUs</li>
</ul>
<p>This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans</li>
<li>Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits</li>
<li>Employer-paid life and disability insurance</li>
<li>11 observed holidays and PTO plan</li>
<li>Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave</li>
<li>Continuing education reimbursement</li>
</ul>
<p>Depending on your residential location certain laws might regulate the way Figure manages applicant data. California Residents, please review our <a href="https://www.figure.com/ca-employee-privacy-notice/">California Employee</a> and <a href="https://www.figure.com/workforce-privacy-notice/">General Workforce Privacy Notice</a> for further information.&nbsp;By submitting your application, you are agreeing and&nbsp;acknowledging&nbsp;that you have read and understand the above notice.</p>
<p>Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.</p>

<p>

<h1><strong>Sales Development Representative, Permanent Placement&nbsp;</strong></h1>
<p><strong>Location:</strong> Remote | Hybrid | Onsite – Dallas, TX</p>
<h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2>
<p>The Sales Development team is a driving force behind Doximity’s growth. We’re on a mission to connect healthcare professionals in smarter ways, and this team plays a key role in making that happen. Sales Development helps us identify new opportunities, expand our reach with existing clients, and create meaningful connections that set our sales teams up for success.</p>
<p>In this role, you’ll take ownership of a determined geography “territory”, researching accounts, identifying key decision-makers, and engaging them through multiple channels to introduce Doximity’s solutions.</p>
<p>We’re looking for individuals who are passionate about sales and eager to grow. This role is a launchpad into a full-cycle Business Development position, providing you with the skills, experience, and mentorship to thrive.</p>
<p><strong><em>Location: This role is in person filled in our Dallas, Texas headquarters or remote U.S. location</em></strong></p>
<h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2>
<p>We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications:</p>
<ul>
<li>1 year of prior relevant experience required.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Integrity, coachability, and a sense of urgency&nbsp;</li>
<li>Strong communication skills and ability to articulate our value proposition&nbsp;</li>
<li>Excellent organization skills and the ability to manage hundreds of accounts and contacts</li>
<li>Experience and success with cold-calling/prospecting; understanding of what it’s like to have a monthly quota.</li>
<li>Someone with a growth mindset who wants to learn and develop professionally</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>How you’ll make an impact:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Prospect via phone, email &amp; social media focusing on both our largest existing customers and new prospects</li>
<li>Partner with Business Development team members to create strategies to land and expand accounts</li>
<li>Become a subject matter expert on Doximity’s suite of Talent Solutions Offerings</li>
<li>Leverage tools such as Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Outreach, LinkedIn &amp; more</li>
<li>Manage your activity and metrics to drive decision-making</li>
<li>Consistently achieve quota&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Growth Opportunities:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>The SDR role provides a clear path to a Permanent Placement -&nbsp; Business Development Role.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Compensation</strong></h2>
<p>The anticipated total compensation for this role is <strong>$85,000-$95,000</strong>, depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.</p>
<p>Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.</p>
<h2><strong>Benefits</strong></h2>
<p>In addition to competitive compensation, Curative offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance</li>
<li>401(k) with company match</li>
<li>Paid time off and company holidays</li>
<li>Paid parental leave</li>
<li>Wellness and mental health resources</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Why You'll Love Working Here</strong></h2>
<p>At Curative, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Make a real impact.</strong> Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.</li>
<li><strong>Work with exceptional teammates.</strong> Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.</li>
<li><strong>Enjoy flexibility and trust.</strong> We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.</li>
<li><strong>Grow your career.</strong> Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.</li>
<li><strong>Bring your authentic self.</strong> We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>About Doximity Talent Solutions | Curative&nbsp;</strong></h2>
<p>Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We are excited to introduce Doximity Talent Solutions, where Curative, Doximity’s recruiting team, joins Doximity Talent Finder, our best-in-class sourcing tool, to support all of our client’s recruitment and hiring needs in one place with a full suite of offerings. Doximity Talent Solutions offers hospitals and health systems a comprehensive product suite that includes best-in-class sourcing, full-service placement – locums, clinical and executive search – and advanced advertising options targeting engaged clinician audiences. It’s a range of products that no other company can offer.</p>
<h2><strong>Our Hiring Process &amp; AI Tools</strong></h2>
<p>Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.</p>
<h2><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity</strong></h2>
<p><em>Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</em></p>
<p><em>If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.</em></p>
