<p><br><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Partner with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers on strategic enterprise opportunities involving AI architecture, governance, integrations, and complex technical requirements.</li>
<li>Lead executive-level discovery, AI strategy discussions, architecture assessments, and technical design workshops with CIO, CTO, AI council, security, data, and enterprise architecture stakeholders.</li>
<li>Understand customers' AI ambitions, business objectives, technology stack, data environment, security requirements, governance models, integration landscape, and revenue workflows.</li>
<li>Architect how Gong can be used within and alongside a customer's AI ecosystem, including through Gong APIs, MCP, Gong Assistant, Deep Research, integrations, and workflow automation.</li>
<li>Advise customers on practical AI use cases that improve revenue-team productivity, effectiveness, and operational efficiency, including responsible adoption and effective credit usage.</li>
<li>Show thought leadership on AI architectures and guide customers on best practices for using Gong data and capabilities in AI-enabled and vibe-coded applications.</li>
<li>Assess customer requirements around data governance, data residency, identity and access management, agent permissions, auditability, human-in-the-loop controls, agent guardrails, and enterprise AI risk.</li>
<li>Develop financially rigorous AI value hypotheses and technical validation plans that help customers assess build-versus-buy choices, total cost of ownership, adoption economics, and measurable ROI.</li>
<li>Position Gong credibly within customers' existing AI ecosystems, including Salesforce, Microsoft, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, and enterprise governance tooling; articulate both better-together integration patterns and clear product boundaries.</li>
<li>Create and present customer-specific AI reference architectures, integration patterns, technical roadmaps, validation plans, risk registers, and implementation recommendations.</li>
<li>Act as the senior technical voice in complex pursuits, including executive presentations, security and architecture reviews, RFPs, proofs of concept, and technical win plans.</li>
<li>Translate complex AI concepts, technical tradeoffs, and product boundaries into clear business value for executive and technical audiences.</li>
<li>Partner with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Professional Services, Support, and Customer Success to ensure customer requirements are represented and solution designs are feasible to implement and operate.</li>
<li>Develop reusable field assets, including AI discovery frameworks, CIO architecture narratives, governance guidance, integration patterns, demo narratives, and objection-handling materials.</li>
<li>Enable Solutions Engineers and account teams on AI positioning, enterprise AI conversations, advanced solution design, CIO persona engagement, and complex-deal execution.</li>
<li>Bring structured market feedback to Product and Engineering, identifying recurring enterprise governance, observability, compliance, control, and adoption requirements.</li>
<li>Serve as a competitive expert capable of representing Gong versus other vendors’ AI offerings. Contribute knowledge and content to Gong’s competitive team.</li>
</ul>
<h4>QUALIFICATIONS&nbsp;</h4>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, sales engineering, consulting, AI strategy, or a comparable customer-facing technical leadership role.</li>
<li>Experience working with large, complex enterprises and engaging CIOs, CTOs, Chief AI Officers, enterprise architects, security leaders, data leaders, and executive stakeholders.</li>
<li>Demonstrated expertise in generative AI, large language models, AI agents, MCP, APIs, integrations, data flows, vibe coding, and enterprise software architecture.</li>
<li>Practical familiarity with leading AI platforms and ecosystems, such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Google Vertex, Salesforce, Microsoft, and related enterprise AI technologies.</li>
<li>Experience discussing AI governance, responsible AI, data privacy, identity and access management, security, compliance, observability, auditability, and enterprise deployment considerations.</li>
<li>Proven ability to lead architecture workshops and translate ambiguous business needs into clear, executable technical designs.</li>
<li>Experience advancing complex enterprise opportunities through technical discovery, security reviews, RFPs, pilots, and proofs of concept.</li>
<li>Strong executive communication, influence, and storytelling skills, with the ability to move comfortably between C-suite conversations and detailed technical design.</li>
<li>Ability to translate AI capabilities into practical, measurable outcomes for revenue organizations.</li>
<li>Strong collaboration skills and a demonstrated ability to enable and scale the impact of a broader technical field organization.</li>
</ul>
<h4>WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE</h4>
<ul>
<li>Strategic customers view Gong as a governed, enterprise-ready component of their AI strategy, not solely a sales productivity application.</li>
<li>CIOs and AI leaders understand how Gong supports their architecture, governance, security, integration, and value-realization priorities.</li>
<li>Account teams can confidently navigate sophisticated AI, architecture, governance, and integration conversations, including mixed-vendor environments.</li>
<li>Complex technical risks are identified early and addressed with clear, practical solution designs and validation plans.</li>
<li>Customers have a credible plan for deploying Gong AI in alignment with security, governance, integration, and compliance requirements.</li>
<li>Account teams can quantify the value, cost, and risk tradeoffs of Gong AI relative to internal development or broader platform alternatives.</li>
<li>The SE organization becomes more capable of positioning Gong in AI-led opportunities through your enablement and reusable assets.</li>
<li>Field insights meaningfully influence Gong's product strategy, enterprise readiness, messaging, and go-to-market execution.</li>
<li>Your work accelerates strategic opportunities, improves customer confidence, and helps revenue organizations realize greater value from Gong.</li>
</ul>
<h4>PERKS &amp; BENEFITS&nbsp;</h4>
<ul>
<li>We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs.</li>
<li>Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle.</li>
<li>Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching.</li>
<li>401(k) program to help you invest in your future.</li>
<li>Education &amp; learning stipend for personal growth and development.</li>
<li>Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend.</li>
<li>Paid parental leave to support you and your family.</li>
<li>Company-wide recharge days each quarter.</li>
<li>Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>The annual OTE for this position is $174,000 - $250,000 USD.&nbsp; </strong></p>
<p>Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect.</p>
<p><strong>We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Gong recruiting email communications will always come from the @gong.io domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Gong via other sources should be ignored.</strong></p>
<hr>

We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.</em></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote Central US
</p>

<p><em>About the Team &amp; Role</em></p>
<p>Rubrik's Product Line Sales organization drives focused growth across Rubrik's specialized workloads, including our Unstructured data protection and security portfolio. This team partners closely with core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success to bring deep product and technical expertise into every Unstructured opportunity — from first conversation through technical validation to close.</p>
<p>We're hiring an NCD Product Line Sales Specialist to own and accelerate Rubrik's Unstructured data protection business within a defined territory. This is a highly technical, quota-carrying overlay role: you'll be the subject-matter expert who can go deep on NAS storage architectures, file-generating applications, backup and recovery mechanics, and the security behind protecting these growing assets — and use that fluency to win deals against competitive point solutions. The ideal candidate has sold in this exact space before, at a company like NetApp, Dell, Qumulo, Vast, EverPure, Komprise, Superna, etc.</p>
<p><em>What You’ll Do</em></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own the NCD product line number: </strong>partner with core Account Executives to identify, qualify, and close NCD data protection and security opportunities across net-new and existing accounts.</li>
<li><strong>Lead with technical credibility: </strong>articulate Rubrik’s NCD architecture, security posture, and the gaps in storage native shared snapshot protection in a way that resonates with both technical and business buyers.</li>
<li><strong>Drive technical discovery and validation: </strong>run or co-lead discovery calls, demos, and proof-of-concept engagements for NCD.</li>
<li><strong>Win competitive deals: </strong>build and defend positioning against competition or "do-nothing", translating technical differentiation into business value.</li>
<li><strong>Build territory and account plans: </strong>develop a coverage strategy in partnership with core sales, SE, and channel teams to maximize NCD attach and expansion within the install base.</li>
<li><strong>Engage multiple stakeholders: </strong>present to IT administrators, security and compliance teams, and executive economic buyers, tailoring the message to each audience.</li>
<li><strong>Forecast with discipline: </strong>maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in Salesforce and participate in regular business reviews.</li>
<li><strong>Stay current: </strong>maintain deep knowledge of Rubrik’s NCD roadmap, storage ecosystems, and the competitive landscape.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Experience You’ll Need</em></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Storage sales experience: </strong>3+ years of quota-carrying sales experience selling storage infrastructure (file preferred) with a deep understanding of these technologies.</li>
<li><strong>Directly relevant background: </strong>experience at a NAS or file storage vendor such as NetApp, Dell, Qumulo, or VAST (or a comparable company like Komprise, Superna, or EverPure) is strongly preferred.</li>
<li><strong>Genuine technical depth: </strong>comfortable discussing NAS architectures (NetApp ONTAP, Dell PowerScale/Isilon, Qumulo, VAST), SMB/NFS protocols, snapshots and replication, file-generating applications, and ransomware and compliance requirements for unstructured data without relying solely on a Sales Engineer.</li>
<li><strong>Proven technical selling motion: </strong>a track record of running or co-leading technical discovery, sizing, and proof-of-concept engagements for storage or data protection solutions, not just handing off to a technical resource.</li>
<li><strong>Consultative approach: </strong>comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across storage and infrastructure teams, security, and executive buyers in mid-market and enterprise accounts.</li>
<li><strong>Overlay/specialist experience: </strong>prior success working in a platform-selling model alongside core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success.</li>
<li><strong>Track record: </strong>consistent history of quota attainment and strong pipeline generation.</li>
<li><strong>Education: </strong>bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Preferred Qualifications</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Hands-on familiarity with enterprise NAS platforms, data management or tiering tools, and backup and recovery workflows for large unstructured data sets.</li>
<li>Experience selling a data security or resiliency platform that spans on-premises, cloud, and SaaS workloads.</li>
<li>Existing relationships with storage, infrastructure, security, or compliance buyers in target accounts.</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-DNI</p>

<p>Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.</p>

<p>Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.</p>

      <title>Abnormal: AI Security Sales Executive, North Central</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - USA
</p>

<p><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></p>
<p>AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.</p>
<p>The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it.</p>
<p>The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close.</li>
<li>Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation.</li>
<li>Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume.</li>
<li>Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most.</li>
<li>Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch.</li>
<li>Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.</li>
<li>Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&amp;D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA.</li>
<li>Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing.</li>
<li>Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL SELL</strong></p>
<p>Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:</p>
<ul>
<li>AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.</li>
<li>AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.</li>
<li>AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.</li>
<li>AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.</li>

<div>
<div>
<h1>6sense Product Marketing</h1>
<h2>Principal Competitive Intelligence Manager</h2>
<h3>Competitive Intelligence &amp; Win/Loss</h3>
<p><strong>Team:</strong> Product Marketing<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> VP, Product Marketing<br><strong>Level:</strong> Principal&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<h2>About the Role</h2>
<p>The market we compete in is being redrawn in real time. Point data providers are moving up the stack. Workflow and enrichment tools are repositioning as operating systems. Buyers are assembling their own stacks from components that used to be bought as a platform. Knowing what each competitor shipped last quarter is table stakes — the job is understanding what the pattern means and what we should do about it.</p>
<p>This role owns competitive intelligence and win/loss for 6sense. It sits on the Product Marketing team and exists so that our positioning, our roadmap conversations and our field enablement are built on evidence rather than assumption. You will be the person the company turns to when there is a disagreement about why we win, why we lose, and who we are actually competing against.</p>
<p>This is a senior individual contributor seat. The work is research, synthesis and judgment — and the willingness to tell the company something it would rather not hear, with the evidence to back it up.</p>
<hr>
<h2>What You'll Own</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>The win/loss program, end to end.</strong> Interviews, coding, synthesis and the readouts that go to product and executive leadership. Not administering a program — making it the thing people trust when they disagree.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Competitive positioning and differentiation.</strong> The evidence behind our claims about where we are stronger, and the honesty about where we are not. You partner with the pillar PMMs so competitive insight shapes positioning rather than trailing it.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Structural market analysis.</strong> How buyers are assembling their stacks, where substitution is happening, which categories are converging, and what that means for us eighteen months out.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Field enablement for competitive situations.</strong> Battlecards, objection handling, trap-setting questions and talk tracks that hold up in a live deal rather than in a deck.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Claims discipline for competitive material.</strong> Sourcing every competitive number we put in front of a customer, and saying no to the ones we cannot stand behind.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Competitive monitoring and alerting,</strong> including ownership of the tooling and of what reaches the field versus what stays internal.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Input to roadmap, pricing and packaging, and analyst relations.</strong> Competitive evidence should shape what we build and how we price, not only how we sell.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2>What You'll Bring</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>8+ years in competitive intelligence, product marketing or research-heavy go-to-market roles in B2B SaaS.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Hands-on win/loss experience.</strong> Designing the program, running the interviews and coding the results — not reading someone else's summary.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>The ability to run primary research and be honest about what the data does and does not support. Small samples are useful; presenting them as more than they are is not.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Strong synthesis and writing.</strong> An executive should be able to read your analysis and know what to do differently.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Comfort presenting uncomfortable findings to product and executive audiences, and holding them under pushback.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Fluency with the B2B SaaS buyer, ideally in martech, RevTech, sales intelligence or data platforms.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Working knowledge of AI and agentic tooling — enough to evaluate what a competitor has actually shipped versus announced.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2>Nice to Have</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Experience with competitive intelligence and research tooling (Klue, Gong, Dovetail or equivalent).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Analyst relations exposure with Gartner or Forrester.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Background in or adjacent to ABM, intent data, GTM intelligence or revenue platforms.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience building a competitive intelligence function rather than inheriting one.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2>What Success Looks Like</h2>
<p>In your first 6–12 months, win/loss is a program leaders act on rather than a report they receive; we know with evidence why we win and lose, by competitor and by segment; the field has competitive material that holds up in a live deal; and every competitive claim we make in market has a source behind it.</p>
<hr>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p>Base Salary Range: $145,503.00 - $213,404.40. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote</p>
<p><span>Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: <a href="https://6sense.com/california-recruitment-privacy-notice/">California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy</a></span></p>
</div>
<div>
<p><strong><span>Our Benefits:</span></strong><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.</span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><span>6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to </span><span><a href="mailto:jobs@6sense.com">jobs@6sense.com</a><a href="mailto:jobs@6sense.com">.</a></span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>

      <title>Bybit: Business Development Assistant</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Europe - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Us</strong></p>
<div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-XCikdRR2xoZIjdxtCKcuOflrs8d">Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-IF06dI0MPoBwYfxbZ4zui13HsoC">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-X5EbdOwvMoYuOmxQBbuueUEDsDd">Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-LtVud2dO7oglqJxxZoOucqjJsPc">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-RMHkdm4bPo66l3xMVO8ui1o8sle">Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.</div>
</div></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p><strong>*Pls kindly note this role has no base salary, it's commission based</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for a internationally minded Regional Business Development Specialist to drive the expansion of Bybit’s payments ecosystem across EU and emerging global corridors. This role will focus on community building, merchant acquisition, local payment partnerships, and strategic growth initiatives for Bybit Pay, Card, and Fiat channels.</p>
<p>The ideal candidate has deep experience in payments, fintech, or crypto, strong local market understanding, and a proven track record of driving regional growth.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Support market expansion for Bybit Pay across EU, building and owning the full growth pipeline</li>
<li>Acquire and manage merchants, payment gateways, fintech partners, Web3 projects, community leaders, and other growth channels.</li>
<li>Drive the end-to-end BD cycle: market mapping, lead generation, pitching, negotiation, and partnership execution.</li>
<li>Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Card, Fiat Channels, Compliance, Payments Ops, Marketing) to activate and scale payment use cases.</li>
<li>Develop regional GTM strategies and identify high-potential payment corridors for crypto-to-fiat and fiat-to-crypto flows.</li>
<li>Support cross-border payment products, including settlement channels, payout solutions, and merchant integrations.</li>
<li>Provide market intelligence, partner feedback, and competitive analysis to optimize product direction.</li>
<li>Represent Bybit in industry events, conferences, and ecosystem partnerships.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>1+ years of experience in payments / fintech / PSP / acquiring / merchant growth / crypto BD.</li>
<li>Long-term overseas work or study experience (must-have).</li>
<li>Strong understanding of local payment rails, fiat/crypto conversion flows, card programs, and merchant needs.</li>
<li>Demonstrated success in driving regional growth or launching payment products in multiple markets.</li>
<li>Ability to work independently and thrive in fast-paced, high-ownership environments.</li>
<li>Native local language proficiency + strong English communication skills.</li>
<li>Network across fintech, Web3, PSPs, acquirers, or merchant ecosystems is highly preferred.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements for payments and cross-border movement.</li>
<li>Background working in global remote teams.</li>
<li>Prior experience with crypto exchanges, payment gateways, or card programs.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why Join Us</strong><br>At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.&nbsp;<br>Our benefits include:<br>- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.<br>- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.<br>- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.<br>- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.<br>- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-business-development-assistant">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-business-development-assistant</a></p>

      <title>Legion: Sales Development Representative - Strategics</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, United States
</p>

<h1>Sales Development Representative, Strategic Accounts</h1>
<h2>Remote, United States</h2>
<p><strong>ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITY</strong></p>
<p>The mission of the Sales Development Representative is to expand Legion’s business by actively prospecting into accounts and sharing the exceptional value our platform delivers. We are looking for someone with passion, drive, and strong business acumen to drive business for our growing Sales team while developing sales skills and accelerating the growth of an exciting company that enables the future of work for the 2.7 billion-person strong deskless workforce.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The most critical deliverables include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Achieving monthly/quarterly quotas of leads sourced, meetings scheduled, and opportunities generated</li>
<li>Pursuing marketing and partner-generated leads to qualify and schedule meetings for the sales team</li>
<li>Partnering with the Marketing team to drive attendance to virtual and in person events</li>
<li>Communicating Legion’s unique value proposition to prospects and maintaining strong product knowledge</li>
<li>Researching and identifying key contacts and actively calling and emailing prospects</li>
<li>Maintaining accurate lead and activity history in Salesforce CRM</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>PROFESSIONAL BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2 years of sales development prospecting experience for Saas company</li>
<li>Comfortable prospecting, cold calling, and overcoming objections</li>
<li>Superior verbal and written communication skills</li>
<li>Experience working with organizations over 5,000 employees</li>
<li>Experience using modern sales tech stack: Salesforce, MixMax, Outreach, Sales Navigator, Zoom, Sendoso</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES AND VALUES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Highly motivated self-starter with a hunter mentality and growth mindset</li>
<li>Great collaborator with team mentality</li>
<li>Desire to continue to learn and improve in role</li>
<li>Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence</li>
<li>Exceptional time management and organizational skills</li>
<li>Continuous and thoughtful listener, ability to learn from prospects and leverage input</li>
<li>Unquestionable integrity, credibility, and character; demonstrated high moral and ethical behavior</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>COMPENSATION &amp; BENEFITS</strong></p>
<p><em>Salary Range: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 + Bonus + </em><em>Stock Equity</em></p>
<p>At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Benefits include, but are not limited to:</p>
<ul>
<li>$0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment</li>
<li>401k plan</li>
<li>Unlimited Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays</li>
<li>Parental Leave&nbsp;</li>
<li>Equity&nbsp;</li>
<li>Monthly Wellness Reimbursement</li>
<li>Monthly Lunch on Legion</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>ABOUT LEGION</strong></h2>
<p>Legion is on a mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, and we’re looking for best-in-class talent to drive this mission.Legion is a fully remote, mission-driven company focused on turning hourly jobs into good jobs. It’s a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and fast-paced culture. You’ll have the opportunity to learn, interact directly with seasoned product executives, grow your skills, and enhance your career while helping solve important problems and achieve Legion’s mission.&nbsp;Our industry-leading, intelligent automation is powered by Legion’s Workforce Management (WFM) platform, which maximizes labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously . In a recent Forrester Total Economic&nbsp;Impact study, Legion WFM was proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion has been recognized for its innovative, modern approach to transforming workforce management – Inc. 5000 fastest-growing private companies in America, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, JMP Securities’ Hot 100 List of the Best Privately Held Software Companies, recognized for its industry leading AI technology by with back to back AI Breakthrough and Artificial Intellegence awards, and named a Gartner Cool Vendor. Legion is backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures.</p>
<h3><strong>BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p>There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig-economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees.The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options.Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously.&nbsp;Legion WFM was built for the cloud, designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses, and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.&nbsp;Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.For more information, visit&nbsp;<a href="https://legion.co">https://legion.co</a>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY</strong></h3>
<p>Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.</p>
<h3><strong>DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION</strong></h3>
<p>For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email <a href="mailto:recruiting@legion.co">recruiting@legion.co</a>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span><em>Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.</em></span></p>
<h2>How We Determine What We Pay</h2>
<p><em>As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.</em></p>
<h1>Job Applicant Privacy Policy</h1>
<p>This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“<strong>Policy</strong>”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“<strong>Legion</strong>”, “<strong>we</strong>”, “<strong>us</strong>” and “<strong>our</strong>”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.</p>
<p>This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the&nbsp;<a href="https://legion.co/privacy-policy/">Legion Privacy Policy</a>&nbsp;applies.</p>
<div class="section-anchor position-relative"></div>
<ol class="ol-bold">
<li>
<p><strong>Types of Personal Information We Handle</strong></p>
<p>We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Identification and contact information, and related identifiers</strong>&nbsp;such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts.</li>

</ul>
</li>

<p>We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.</p>

      <title>Samsara: Account Executive, Mid Market (Northeast)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - MA; Remote - RI
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p>
<p><span>Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.&nbsp;</p>
<div class="c-virtual_list__item">
<div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message">
<div class="c-message_kit__hover">
<div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default">
<div class="c-message_kit__gutter">
<div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right">
<div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text">
<div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer">

      <title>Abnormal: AI Security Sales Executive</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - UK
</p>

<p><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></p>
<p>AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.</p>
<p>The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it.</p>
<p>The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close.</li>
<li>Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation.</li>
<li>Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume.</li>
<li>Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most.</li>
<li>Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch.</li>
<li>Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.</li>
<li>Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&amp;D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA.</li>
<li>Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing.</li>
<li>Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL SELL</strong></p>
<p>Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:</p>
<ul>
<li>AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.</li>
<li>AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.</li>
<li>AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.</li>
<li>AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.</li>
<li>AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW</strong></p>
<p>Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open.</p>
<p>For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of personal quota attainment and winning new business.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience selling an AI product, with enough technical and product depth to run the sales cycle as the expert and give our product team credible feedback.</li>
<li>A record of selling in security or closely adjacent infrastructure.</li>
<li>Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers.</li>
<li>A consultative, challenger style, paired with the hunter instincts to run strategic outbound into new logos.</li>
<li>Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on.</li>
<li>Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>NICE TO HAVES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories.</li>
<li>Experience as an early seller or builder of a new motion: a first sales hire, a founding seller, or a new product line launched inside a larger company.</li>
<li>Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders.</li>
<li>Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals.</li>
</ul>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. <p><span>Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.&nbsp;</p>
<p>On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our French EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from France and the United Kingdom.</p>

<li><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong>Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong>&nbsp;</h4>

<li>Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling</li>

</ul>
<p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p>

<li>1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles</li>
<li>6-12 months sales experience as a minimum</li>
<li>Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales</li>
<li>Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills, verbal and written</li>
<li>Curious and able to ask insightful questions</li>
<li>A champion of a Growth Mindset</li>
<li>Highly proficient in English and fluent in French</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p>

<li>Experience in closing-sales roles</li>
<li>Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)</li>
<li>Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment</li>
<li>Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways</li>
<li>Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space</li>

<p>Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>The next level in the program is <strong>ADR II</strong>, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. <p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.</p>
<p>Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU</strong></p>
<p>You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:</p>
<ul>
<li>Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)</li>
<li>Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding</li>
<li>Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays</li>
<li>Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material</li>
<li>The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers</li>
<li>As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules</li>
<li>An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals</li>
</ul></div><h3><strong>JOB SUMMARY</strong></h3>
<p>We're looking for a Senior Content Marketing Specialist to shape and create impactful, thought-leadership led content across our 6 monthly brand campaign cycles, plus additional ICP tracks as needed, while owning customer advocacy content - e.g. case studies. The right candidate understands what makes great B2B marketing content, is AI-native, takes initiative in a fast-paced scale up environment, and brings a data-driven mindset to connect strategy with business results.&nbsp;This person will sit within Storyblok's Brand and Communications team, supporting marketing across the buyer journey, driving case study development, and partnering with field marketing, social, and events on content needs. They'll also help build and launch a new UGC programme and support executive communications on LinkedIn.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>&nbsp;ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS</strong></h3>
<p><strong>Content strategy</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Shape and execute content creation efforts within the Brand and Communications Team, from long-form whitepapers and blog posts to short-form landing pages and other supporting assets that require content support</li>
<li>Generate creative, storytelling-focused content ideas that produce engaging thought leadership, staying abreast of B2B social trends and thinking beyond the 'usual' types of content</li>
<li>Support aligning content marketing efforts with the wider Brand and Communications team functions, including PR, company social media, and executive communications via LinkedIn</li>
<li>Conduct in-depth keyword research using tools like Ahrefs and/or Semrush to identify relevant topics and keyword groups for Storyblok content</li>
<li>Briefing videographers and motion graphics experts to create videos for campaign tracks, events, social to name a few</li>
<li>Optimisation and monitoring of content health of all Storyblok content via the website</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Customer advocacy</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Ownership of the case study content process, from initial ideation and customer contact, to creation and publication of the assets</li>
<li>Optimisation and monitoring of all case study pages on Storyblok's website</li>
<li>Ensuring consistent quality across all case study pages by updating older case studies and coordinating with the Partner and/or Customer Success team</li>
<li>Planning measurable outreach strategies to garner more customer success stories in response to business requirements</li>
<li>Defining and tracking precise KPIs for all case study efforts</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE</strong></h3>
<p>Must haves</p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years’ experience in content marketing or content strategy</li>
<li>Knowledge of SEO best practices and familiarity with on-page and off-page SEO tactics</li>
<li>Tech industry marketing experience</li>
<li>Content reporting experience including analysing data and making recommendations</li>
</ul>
<p>Nice to haves</p>
<ul>
<li>Content marketing experience in a B2B tech scale up environment</li>
<li>Experience developing and executing UGC programmes, particularly in B2B/tech settings</li>
<li>Experience in a Brand and Communications team/similar with an integrated content function, having worked with PR and social media teams</li>
<li>Demonstrable experience building content marketing support agents via the likes of Claude - e.g. to automate processes</li>
<li>Experience working on event content</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;<strong>PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Highly organised, reliable, and self-driven in fast-moving ambiguous environments</li>
<li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills</li>
<li>Impeccable creative writing skills</li>
<li>Skilled at managing multiple projects simultaneously</li>
<li>Ability to follow editorial governance to ensure content is consistent with Storyblok’s brand voice, style, and tone</li>
<li>Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS</strong></p>
<p><span>Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space</span></p>

We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain (<a class="c-link" href="http://storyblok.com/">storyblok.com</a>).</p>

      <title>Collibra: Senior Account Executive II, Federal DOW/Army/Navy/Air Force/Pentagon</title>

      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, USA
</p>

<h3><strong>Joining Collibra’s Public Sector team</strong></h3>
<p>Make an impact at Collibra Public Sector by driving growth in US federal DOW agencies.&nbsp; This role will be responsible for selling Collibra's value and vision to prospects and existing customers, offering a complete solution that includes software, support and services.&nbsp; As part of our federal sales team, you will manage some of Collibra’s largest accounts.&nbsp; You will use your knowledge and skills in enterprise sales to establish trusted and credible relationships, build Collibra’s brand and awareness around our solutions, and serve as a data intelligence advisor throughout the customer journey.&nbsp; You will be actively involved in the entire sales cycle creating initial demand, progressing the opportunity through the technical and financial decision process, and ensuring adoption and expansion after the sale.&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>Collibra Public Sector Account Executive II, Federal at Collibra are responsible for</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years in a technical customer facing role, ideally supporting Enterprise Class customers in an SaaS environment.</li>
<li>Experience in Technical Account Management, Support or similar type of Premium or Signature Service organization dealing with Enterprise Software Application Support.</li>
<li>Experience troubleshooting web-based applications.</li>
<li>Experience with Java, REST API and SSO and a working knowledge of kubernetes, with VM, SQL, SSL, SSO, and LDAP a plus.</li>
<li>Experience and a strong interest in developing deep customer relationships while facilitating discussions about enterprise IT architecture.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>You have</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Consistently exceeded assigned sales quotas.</li>
<li>Experience in the data storage or data management software industry.</li>
<li>7 + years experience calling on federal defense accounts in a field sales capacity.</li>
<li>Prior relationships with Departments of Defense/War, Army, Fourth Estate.</li>
<li>Originated and closed complex sales with multiple technical and business stakeholders.</li>
<li>Managed consultative sales processes, with value-based impacts or outcomes.</li>
<li>A bachelor’s degree or equivalent related working experience.</li>
<li>US citizenship (required) and active security clearance (preferred).</li>
<li>Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.</li>
<li>Because this role supports the US government, it is required that this candidate be a US citizen who resides on US soil.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>You are</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Known for your integrity, and commitment to the customer.</li>
<li>Detail and results oriented – you work backwards from a goal using documented plans.</li>
<li>Composed, resourceful, and comfortable in high-growth high-expectation environments.</li>
<li>Adaptive, accountable, and execution-oriented.</li>
<li>A concise communicator, persuasive negotiator, collaborative seller.</li>
<li>Proud of your work and aim for excellence.</li>
<li>Flexible to travel as required.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Measures of success</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Within your first month, you will have completed onboarding, connected with your team members as well as with your functional peers.</li>
<li>Within your third month, you will be building a pipeline of business in your assigned territory.</li>
<li>Within your sixth month, you will have solid foundation of prospective clients who you will be close to closing.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Compensation for this role</strong></h3>
<p>The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $175,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.</p>
<p>In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Benefits at Collibra</h3>
<p>Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about <a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/benefits">Collibra’s benefits</a>.</p>
<p>We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about&nbsp;<a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/dei">diversity, equity, and inclusion</a> at Collibra.</p>
<p>At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.</p>
<p>With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/accommodations">Accommodations for Applicants form</a>.</p></div>

      <title>Descript: Head of Enterprise Marketing</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA or Remote, US 
</p>

<h3><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></h3>
<p>Descript is at an inflection point. We have 50M+ users, genuine product-market fit, and a real opportunity to move upmarket—converting high-fit self-serve users into consolidated enterprise contracts and going after the accounts that belong in our pipeline. As Head of Enterprise Marketing, you'll own that motion end-to-end.</p>
<p>This is a builder role for someone who's done it before: someone who can meticulously understand what's driving inbound interest, identify which accounts to go after and why, and design the campaigns, lifecycle plays, and conversion experiments to bring them in. You'll co-own upmarket pipeline with Sales, partner with Product on the self-serve-to-enterprise conversion motion, and partner with our in-house Growth/Paid team and RevOps to make sure the whole system is instrumented and accountable.</p>
<p>The raw materials are here—a passionate user community, a strong product, and a large market. This hire shapes what we do with them upmarket.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></h3>
<p>Pipeline Strategy &amp; Execution</p>
<ul>
<li>Co-own upmarket pipeline targets with Sales, with shared accountability for sourced and influenced pipeline</li>
<li>Build and execute an enterprise demand playbook: ICP definition, target account selection, channel mix, offer strategy, and campaign design and execution</li>
<li>Develop a vertical prioritization framework: define which industries and enterprise segments to pursue, in what order, and with what message</li>
<li>Design account-based programs with messaging and experiences calibrated to high-fit accounts</li>
<li>Own and maintain an annual marketing calendar that aligns campaign activity to business milestones, seasonal growth opportunities, and pipeline targets</li>
<li>Source and manage contract and agency resources as needed</li>
</ul>
<p>Self-Serve to Enterprise Conversion</p>
<ul>
<li>Partner with Product and Sales to identify high-fit self-serve buyers and design conversion experiments that move them toward consolidated contracts</li>
<li>Build lifecycle plays that nurture individual users into team and enterprise buyers</li>
<li>Develop and iterate on the plays, offers, and sequences that convert product-qualified accounts into pipeline</li>
</ul>
<p>Performance &amp; Measurement</p>
<ul>
<li>Meticulously track which channels, plays, and offers are driving inbound interest and conversions, and use that intelligence to sharpen programs continuously</li>
<li>Build AI-first marketing ops and measurement frameworks that give the team real visibility into what's working</li>
<li>Report regularly on pipeline contribution, channel efficiency, and program performance</li>
</ul>
<p>Sales &amp; Cross-functional Partnership</p>
<ul>
<li>Partner daily with Sales on account priorities, ABM strategy, and pipeline reviews</li>
<li>Brief and align with the in-house paid advertising team on enterprise-targeted campaigns</li>
<li>Co-own enterprise lifecycle with RevOps, ensuring accountability is clear and programs are coordinated</li>
<li>Own the strategy for high-touch deal acceleration programs—things like executive roundtables and leadership-level events—partnering with Field Marketing on execution</li>
<li>Contribute to enterprise pricing and packaging strategy alongside Product and Sales, with an eye toward what moves deals forward and expands accounts</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>WHAT YOU BRING</strong></h3>
<p>Minimum Qualifications</p>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 3 years building or scaling an upmarket or enterprise demand motion</li>
<li>Experience at a PLG or product-led company—you understand the self-serve-to-enterprise conversion motion and have driven it</li>
<li>Consumer-to-B2B crossover experience; you know how to market to users who are also buyers</li>
<li>Strong analytical skills and a track record of building measurement frameworks that actually get used</li>
<li>Experience co-owning pipeline targets with Sales in an accountable, collaborative way</li>
</ul>
<p>Preferred Qualifications</p>
<ul>
<li>Deep familiarity with modern ABM tooling and CRM/MAP integration</li>
<li>Experience building, or deeply partnering with, AI-native marketing ops and workflows</li>
<li>Background in SaaS, media tech, or creative tooling</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to design and run conversion experiments across PLG funnels</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><br><br></strong></p>
<h3><strong>SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE</strong></h3>
<p>Within your first 12 months, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Launch Descript's enterprise demand motion, with a defined ICP, target account list, vertical prioritization framework, and multi-channel playbook</li>
<li>Co-own and hit upmarket pipeline targets in partnership with Sales</li>
<li>Build upon the existing self-serve-to-enterprise conversion experiments with Product, with measurable account progression</li>
<li>Build a measurement framework that gives the team clear visibility into channel performance, conversion rates, and pipeline attributionCreate and maintain a formal marketing calendar that the broader team runs off of</li>
<li>Establish a functioning enterprise lifecycle program with RevOps</li>
<li>Run at least one high-touch deal acceleration program (EBC, roundtable, or CxO event) in partnership with Field Marketing</li>
</ul>
<div>
<p>The base salary range for this role is $180k - $230k/year. Final offer amounts will carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location, level, and may vary from the amount above.</p>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2 class="p-security">About Descript</h2>
<p class="p-security">Descript is building a simple, intuitive, fully-powered editing tool for video and audio — an editing tool built for the age of AI. We are a team of 150&nbsp;and the backing of some of the world's greatest investors (<a href="https://www.descript.com/blog/article/all-new-descript-backed-by-openai-startup-fund">OpenAI</a>, <a href="https://www.a16z.com/">Andreessen Horowitz</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://redpoint.com/">Redpoint Ventures</a>, <a href="https://medium.com/spark-capital/welcome-descript-a6caddb91039">Spark Capital</a>).&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p-security">Descript is the special company that's in possession of both product market fit and the raw materials (passionate user community, great product, large market) for growth, but is still early enough that each new employee has a measurable influence on the direction of the company.</p>
<p class="p-security">Benefits include a generous healthcare package, 401k matching program, catered lunches, and flexible vacation time.&nbsp;<a href="https://tours.momentumvirtualtours.com/tours/WtZKwedwv">Our headquarters</a> are located in the Mission District of San Francisco, CA. We're hiring for a mix of remote roles and hybrid roles.&nbsp; For those who are remote, we have a handful of opportunities throughout the year for in person collaboration.&nbsp; For our hybrid roles, we're flexible, and you're an adult—we don't expect or mandate that you're in the office every day. We do believe there are valuable and serendipitous moments of discovery and collaboration that come from working together in person.&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p-security">Descript is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We believe in actively building a team rich in diverse backgrounds, experiences, and opinions to better allow our employees, products, and community to thrive.&nbsp;</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/descript-head-of-enterprise-marketing">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/descript-head-of-enterprise-marketing</a></p>
</description>

      <title>PlanetScale: Video Editor</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote US 
</p>

<p>We're looking for a Video Editor who will help shape how videos get made at PlanetScale. You'll work with our team to edit and animate YouTube videos, social shorts, conference highlights, case studies, and launch films, with free rein to use any tool that makes them better, including ones that didn't exist six months ago.</p>
<p>AI is reshaping the video editing space in similar ways to how it is transforming software broadly. We're looking for someone who embraces this new world of creating, combining this with your own personal craft to make excellent video content. We give you the room, the tools, and the time to both create and experiment.</p>
<h2>What we're looking for</h2>
<ul>
<li>A portfolio that shows strong editing across formats. YouTube, short form edits, podcasts, etc.</li>
<li>A sharp sense of pacing, structure, and story: you know what to keep, what to cut, and how to time things to maintain an engaged audience.</li>
<li>Equal comfort with editing, animation, and design: you can shape a story, incorporate interesting visuals, and set clean, expressive type that reads well on any screen.</li>
<li>Fluency in professional editing tools such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro.</li>
<li>Experience using AI tools to create animations, assist with editing, and the curiosity to push the limits of how these can be used in a video creation workflow.</li>
<li>Ability to create custom scripts and leverage AI to automate parts of your pipeline, such as transcription, thumbnail ideation, and generating rough edits of large amounts of footage.</li>
<li>Work closely with our team to help shape ideas before the edit starts, and iterate on feedback quickly.</li>
</ul>
<h2>What you'll edit</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>YouTube videos</strong>, from explainers to interviews, paced to hold attention start to finish.</li>
<li><strong>Shorts and vertical clips</strong> for social platforms.</li>
<li><strong>Conference talks</strong>, full-talks from our events and clips to share on socials.</li>
<li><strong>Launch videos</strong>, where timing, polish, and pacing carry the announcement.</li>
<li><strong>Thumbnails, title cards, typography, and motion graphics</strong> that go with all of the above.</li>
</ul>
<h2>How you'll work</h2>
<ul>
<li>A combination of strong individual editing skills combined with an excitement for how AI can improve the speed and quality at which we create.</li>
<li>In close collaboration with the Marketing team at PlanetScale.</li>
<li>You'll have time and budget to try new tools.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Bonus points</h2>
<ul>
<li>Background in Software Development, or working with Engineering companies</li>
<li>Experience editing tech / developer content</li>
<li>A channel or account you've grown yourself</li>
<li>Experience with code-driven video tools like Remotion</li>
<li>A knack for creating engaging thumbnails and titles</li>
<li>Sound design and audio mixing skills</li>
<li>Experience shooting or directing your own footage</li>
<li>Livestream or live event production experience</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Why PlanetScale</strong></h2>
<p>PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.</p>
<p>At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.</p>
<p>If you have a disability, please let us know if there’s any way we can make the interview process better for you; we’re happy to accommodate!</p>
<h2><strong>Total Compensation and Pay Transparency</strong></h2>
<p>An employee’s total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Base salary range: $150,000 - $200,000</p>
<p>PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess/MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all sizes.&nbsp;</p>
<p>PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn’t be higher.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-video-editor">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-video-editor</a></p>
</description>

      <title>PlanetScale: Solutions Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
