      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - EMEA, Remote - NA
</p>

<p>PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the transactional database market. The PlanetScale platform offers both Postgres and Vitess clusters. Vitess, an open-source database clustering system for horizontal scaling of MySQL, enables businesses to efficiently handle large-scale data workloads — without sacrificing developer experience.</p>
<p>PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for early members of our Sales team that can form deep partnerships with our prospects and customers to help them adopt and succeed on the next generation of database infrastructure.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>What's the job to be done?</h2>
<ul>
<li>Partner with Sales and Customer Engineering throughout the pre-sales and post-sales journey as the technical expert helping customers solve their most challenging database problems.</li>
<li>Lead technical discovery to match customers’ business and technical objectives with PlanetScale’s offerings.</li>
<li>Design and execute proof of value timelines that deliver on agreed upon business outcomes and success criteria.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Design database migration strategies and work hands-on with customers to execute migrations to PlanetScale's PostgreSQL and Vitess platforms.</li>
<li>Assess workloads, analyze performance requirements, and recommend architecture, sizing, and optimization strategies.</li>
<li>Build tools, scripts, and automation that accelerate migrations and improve customer onboarding.</li>
<li>Create educational content including documentation, guides, blog posts, workshops, and videos.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and shape the platform.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>These attributes best describe you…</h2>
<ul>
<li>You have deep expertise in database systems including replication, high availability, sharding, performance tuning, and migration strategies.</li>
<li>You're equally comfortable presenting architecture designs to executives and writing scripts to automate migration tasks.</li>
<li>You thrive in customer-facing situations and translate technical concepts into business value for diverse audiences.</li>
<li>You're self-motivated and can manage multiple engagements simultaneously with minimal oversight.</li>
<li>You enjoy creating content and sharing knowledge through various formats.</li>
<li>You're comfortable with occasional travel (less than 20%).</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>What you will need</h2>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of hands-on experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL in production, including operations, performance tuning, and troubleshooting&nbsp;OR</li>
<li>5+ years of experience supporting customers with MySQL or PostgreSQL workloads where you advised on operations, performance tuning, and troubleshooting</li>
<li>Experience working with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure, or OCI)</li>
<li>Proven success in customer-facing technical roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager</li>
<li>Strong understanding of database migration strategies and tooling</li>
<li>Experience evaluating database solutions including architecture reviews, capacity planning, and performance analysis</li>
<li>Ability to write scripts and tools in Python, Go, or JavaScript</li>
<li>Experience creating technical content such as documentation, tutorials, or blog posts</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>What else will help you be successful</h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience with AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) or logical replication tools</li>
<li>Knowledge of Vitess, database sharding, or distributed database systems</li>
<li>Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures</li>
<li>Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation</li>
<li>Contributions to open-source projects or active participation in database communities</li>
<li>Public speaking experience at conferences or meetups</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>Why PlanetScale</h2>
<p>We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Solutions Engineer, you'll guide customers through transformational database migrations and help them unlock the full power of PlanetScale's platform.</p>
<p>PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.</p>
<p>At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.</p>
<p>If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>Total Compensation and Pay Transparency</h2>
<p>An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.</p>
<p><strong>Base salary range:</strong> $160,000 - $250,000 USD</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-solutions-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-solutions-engineer</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Veracode: Senior Website Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Burlington, MA OR US Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market?  Look no further than Veracode!&nbsp;</p>
<p>Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.</p>
<p><em>Learn more at </em><a href="https://www.veracode.com/"><em>www.veracode.com</em></a><em>, on the </em><a href="https://www.veracode.com/blog"><em>Veracode blog</em></a><em>, and on </em><a href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fveracode%2F&amp;data=05%7C02%7Cjbelmonte%40Veracode.com%7C989fdcd544fe425a07b808dc69096df9%7C3b627b68f21c4ed79fe3698efdedbe21%7C0%7C0%7C638500736454429530%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=WIg8EmVTgkrfgliLodV3%2Fgl%2F1IdGyT05d7Y%2FEfXS070%3D&amp;reserved=0"><em>LinkedIn</em></a><em> and </em><a href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2FVeracode%3Fref_src%3Dtwsrc%255Egoogle%257Ctwcamp%255Eserp%257Ctwgr%255Eauthor&amp;data=05%7C02%7Cjbelmonte%40Veracode.com%7C989fdcd544fe425a07b808dc69096df9%7C3b627b68f21c4ed79fe3698efdedbe21%7C0%7C0%7C638500736454434178%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=YUcOAPoWdcug7OmcC1N7CEoeEKUFDAaTvgE4r1rAAe0%3D&amp;reserved=0"><em>Twitter</em></a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>Veracode is seeking a Senior Website Manager to own the strategy, governance, performance, and ongoing evolution of Veracode.com. Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing and working closely with the Creative Director, this role will lead the website roadmap, improve operational excellence, and turn business priorities into high-performing digital experiences that increase traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions.</p>
<p>You will own the web roadmap, lead the migration from WordPress to Webflow through launch and partner with marketing, creative, demand generation, operations, IT, and agency teams to translate business needs into scalable website experiences. You will oversee site infrastructure, reusable templates, page builds, campaign support, content publishing, and continuous optimization for speed, security, accessibility, SEO, GEO, and user experience.</p>
<p>The Senior Website Manager will improve the full digital journey, from organic discovery and campaign landing pages to content engagement, form conversion, personalization, and post-click experiences aligned to priority personas.</p>
<p>This role balances strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The Senior Website Manager should be comfortable setting priorities, managing stakeholders, improving governance, and jumping into the details of site updates, QA, analytics, campaign launches, and CMS operations when needed. This is a hands-on role. The manager will build and edit pages in Webflow, troubleshoot tracking and form issues, and review agency work in the code and configuration, not just in screenshots.</p>
<h4><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>Migration Ownership</strong> — Take ownership of Veracode’s in-flight migration from WordPress to Webflow and drive it through launch and post launch stabilization. Align stakeholders, leadership, and agency partners on scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning.</li>
<li><strong>Day-to-Day Site Management</strong> — Manage daily website operations, intake, prioritization, page updates, QA, publishing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder requests while maintaining high standards for accuracy, usability, performance, and brand consistency.</li>
<li><strong>Data and Analytics</strong> — Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, dashboards, and campaign data to monitor traffic, behavior, conversions, attribution, and funnel performance, then translate insights into optimization priorities.</li>
<li><strong>Content Governance and Quality Control</strong> — Maintain site content standards, taxonomy, metadata, redirects, page ownership, review cycles, archival processes, and content hygiene so the website stays accurate, discoverable, compliant, and easy to maintain.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic Roadmap and Vision</strong> — Architect and execute web strategies that incorporate AI-enabled personalization, SEO, GEO, campaign performance, content experience, and conversion optimization to drive traffic, engagement, and pipeline impact.</li>
<li><strong>Design Strategy &amp; Governance</strong> — Lead visual and UX evolution, ensuring designs align with brand identity; manage scalable design systems, wireframes/prototypes (e.g., Figma), and trends like micro-interactions, organic layouts, and performance-driven creativity. Own the translation of Figma designs into Webflow components and templates.</li>
<li><strong>Conversion-First UX &amp; AI-Enhanced Personalization</strong> — Direct user journeys for high-stakes pages; implement AI-driven adaptive experiences and A/B testing to optimize funnels.</li>
<li><strong>Privacy, Consent, Accessibility and Compliance</strong> — Partner with legal, security, and marketing operations to manage cookie consent, privacy requirements, data collection standards, accessibility, and compliance needs across website experiences. As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy.</li>
<li><strong>Performance Optimization</strong> — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance.</li>
<li><strong>Reporting and Executive Visibility</strong> — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities.</li>
<li><strong>SEO, GEO and Growth Management</strong> — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences.</li>
<li><strong>Technical Oversight</strong> — Manage Webflow, WordPress, or similar enterprise CMS environments, and coordinate with IT and development teams on infrastructure, security, bugs, integrations, and new features. Manage WordPress through sunset and Webflow as the long-term platform, including CMS structure, permissions, hosting, and custom code.</li>
<li><strong>Website Release Management and QA</strong> — Own launch readiness for new pages, templates, campaigns, integrations, and site changes, including requirements intake, testing, stakeholder approvals, rollback planning, documentation, and post-launch monitoring.</li>
<li><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership</strong> — Partner with marketing, creative, product marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, sales, agencies, and vendors to gather requirements, align priorities, manage dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver website initiatives on time.</li>
<li><strong>Vendor and Agency Partnership</strong> — Act as the primary liaison for web development partners and agencies. Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently.</li>
<li><strong>Marketing Automation Integration</strong> — Work with marketing ops to ensure seamless ties with Marketo forms, lead capture, and CRM (Salesforce).</li>
<li>This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. You will administer infrastructure, manage CMS operations, build scalable templates and interactive experiences, publish content, improve governance, and continuously optimize site performance.</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Required Skills &amp; Qualifications</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>8–10+ years in web management, digital marketing, or web program management, with strong emphasis on strategy, design oversight, and growth.</li>
<li>Experience leading a full CMS migration for a large B2B site (hundreds of pages or more), including redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and tracking validation.</li>
<li>Strong experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM strategies, SEO and GEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog), and CRO (A/B testing, heatmaps like Hotjar).</li>
<li>Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL; frontend literacy (e.g., CSS Grid/Flexbox, animations).</li>
<li>Familiarity with website security, ADA/WCAG compliance (accessibility-first design), performance optimization, and 2026 trends like AI personalization and immersive interactivity.</li>
<li>Proven project management skills (e.g., Jira, Asana); experience managing agencies, vendors, in-house teams (development/design).</li>
<li>Strong analytical mindset; ability to present performance, design, and growth reports to executives.</li>
<li>Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration expertise.</li>
<li>Experience with Marketo and Salesforce form/CRM integrations.</li>
<li>Webflow Enterprise experience is a plus.</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Examples of A/B Testing Strategies This Role Might Lead</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Headline/CTA variations on landing pages to boost conversions (e.g., testing benefit-focused vs. feature-focused copy).</li>
<li>Layout changes (e.g., grid vs. organic/asymmetric) or visual elements (e.g., hero images/videos, micro-animations) for engagement/time-on-page.</li>
<li>Form optimization (e.g., multi-step vs. single-page) or personalization (e.g., AI-segmented content) for lead capture.</li>
<li>Button colors/sizes/text or navigation tweaks to improve click-through and funnel progression.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate’s position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting.</p>
<p><em>Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.</em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed</h3>
<p class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.</p>
<p class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">Here’s our recruitment promise to you:</p>
<ul>
<li class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers.</li>
<li class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware.</li>
<li class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address.</li>
</ul>
<p class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-5">If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at&nbsp;<a href="mailto:careers@veracode.com">careers@veracode.com</a>&nbsp;before taking any further action.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Texas, United States, AMER
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.</p></div><p><span><strong>About Us</strong></span><br><span>Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.</span><br><br><span>Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.</span><br><br><span>Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.</span><br><br><span>As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.</span><br><br><span>During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>About the Role</strong></span></p>
<p><span>The Enterprise Account Executive will drive towards aggressive new customer and partner revenue goals, while growing our footprint in the Enterprise market.</span></p>
<p><span>This is a full-time, remote position and must be based out of Texas in the United States. Please note that the compensation listed below does not include commission (uncapped 50/50 split) or RSU value.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>What You'll Do</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, customer success, alliances, operations, and analytics to drive pipeline generation and exceed revenue goals.</span></li>
<li><span>Accelerate the growth &amp; adoption of Fivetran in the Enterprise Market through value-driven sales cycles.</span></li>
<li><span>Lead in-depth discovery and demonstrate a deep interest in our Enterprise customers’ data challenges, identify required capabilities and positive business outcomes to drive towards valuable long term customer engagements.</span></li>
<li><span>Speak comfortably about Fivetran’s vision to a broad range of audiences from C-level executives to individual contributors.</span></li>
<li><span>Seek out and land deals with new Enterprise target accounts, then look to grow their footprint with Fivetran through new use cases, cross-sells and expansion.</span></li>
<li><span>Build strategic relationships with partners in order to identify new opportunities and accelerate deal cycles.</span></li>
<li><span>Forecast accurately and provide clear visibility on sales and revenue performance by actively managing and progressing opportunities.</span></li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>Skills We're Looking For</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>8+ years of large enterprise software sales experience and well-developed pattern recognition for navigating complex organizations.</span></li>
<li><span>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold multiple stakeholders accountable throughout a complex value-driven sales cycle.</span></li>
<li><span>In-depth familiarity with the modern data technology industry and key players.</span></li>
<li><span>You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.</span></li>
<li><span>You thrive in an extremely fast-paced, ever changing work environment.</span></li>
<li><span>You’re able to keep up with a highly motivated team in a market that is growing extremely fast.</span></li>
<li><span>You are extremely organized.</span></li>
<li><span>You are able to juggle lots of things at once while not letting anything drop.</span></li>
<li><span>You are a strategic thinker.</span></li>
<li><span>You are able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way.</span></li>
<li><span>You are a problem solver.</span></li>
<li><span>You are resilient and creative, able to be resourceful to proactively seek out a solution to a problem.</span></li>
<li><span>You are enthusiastic!</span></li>
<li><span>You exhibit passion and excitement for your work and you have a can-do attitude.</span></li>
<li><span>Previous experience with data integration, database, ETL, or business intelligence technologies is a plus, but not required</span></li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>Please note that the base + uncapped commission compensation listed below does not include RSU value. This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><em>As part of our commitment to setting new hires up for success, all new sales team members attend a one-week, in-person Revenue Bootcamp during their second week at Fivetran. This bootcamp, held at one of our designated company locations, requires travel and is a mandatory part of the onboarding process.</em></span></p>

The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. <p class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Perks and Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>100% employer-paid medical insurance<strong>*</strong></li>
<li>Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.</li>
<li>RSU stock grants*</li>
<li>Professional development and training opportunities</li>
<li>Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities</li>

<hr>
<p>We’re honored to be <a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran.com/blog/hvr-acquisition-series-d">valued at over $5.6 billion</a>, but more importantly, we’re proud of our&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran.com/culture">core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream</a>. Read about us in&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran-com.s3.amazonaws.com/news/forbes-aug-sept-2022-digital-reprint-10-21-22.pdf">Forbes</a>.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
<p>Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion &amp; belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.</p>
<p>To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xlhtp4dGh8o">click here</a> and enjoy our video.</p>

We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.</em></p></div>

      <title>Fivetran : Enterprise Account Executive</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote,  Minnesota, United States, AMER
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.</p></div><p><span><strong>About Us</strong></span><br><span>Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.</span><br><br><span>Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.</span><br><br><span>Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.</span><br><br><span>As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.</span><br><br><span>During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>About the Role</strong></span></p>
<p><span>The Enterprise Account Executive will drive towards aggressive new customer and partner revenue goals, while growing our footprint in the Enterprise market.</span></p>
<p><span>This is a full-time, remote position and must be based out of Minnesota in the United States. Please note that the compensation listed below does not include commission (uncapped 50/50 split) or RSU value.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>What You'll Do</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, customer success, alliances, operations, and analytics to drive pipeline generation and exceed revenue goals.</span></li>
<li><span>Accelerate the growth &amp; adoption of Fivetran in the Enterprise Market through value-driven sales cycles.</span></li>
<li><span>Lead in-depth discovery and demonstrate a deep interest in our Enterprise customers’ data challenges, identify required capabilities and positive business outcomes to drive towards valuable long term customer engagements.</span></li>
<li><span>Speak comfortably about Fivetran’s vision to a broad range of audiences from C-level executives to individual contributors.</span></li>
<li><span>Seek out and land deals with new Enterprise target accounts, then look to grow their footprint with Fivetran through new use cases, cross-sells and expansion.</span></li>
<li><span>Build strategic relationships with partners in order to identify new opportunities and accelerate deal cycles.</span></li>
<li><span>Forecast accurately and provide clear visibility on sales and revenue performance by actively managing and progressing opportunities.</span></li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>Skills We're Looking For</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>8+ years of large enterprise software sales experience and well-developed pattern recognition for navigating complex organizations.</span></li>
<li><span>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold multiple stakeholders accountable throughout a complex value-driven sales cycle.</span></li>
<li><span>In-depth familiarity with the modern data technology industry and key players.</span></li>
<li><span>You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.</span></li>
<li><span>You thrive in an extremely fast-paced, ever changing work environment.</span></li>
<li><span>You’re able to keep up with a highly motivated team in a market that is growing extremely fast.</span></li>
<li><span>You are extremely organized.</span></li>
<li><span>You are able to juggle lots of things at once while not letting anything drop.</span></li>
<li><span>You are a strategic thinker.</span></li>
<li><span>You are able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way.</span></li>
<li><span>You are a problem solver.</span></li>
<li><span>You are resilient and creative, able to be resourceful to proactively seek out a solution to a problem.</span></li>
<li><span>You are enthusiastic!</span></li>
<li><span>You exhibit passion and excitement for your work and you have a can-do attitude.</span></li>
<li><span>Previous experience with data integration, database, ETL, or business intelligence technologies is a plus, but not required</span></li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>Please note that the base + uncapped commission compensation listed below does not include RSU value. This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><em>As part of our commitment to setting new hires up for success, all new sales team members attend a one-week, in-person Revenue Bootcamp during their second week at Fivetran. This bootcamp, held at one of our designated company locations, requires travel and is a mandatory part of the onboarding process.</em></span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. &nbsp;Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process.</p></div><div class="title">Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$151,351</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$189,189 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">OTE (On Target Earning)</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$302,702</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$378,378 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Perks and Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>100% employer-paid medical insurance<strong>*</strong></li>
<li>Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.</li>
<li>RSU stock grants*</li>
<li>Professional development and training opportunities</li>
<li>Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities</li>
<li>Monthly cell phone stipend</li>
<li>Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.</li>
</ul>
<p><em><strong>*</strong>May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information</em></p>
<p><em>Click <a href="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CdawUwjo1Q1B7ghZJ_owdmmHB8VtqhBu?usp=sharing">here</a> to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.</em></p>
<hr>
<p>We’re honored to be <a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran.com/blog/hvr-acquisition-series-d">valued at over $5.6 billion</a>, but more importantly, we’re proud of our&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran.com/culture">core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream</a>. Read about us in&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran-com.s3.amazonaws.com/news/forbes-aug-sept-2022-digital-reprint-10-21-22.pdf">Forbes</a>.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
<p>Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion &amp; belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.</p>
<p>To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xlhtp4dGh8o">click here</a> and enjoy our video.</p>
<p>To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can <a href="https://fivetran.com/candidate-privacy">read our statement here</a>.</p>
<hr>
<p><em>We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this <a href="https://forms.gle/V7k3t4u9j523XkEt6">form</a>. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.</em></p></div>

      <title>Upsun: Sales Enablement Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇫🇷 France, 🇩🇪 Germany, and 🇬🇧 United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote • Spain, France, Germany and the United Kingdom
</p>

<h1><span><strong>About Upsun</strong></span></h1>
<p><span>Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.</span></p>
<p><span>Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span><strong>Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator.</strong> Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.</span></li>
<li><span><strong>Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration.</strong> Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:</span>
<ul>
<li><span>Predictable performance, even at scale</span></li>
<li><span>Secure, compliant environments by default</span></li>
<li><span>Real-time observability and profiling built in</span></li>
<li><span>Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds</span></li>
<li><span>Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely</span></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span>The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work. </span></p>
<p><span>Our values:&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span> We make a positive impact.</span></p>
<p><span> We aim for the stars.</span></p>
<p><span> We care for each other.&nbsp;</span></p>
<h1><span><strong>Impact of a Sales Enablement Manager</strong></span></h1>
<p><span><span>As Sales Enablement Manager, you will own the onboarding path a seller follows in week one, the certification that shows they can execute, the kit that arrives before the deal does, and the measurement that shows it works. </span><span>Our selling methodology only works if it holds when nobody is in the room. Our revenue enablement team makes that happen. One part of the team sets the methodology and coaches sellers directly. In close partnership with the Head of Sales Enablement, you will build and run the other part: the programs and systems that carry it every day.</span><span><br></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>Effective enablement goes beyond initial training to keep pace with a dynamic environment. As sellers join mid-quarter, product releases ship, and tools evolve, static frameworks in decks aren't enough. You will build robust systems and machinery that continuously support sellers and improve over time.</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>In this role you will report to the Senior Director, Customer Solutions.</span></span></p>
<p><strong>What to expect</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Programs and systems:</strong> Run onboarding and ramp for new sellers, with clear steps, checkpoints, and certification. Build the product change process as a system, so product updates reach sellers on time.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Sales plays and measurement:</strong> Build assets for sales plays and roll them out. Track ramp time, certification currency, and content usage. Report what the data shows and what to keep, change, or stop.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Content and knowledge:</strong> Build industry kits that sellers can use in a live deal. Deliver product trainings. Keep our knowledge base current and easy to search. Build a practice catalog for sellers, with AI roleplay where it helps.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>AI as a practical tool:</strong> Use AI to speed up drafting, curation, and routine tasks. Test ideas quickly, keep what works, and protect quality while you move fast.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Cross-team partnership:</strong> Work with RevOps, Product Marketing, Product, and Engineering. Bring clear requirements and follow up after each launch, so sellers are ready when a release arrives.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Prioritization:</strong> You will have more requests than time. Prioritize the backlog, sequence the work, and explain your choices to your partners.</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h1><span><strong>What you bring</strong></span></h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Enablement program experience:</strong> Proven experience running sales enablement, revenue enablement, or GTM programs from start to finish in B2B technology, including programs that changed a measurable behavior.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Sales or solutions engineering background:</strong> Experience in sales or solutions engineering, with a clear sense of what sellers need in a live deal.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Builder mindset with AI:</strong> Experience turning repeated work into systems that run without you, and hands-on use of AI for drafting, summarizing, or automated workflows. Knowledge of where AI saves time and where it adds review work.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Clear thinking and measurement:</strong> Experience turning a goal into a defined problem, scope, steps, and success measure. Familiarity with choosing and tracking a leading indicator.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Technical product and tools:</strong> Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and developer workflows, enough to talk with technical buyers. Experience writing clear requirements for RevOps and working with enablement tools such as an LMS or knowledge base.</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h1><span><strong>Bonus points</strong></span></h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p><span>Experience setting up an LMS, knowledge management, conversation intelligence, or roleplay tool from scratch.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>Experience building agents, skills, or automated workflows to support your own work or your team's work.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>Experience enabling sellers for a platform, infrastructure, or developer tools product.</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h1><span><strong>Where we hire</strong></span></h1>
<p><span><span>At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans more than 30 countries and a wide range of experience levels, and we’re currently hiring for this role in</span> <strong>France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom</strong>. <span>We’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, but we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.</span></span></p>
<h1><span><strong>How we hire</strong></span></h1>
<p><span><span>Our interview process is a chance for us to understand how you think, what you’ve built, and what you want to take on next, and for you to get to know us. Together, we’ll explore where your strengths and interests meet the challenges our teams are solving.</span><br><br><span>We know a great hire won’t meet every requirement above. If you can see yourself making the team better, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here if someone hadn’t taken a chance on us.</span> &nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>You can expect <strong>4</strong> interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below.&nbsp;</span></p>
<ol>
<li><span>45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Senior Director, Customer Solutions)<br></span></li>
<li><span>60 Minutes with Team (IC's &amp; Manager, Sales)</span></li>
<li><span>60 Minutes with Cross-Team (Product Marketing &amp; Head of Sales Enablement)&nbsp;</span></li>
</ol>
<p><em>All roles require background checks.</em></p>
<h1><span><strong>What we offer</strong></span></h1>
<p><span> <strong>A product you can believe in</strong> - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud <strong>B Corp</strong>.</span></p>
<p><span><strong> An Award-Winning Workplace</strong> - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.</span></p>
<p><span>️ <strong>A culture that values your voice </strong>- Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.</span></p>
<p><span> <strong>A global team </strong>- Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives</span></p>
<p><span><strong> </strong><strong>Benefits and perks</strong> - Make the most of what matters to you</span></p>
<blockquote>
<p> Flexible PTO</p>
<p> Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)</p>
<p> Company stock options</p>
<p> Professional development budget</p>
<p> Office equipment budget</p>
<p>‍️ Wellness budget</p>
<p> Annual team gatherings</p>
<p> Internet reimbursement</p>
<p> Inclusive parental leave</p>
<p>️ Remote work travel program</p>
</blockquote>
<h1><span><strong>You belong here</strong></span></h1>
<p><span>At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. </span><span>If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.<br></span></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upsun-sales-enablement-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upsun-sales-enablement-manager</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Tailscale: Head of Communications</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇨🇦 Canada</country>
      <state>California</state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6643/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Canada
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://tailscale.com/">https://tailscale.com/</a>
</p>

<div>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>We are seeking a strategic, creative, and highly experienced Head of Communications to lead and scale Tailscale's global communications function. This leader will shape how Tailscale is understood by the market, elevate our visibility in the media, and build the communications engine needed to support our next phase of growth.</p>
<p>Tailscale is a multi-product secure connectivity platform spanning networking, privileged access, workload connectivity, and AI infrastructure. We have an opportunity to help define the future of secure connectivity, establishing Tailscale as the obvious and best networking choice for AI and agentic infrastructure. We're looking for someone who can turn our technical innovation, customer impact, and vision into compelling stories that earn attention and establish Tailscale as a category leader.</p>
<p>Reporting to the SVP of Marketing, you will own product and corporate communications, public relations, media strategy, internal communications, crisis communications, award applications, international comms and media relations, new media engagement, and executive communications across the leadership team outside the CEO. You'll also partner closely with a separate dedicated CEO and policy communications leader to ensure our stories are coordinated and consistent.</p>
<p>This is a builder role for someone who combines strong strategic judgment with exceptional execution. You will initially be hands-on while hiring and developing a small, high-performing team. You will work directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, People, Legal, and the executive team to build a communications function that can scale with Tailscale's ambitions.</p>
<p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Develop and execute Tailscale's global communications strategy, strengthening brand awareness, reputation, and market leadership.</li>
<li>Lead product and technology communications, translating complex innovations, product launches, and customer stories into compelling narratives that earn meaningful media coverage. This should include sustained product storytelling between launches, including through independent reviews, technical publications, comparisons, creators, and third party validation. It could also include research-led PR.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Build strong relationships with top-tier business, technology, cybersecurity, and AI journalists, driving proactive media opportunities and increasing Tailscale's share of voice.</li>
<li>Expand Tailscale's presence across emerging media channels, including influential podcasts, newsletters, creators, and technical communities.</li>
<li>Own corporate communications for major company milestones, strategic partnerships, funding announcements, and other business developments.</li>
<li>Build and scale international communications programs, including regional media relations and agency partnerships.</li>
<li>Develop executive communications and thought leadership programs for the leadership team outside the CEO, including speaking opportunities, media engagements, and executive social presence. Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications lead to coordinate company narratives, major announcements, and executive engagement, building comms campaigns for executives that align with the overall company narrative.</li>
<li>Oversee internal communications, partnering with People and executive leadership on company-wide messaging, all-hands, organizational changes, and employee engagement communications.</li>
<li>Lead crisis communications, establishing response plans and partnering with Legal, Security, Engineering, and leadership to protect customer trust and company reputation. You should be able to improve processes over time as we scale.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Own Tailscale's awards and recognition strategy, identifying and securing high-value industry and company accolades.</li>
<li>Hire, manage, and develop a high-performing communications team while overseeing external agencies, communications processes, and performance measurement. This team will start small (likely 2 heads), but has the potential to grow in the future as we scale.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications individual contributor to maintain consistent narratives and support broader policy communications initiatives.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What We Are Looking For</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>10+ years of experience in public relations, product communications, or corporate communications, ideally within high-growth B2B technology companies.</li>
<li>Proven track record of securing meaningful earned media coverage and building strong relationships with influential journalists.</li>
<li>Deep product communications expertise, with the ability to translate complex technical products into clear, compelling stories.</li>
<li>Experience hiring, managing, and developing communications professionals and overseeing agency partners.</li>
<li>Exceptional writing, storytelling, and editorial judgment across external, executive, and internal communications.</li>
<li>Experience advising senior executives and navigating high-stakes or sensitive communications situations.</li>
<li>Strong strategic judgment and operational discipline, with the ability to prioritize, build scalable processes, and measure impact. Curiosity around and openness to leveraging AI to support operations and execution but not replace human taste and judgement.&nbsp;</li>
<li>A hands-on, creative, and highly accountable leader who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and is comfortable building from the ground up.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience in networking, cybersecurity, infrastructure, developer tools, or AI.</li>
<li>Experience scaling communications at a high-growth, global technology company.</li>
<li>Experience supporting fundraising, acquisitions, or pre-IPO communications as well as experience supporting a company through an IPO.</li>
<li>
<p>Experience collaborating with teams who support analyst relations, public policy, or major industry research initiatives.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.</p>
</div>
<div class="job__pay-ranges">
<div class="pay-range">
<p class="body body--medium">CAN Pay Range</p>
<p class="body">$254,600 - $317,580 CAD</p>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<ul>

      <title>Brex: Senior Field Marketing Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why join us</strong></p>
<p>Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.</p>
<p>Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.</p></div><p><strong>Marketing at Brex</strong></p>
<p>Marketing tells the story of Brex to the world. From acquisition to activation, we translate product value into business results. Our team spans Revenue, Product, and Brand Marketing, and works closely with nearly every function at Brex. We move fast, experiment often, and think deeply about customer behavior. If you want your creativity to drive growth and shape perception, this is the place.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p>
<p>Brex is looking for a strategic, data-driven Senior Field Marketing Manager to build and lead the field marketing motion for our Commercial segment.</p>
<p>Commercial represents one of Brex's largest growth opportunities. This role will be responsible for developing the segment strategy, identifying the markets and audiences with the greatest potential, and creating integrated programs that generate new pipeline and accelerate existing opportunities.</p>
<p>You will operate as the marketing lead for the Commercial business, partnering closely with Sales to understand their goals, test new approaches, and build repeatable programs that can scale. Your campaigns may include executive and customer events, industry programs, direct mail, digital experiences, partner activations, webinars, account-based plays, and other creative approaches.</p>
<p>The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment with hands-on execution. You are comfortable analyzing pipeline and campaign performance, presenting to Sales leadership, and managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders.</p>
<p><strong>Where you'll work</strong></p>
<p class="p8i6j03 paragraph">This role will be fully remote and based in the United States.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own the field marketing strategy, annual plan, budget, and pipeline goals for the Commercial segment</li>
<li>Partner with Commercial Sales leadership and set the planning rhythm across Marketing, Sales, and SDR</li>
<li>Analyze account, pipeline, industry, geographic, and performance data to identify the highest-potential audiences</li>
<li>Build integrated campaigns that combine in-person, digital, partner, content, direct mail, and account-based tactics</li>
<li>Shape event strategy, from regional programs to targeted dinners. For larger experiences, partner with the Events team while owning the audience, objective, Sales plan, and pipeline outcome</li>
<li>Test new campaign ideas, define success upfront, and turn what works into repeatable plays and documented playbooks</li>
<li>Track results (pipeline, conversion, ROI) and present them to senior Marketing and Sales leaders</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Requirements</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>7+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, demand gen, account-based marketing, or a related role, ideally in SaaS, fintech, or another high-growth technology company</li>
<li>Experience owning marketing strategy for a defined customer segment, region, industry, or sales organization</li>
<li>A track record of sourcing and accelerating pipeline through integrated programs</li>
<li>A strong understanding of the B2B sales cycle and the ability to translate Sales priorities into focused marketing strategies</li>
<li>Fluency in marketing and pipeline metrics, including the ability to analyze campaign performance, diagnose gaps, and clearly explain results</li>
<li>Strong project management and executive communication skills, with comfort juggling multiple programs in a fast-paced environment</li>
<li>Willingness to travel up to 40% for events, Sales meetings, and customer programs</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience building a field marketing motion or entering an underdeveloped segment</li>
<li>Experience marketing to companies in the Commercial or emerging mid-market segment</li>
<li>Familiarity with finance, fintech, spend, payments, ERP, or procurement audiences</li>
<li>Experience using Salesforce and marketing analytics platforms to assess funnel performance and campaign impact</li>
<li>Experience developing a business case for additional investment or team growth based on demonstrated results</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p>The expected salary range for this role is <span class="s1">$116,000 - $165,000</span>. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://brex.com/">brex.com</a>&nbsp;domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.</em></p></div>

<p>

</p>

<div class="job-post-container">
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div class="job-post-content">
<div><img src="https://res.cloudinary.com/o2bwt8ar/image/upload/f_auto,q_auto/CockroachLabs_Symbol_Black_2" alt="" width="92"></div>
<h1>Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.</h1>
<p>For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.</p>
<p>The customers you’ll work with are some of the most innovative businesses in the world, and the problems they’re trying to solve are real and urgent. You’ll bring a genuinely differentiated product to a market moving fast, at a company positioned to lead it. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.</p>
<hr>
<h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2>
<p>We are looking to grow our rapidly expanding sales engineering team. As a Sales Engineer, you will help qualify and close opportunities with customers and partners and provide technical expertise through sales presentations, product demonstrations, and supporting technical evaluations. While location for this role is flexible, you must be based in the Central territory to be eligible for this role. You will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Work alongside the sales team to introduce CockroachDB to our potential customers. As a trusted advisor, you will help educate prospects on the unique capabilities of CockroachDB and design solutions to meet a wide variety of challenges.</li>
<li>Lead product and solution briefings, build proof-of-concepts (POC), run live product demos, and prototype CockroachDB integrations.</li>
<li>Partner with Cockroach Labs product management, engineering and support teams to solve customer challenges and improve CockroachDB.</li>
<li>Identify and address customers' key technical objections and develop the engineering strategies strategy to resolve those blockers to adoption.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>The Expectations</strong></h2>
<p>In your first 30 days, you will immerse yourself in CockroachDB and our sales motion. We believe that it's important for you to take this first month to become familiar with our company, technology and message.</p>
<p>During this time you will be an active listener on customer calls and build relationships with various teams at Cockroach Labs. As you gain confidence in the message and technology, you will be called upon to lead meetings with support from the team.</p>
<p>After 90 days, you should be ready to lead customer meetings without support and conduct POCs. You should be working closely with Account Managers in your territory to build regional go to market strategies and account plans for key prospects.</p>
<h2><strong>You Have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>10-12+ years of prior experience collecting requirements, developing solution architectures, leading presentations and teaching prospective users or project teams how to use software similar to CockroachDB.</li>
<li>Developed software or infrastructure for scalable, distributed systems in the past and want to stay close to the code.</li>
<li>A passion for working on complex technical problems and have a strong understanding of modern infrastructure and database technologies.</li>
<li>A strong ability to build relationships with our partners, customers, and open-source users.</li>
<li>A collaborative spirit and enjoy making sure that each team gets customer feedback to keep improving CockroachDB.</li>
<li>The flexibility to travel to meet customers, attend events or conferences or wherever the work takes you.</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<p>Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at <a href="mailto:accessibility@cockroachlabs.com">accessibility@cockroachlabs.com</a>.</p>
<p>Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.</p>
<hr>
<h1>Benefits</h1>
<ul>
<li>Stock Options</li>
<li>Medical Insurance</li>
<li>Vision Insurance</li>
<li>Dental Insurance</li>
<li>Life and Disability Insurance</li>
<li>Professional Development Funds</li>
<li>Flexible Time Off</li>
<li>Paid Holidays</li>
<li>Paid Sick Days</li>
<li>Paid Parental Leave</li>
<li>Retirement Benefits</li>
<li>Mental Wellbeing Benefits</li>
<li>And more!</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-Remote</p>
</div>
</div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual anticipated base salary range for U.S. candidates for this role is listed in USD below. This role is also eligible for commission. Salary is one component of the Cockroach Labs’ Total Rewards package, which also includes, for each employee: stock options, medical insurance, vision insurance, dental insurance, life and disability insurance, funds towards professional development resources, flexible paid time off, 11 paid holidays a year, 10 paid sick days a year, paid parental leave, a 401(k) plan, and wellbeing benefits.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>We set standard ranges for all U.S.-based roles based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Actual salaries may vary and fall outside of this range depending on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, geographic location, skills, experience, and competencies. In addition, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Salaries for candidates outside the U.S. will vary based on local compensation structures.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This position will remain posted until filled. Applicants should apply via our Careers Page.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Anticipated Base Salary Range (U.S)</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$182,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$217,000 AUD</span></div></div></div>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p>
<p><span>Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. <p><strong>Flexible Working&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><span>At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams.
