      <title>Upstart: Business Development Representative, Auto Retail</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Austin, TX, USA; United States | Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Upstart</strong></p>
<p>At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.</p>
<p>As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.</p>
<p>We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.</p>
<p>If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.</p></div><p><strong>The Team:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Upstart’s Auto Retail team is building the future for car buying. We believe that AI-powered lending can help dealerships create a faster, more seamless financing experience for their customers while improving profitability. Upstart Auto Finance (UAF) gives dealership finance teams access to AI-powered credit decisioning that uses thousands of data points beyond traditional credit scores to help more car buyers access flexible financing options.</p>
<p>Our Auto Retail Sales Development team is responsible for lead generation. They seek out new opportunities to reach dealerships and introduce Upstart Auto Finance, our AI-powered auto finance solution. UAF empowers dealership finance teams with soft credit pulls, instant credit decisions, and automated pricing to help them present more competitive offers to more car buyers. They’re an analytical, ambitious team that brings a unique proposition to the industry and provides support in a number of ways to help hit sales pipeline generation targets. Alongside the Account Executives, they will enable Upstart to continue to grow its customer base and drive revenue.</p>
<p>As the&nbsp;<strong>Business Development Representative</strong> on the Auto Retail team at Upstart, you'll be responsible for driving revenue by prospecting and building pipelines with automotive dealerships. You are an energetic, committed, over-achiever who is passionate about sales and bringing value-added UAF solutions to customers. You consistently exceed your quota and are always looking for ways to have a larger impact. In addition to your core responsibilities, you’ll also get to play a pivotal role in partnering with marketing, executive teams and the OEM team on driving strategic initiatives and identifying key accounts. This is a great opportunity for candidates who want to work in a fast-paced environment, make a big impact, grow, and win as a team to scale a growing business.</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Account research: Research target dealerships and identify key decision makers to better tailor messaging</li>
<li>1:1 sales prospecting: Deliver compelling, personalized messages and offers via daily cold calls and emails to key personas such as the General Manager, General Sales Manager, Dealer Principle and Directors of Marketing.</li>
<li>Inbound lead follow-up: In partnership with marketing, follow-up with marketing qualified leads generated from the website and marketing campaigns in a timely manner.</li>
<li>Sales partnership: Coordinate with account executives to align on target accounts, handoff leads, share prospect insights, and prepare for first meetings.</li>
<li>Structured lead management: Consistently update account and lead information and assist the operations team on data cleanup within the CRM system and support weekly reporting efforts.</li>
<li>Market insights: Provide “voice of customer feedback and competitive insights to sales, marketing and OEM teams to improve go-to-market strategy.</li>
<li>Company support: Work closely with the Marketing and OEM teams on special projects to drive critical initiatives.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Minimum Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field is preferred.</li>
<li>At least 6+ months of Enterprise software / SaaS B2B sales development experience including cold calling and email outreach</li>
<li>A track record of measurable success in growing sales pipeline through a targeted account-based approach</li>
<li>Strong communication, analytical, and listening skills, with a positive and energetic phone presence</li>
<li>Strong work-ethic with a strong sense of ownership, accountability and a desire to continually improve.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Exceptional writing skills and verbal communication skills to engage prospective customers</li>
<li>Strong organizational and time management skills to prioritize daily and weekly activities, specifically following up with leads in a structured manner</li>
<li>Natural teamwork skills to collaborate with marketing and sales colleagues</li>
<li>Passion for having an impact on demand generation and sales growth</li>
<li>Familiarity with sales development tools such as Outreach, Connectandsell, Zoominfo, and Sendoso</li>
<li>Previous experience within automotive industry a plus</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Position location</strong> This role is available in the following locations: Austin, TX</p>
<p><strong>Time zone requirements</strong> The team operates on the Central time zones.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>In-Office requirements.&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;This team has regular onsite collaboration sessions. These occur 3 days per week at one of Upstart’s offices. If you need to travel to make these meetups, Upstart will cover all travel related expenses.</p>
<p><strong>Travel requirements</strong> As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.</p>
<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>#LI-REMOTE</span></p>
<p><span>#LI-Associate</span></p>
<div></div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span>At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package.&nbsp; The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.</span></p>
<p><span>In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).</span></p></div><div class="title">United States | Remote -  Anticipated Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$65,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$90,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What you'll love</strong></p>
<p>At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:</p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly&nbsp;</li>
<li>Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)</li>
<li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)</li>
<li>Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.</li>
<li>Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)</li>
<li>Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security</li>
<li>Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements</li>
<li>Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)</li>
<li>Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs</li>
<li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources</li>
<li>Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)</li>
<li>Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you</li>
<li>Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from</li>
<li>Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)</li>
<li>Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City</li>
</ul>
<p>For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.</p>
<p>Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.</p>
<p><em>If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate_accommodations@upstart.com</em></p>
<p><a href="https://www.upstart.com/candidate_privacy_policy">https://www.upstart.com/candidate_privacy_policy</a></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upstart-business-development-representative-auto-retail">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upstart-business-development-representative-auto-retail</a></p>
</description>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Mission:</strong></p>
<p>6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.&nbsp; We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.</p>
<p><strong>Our People:</strong></p>
<p>People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. &nbsp;Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.&nbsp; 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.&nbsp; We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>About the Role&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>At 6sense, we're building one of the fastest-growing advertising businesses in B2B technology and looking for exceptional enterprise sellers to help fuel the next phase of growth.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This is a unique opportunity to join a rapidly expanding team within one of the industry's leading go-to-market platforms and play a direct role in shaping the future of B2B advertising. As a Senior Enterprise Advertising Account Executive, you'll partner with some of the world's largest enterprise organizations, helping them leverage programmatic advertising, predictive intelligence, AI-driven insights, intent data, and audience activation to identify in-market buyers, accelerate pipeline, and drive measurable revenue growth.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This is an overlay seller role that partners closely with SaaS Account Executives to grow revenue across strategic enterprise accounts, help customers unlock greater value from 6sense, and drive measurable pipeline and business outcomes.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're looking for ambitious, driven sellers who want more than just another sales role. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-growth business, work alongside industry-leading GTM experts, and become a core contributor to one of the company’s growing revenue streams. &nbsp;</p>
<p>The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments and is energized by helping enterprise customers achieve measurable outcomes, driving meaningful revenue growth, and contributing to the continued expansion of 6sense’s advertising business.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>10+ years of quota-carrying enterprise advertising or SaaS sales experience.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proven success selling B2B programmatic advertising including predictive intelligence and intent data&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience selling into large enterprise organizations, preferably Fortune 500 companies.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated track record of exceeding sales quotas and closing complex six- and seven-figure deals.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proven ability to expand and grow media revenue within complex enterprise organizations through executive relationship development, multi-threaded selling, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Strong executive presence, consultative selling, and business acumen.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Ability to communicate how advertising, audience activation, predictive intelligence, and intent data contribute to pipeline and revenue outcomes.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred Experience&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Preferred experience includes selling into large enterprise organizations and engaging executive marketing stakeholders such as CMOs, VP Marketing, VP Advertising, VP Media, Demand Generation and ABM Leaders&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Ideal Candidate&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>The ideal candidate has successfully sold B2B programmatic advertising that includes audience targeting, predictive intelligence, intent data, AI-driven marketing into large enterprise organizations and understands how advertising fits within a broader B2B go-to-market strategy.&nbsp;</li>
<li>This individual has experience engaging executive-level marketing buyers and can connect advertising investments directly to pipeline creation, revenue growth, account engagement, and measurable business outcomes.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Must have a proven track record of expanding complex enterprise organizations by identifying new buying centers, building executive relationships, navigating matrixed stakeholders, and increasing share of wallet across large accounts.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Base Salary Range: $120,285.00 - $176,418.00. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). <span>#Li-remote</span></p>

We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.</span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>

<p>6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.&nbsp; We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.</p>
<p><strong>Our People:</strong></p>
<p>People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. <p>We will trust you to evangelize 6sense, run your business like a CEO, and consistently exceed quarterly and annual targets. This is not your average opportunity: you'll be closing large, complex deals across a diverse book of business, and you'll be rewarded very well for doing so.</p>
<p><strong>The Fit</strong></p>
<p>We're looking for driven closers who have a track record of being the best of the best. You bring passion for fundamentally changing B2B marketing and sales, and you can think critically about driving customer growth and building a world-class sales organization. This is a unique opportunity to help shape and accelerate our success.</p>
<p><strong>Here are the traits you exhibit:</strong></p>

<p>Intrinsic drive to be successful, love to win: You take initiative to figure it out and are motivated to do your absolute best work. That's why you've ended up at the top across your career.</p>

<li>

<li>
<p>Technical expertise: You can demonstrate and speak to how 6sense drives customer success.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Innately curious: You know your buyer, their business, and what 6sense means to their outcomes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Empathetic listener: You listen more than you talk, and you really get what they mean.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Collaborate and win as a team: You compete, but above all you collaborate. You share what's working, help the team win, and take on projects beyond just closing deals.</p>

<li>
<p>Consistent track record of over-achieving quota (top 10-20% of company)</p>

<li>
<p>Experience closing transactions of $100k+ ACV to line-of-business executives</p>

<li>
<p>Experience bringing on net-new logos and managing a pipeline of enterprise-level opportunities</p>

<p>Experience closing $1M+ transactions</p>

<li>
<p>Strong written and verbal communication skills</p>

<li>
<p>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>4-year BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience</p>

<li>

      <title>PlanetScale: AI Developer Experience Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote US 
</p>

<h2>About the role</h2>
<p>More and more PlanetScale databases are created, connected and queried by AI agents. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and a growing list of other tools now sit between developers and their infrastructure.</p>
<p>You will own that experience end to end. You'll make sure PlanetScale shows up everywhere developers build with AI, that our MCP server and CLI work flawlessly in every agent, and that we can measure how well it all works. Then you'll show the world how to do it well through demos, docs, blog posts, videos, and conferences.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on role combining engineering, content creation, and a strong public voice. You'll work closely with the teams that build our MCP server, CLI, API and docs.</p>
<p>The landscape of how developers work with AI changes fast. You'll have the opportunity to move quickly, experiment, and take the lead on the future of AI use with databases and infrastructure.</p>
<h2>Make PlanetScale great with AI tools</h2>
<ul>
<li>Build and maintain the plugins for PlanetScale in every AI marketplace and directory: agent plugins, skill registries, MCP directories, IDE extension stores and AI app builders</li>
<li>Own our integrations with AI coding tools, agent frameworks and platforms</li>
<li>Stay current with AI tools as they launch and ensure our customers have a great experience from day one</li>
<li>Test the PlanetScale MCP server and CLI across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and other clients, and catch regressions before users do</li>
<li>Find friction in creating a database, connecting, running migrations and debugging queries from inside an agent, then fix it or drive the fix with the owning team</li>
<li>Improve the context agents rely on: tool descriptions, skills, llms.txt, docs written for agents, and error messages agents can act on</li>
<li>Attention to AEO (answer engine optimization): make sure agents find and recommend PlanetScale</li>
<li>Build and maintain skills for working with Postgres, MySQL, Vitess, Neki, and PlanetScale</li>
</ul>
<h2>Measure how well we're doing</h2>
<ul>
<li>Build evals that run real agent tasks against PlanetScale databases</li>
<li>Benchmark how agents perform with PlanetScale and work towards continuous improvement</li>
<li>Track how often AI assistants and agents recommend PlanetScale for database questions, and whether what they say about us is accurate</li>
<li>Instrument and report on agent usage: databases created by agents, time to first connection, MCP versus CLI usage, and where sessions fail</li>
</ul>
<h2>Show people how to do it well</h2>
<ul>
<li>Build demos and sample apps that show PlanetScale and AI tooling at their best</li>
<li>Write docs, guides and blog posts on using databases effectively with AI, including safe access, branching and performance assessment</li>
<li>Make videos and attend conferences to communicate with our audience how to build effectively with AI</li>
</ul>
<h2>These attributes best describe you</h2>
<ul>
<li>Daily use of AI coding agents, with strong opinions about what makes a tool work well with them</li>
<li>Experience building an MCP server, plugin, CLI or SDK that real developers use</li>
<li>Software engineering background in languages like TypeScript and Go, and comfort with APIs, OAuth and the command line</li>
<li>Experience with writing docs, blogs, and / or video content creation</li>
<li>Good at communicating with a broad audience and customers alike on socials</li>
<li>Experience working with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite), schema design, migrations, connection handling, and Postgres or MySQL in production</li>
<li>Data fluency: designing evals, writing the queries behind a dashboard, and telling a real trend from noise</li>
<li>Clear communication of technical ideas in writing, on video and on stage</li>
<li>Independence and speed: spotting a gap, shipping a fix, and telling people about it</li>
<li>Genuine curiosity about the AI tooling landscape and a habit of keeping up with it</li>
</ul>
<h2>Bonus points</h2>
<ul>
<li>Contributions to the MCP spec, SDKs or popular open-source MCP servers</li>
<li>Experience writing agent skills, plugins or rules files for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex</li>
<li>Experience with LLM eval tools and building benchmarks for agents</li>
<li>Experience with AEO or GEO, or with tracking how LLMs surface and recommend a product</li>
<li>A blog, YouTube channel or GitHub that developers already follow</li>
<li>Experience with Vitess, database sharding, or running databases at scale</li>
</ul>
<p></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>Why PlanetScale</h3>
<p>We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.</p>
<p>At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.</p>
<p>If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!</p>
<h3>Total Compensation and Pay Transparency</h3>
<p>An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.</p>
<p>Base Salary Range: $170,000 - $220,000</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-ai-developer-experience-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-ai-developer-experience-engineer</a></p>
</description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@<a class="c-link" href="http://tebra.com/">tebra.com</a>, @<a class="c-link" href="http://patientpop.com/">patientpop.com</a>, or @<a class="c-link" href="http://kareo.com/">kareo.com</a>) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse.&nbsp;We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.</p></div><p></p>
<h1>About the Role</h1>
<p>As a Senior Sales Director at Tebra, you will lead a high-performing sales organization focused on driving new business across key segments. This senior leadership role goes beyond quota attainment — you’ll be a key player and important partner in shaping sales strategy, mentoring sales leaders and scaling revenue in a fast-paced SaaS environment.</p>
<h1>Your Area of Focus</h1>
<ul>
<li>Lead, develop, and scale a team of Leaders across multiple segments capable of consistently delivering results</li>
<li>Understand industry, product, competitive landscape and Tebra’s unique value proposition to effectively position our offerings and win new customers</li>
<li>Drive teams to consistently hustle, achieving efficiency and effectiveness targets</li>
<li>Partner with Sales leadership to refine sales strategy, systems and processes&nbsp;</li>
<li>Build growth and always be learning mindset across your teams</li>
<li>Own forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and sales efficiency metrics</li>
<li>Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure high quality customer journey and strong customer retention</li>
<li>Work with Marketing partners to create, test and execute campaigns</li>
<li>Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to Sales leadership</li>
<li>Coach and mentor rising sales leaders and contribute to leadership hiring</li>
<li>Building high performing, accountable, resilient, solutions-oriented culture</li>
</ul>
<h1>Your Professional Qualifications</h1>
<ul>
<li>7-8 years of experience in a Sales Management and Director positions</li>
<li>Proven ability to consistently deliver sales objectives and results</li>
<li>Proficiency in full-cycle selling both in inbound and outbound motions</li>
<li>Exceptional communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills</li>
<li>Strong forecasting and reporting skills&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated success recruiting and assessing talent and building winning teams&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience in the Healthcare IT industry and strong market knowledge</li>
<li>Demonstrated leadership influencing broader go-to-market strategy, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations</li>
<li>Proven experience driving strategic Sales and Business initiatives</li>
<li>Strong understanding of complex solution selling, sales methodologies, SaaS metrics (CAC, LTV, sales cycles)&nbsp;</li>
<li>BA/BS required</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>#LI-AH1 #LI-Remote</strong></p>
<p></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. For this position, this range reflects our Zone 1 (National Average) pay band. Your specific compensation is thoughtfully determined by your experience, qualifications, the specific requirements of the role, and your Geo Zone. Our geo-zone system ensures your pay is competitive for your location, recognizing varying costs of labor across regions.</p>
<p>Our four geo zones are designed to reflect this:<br>Zone 1: National Average<br>Zone 2: Moderately Higher Cost Regions<br>Zone 3: High-Cost Regions<br>Zone 4: Lower-Cost Regions</p>
<p>Beyond base compensation, Tebra offers eligible employees the opportunity for variable pay and a robust benefits package, reflecting our commitment to your overall well-being. In compliance with California pay transparency laws, the specific compensation range applicable to your Geo Zone will be shared during your initial talent screen.</p></div><div class="title">Zone 1 (National Average)</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$250,500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$286,500 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>About Tebra</h1>
<p>Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="http://www.tebra.com/">www.tebra.com</a>.</p>
<h1>Our Values</h1>
<h2>Start with the Customer&nbsp;</h2>
<p>We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens.</p>
<h2>Keep It Simple</h2>
<p>Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone.</p>
<h2>Stay Entrepreneurial&nbsp;</h2>
<p>We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action.</p>
<h2>Better Together</h2>
<p>We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together.</p>
<h2>Celebrate Success</h2>
<p>Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success.</p>
<h1>Perks &amp; Benefits&nbsp;</h1>
<p>United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.</p>
<p>Costa Rica: To assist with all of life’s needs, Tebra also offers a wellness and childcare subsidy and a University/Education discount! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.</p>
<h1>Compliance &amp; Privacy Disclosures</h1>
<p><em><span>NOTE: Tebra is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>California residents who apply or are recruited for a job with us: please carefully review our California-specific Privacy Notice under the California Consumer Protection Act here: <a href="https://www.tebra.com/privacy-policy/california-supplemental-notice/">https://www.tebra.com/privacy-policy/california-supplemental-notice/</a></span></em></p>
<p><em><span>If you would like to report a fraudulent Tebra job posting, please contact us at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="mailto:talentacquisition@tebra.com">talentacquisition@tebra.com</a>&nbsp;and consider reporting your experience to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center or the Better Business Bureau to help keep others safe online, too.</span></em></p>
<p></p>
<p><em>As part of our commitment to a fair and efficient hiring process, Tebra utilizes Greenhouse Notetaker, Greenhouse's native interview intelligence tool, for our phone and video screenings. This technology records and transcribes interviews to help us ensure consistency, reduce bias, and make more informed hiring decisions. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your interview may be recorded.</em></p>
<p></p></div>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote United States
</p>

<p>BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.</p>
<p>Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.</p>
<p>The Role:</p>
<p>The Enterprise Account Manager- DoD/Combatant Commands will manage a defined sales territory and be responsible for delivering against a quota goal for the defined territory. You will&nbsp;identify, generate, qualify, and close new business for customers and prospects in a defined territory.&nbsp; Responsible for managing the full sales lifecycle, building the go-to-market plan (including direct and indirect business).&nbsp;</p>
<p>What You’ll Do:</p>
<ul>
<li>Develop new and existing accounts within the US Department of Defense (DOD)/War (DOW)</li>
<li>Complete and maintain a territory sales plan which outlines a road map to success</li>
<li>Responsible for meeting or exceeding your monthly and annual quota. by proactively prospecting for All Product Lines and opportunities with new and existing customers</li>
<li>Responsible for sales forecasting, lead generation, prospecting, and account management through the close cycle</li>
<li>Maintain accurate Whitespace data on customer and focus prospect accounts</li>
<li>Partner closely with Vice President, SE’s, PAM’s and wider POD to deliver strategic goals</li>
<li>Algin with Channel team and Channel Partners to deliver value to our customers and BeyondTrust wherever possible</li>
<li>Align with SDR team to proactively cover your total addressable market (focus and non-focus territory accounts)</li>
<li>Attend corporate trade shows and events</li>
<li>Maintain sales pipeline activity in Salesforce</li>
<li>Schedule and conduct product demonstrations and detailed presentations to prospects, customers and partners</li>
<li>Lead RFP responses for your accounts</li>
</ul>
<p>What You’ll Bring:</p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience</li>
<li>5+ years customer-facing sales experience with security, PAM, Identity Management, or IT related software</li>
<li>Sale experience in the DOD Unified Combatant Commands and DOD Forth Estate accounts.</li>
<li>Familiar with federal buying vehicles such as ESI, GSA, CHESS/ITES, etc</li>
<li>Knowledge of the federal government channel of VADs and VARs</li>
<li>Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quota</li>
<li>Established network and relationships with senior IT professionals</li>
<li>Excellent communication and influencing skills</li>
<li>Ability to travel within defined region</li>
</ul>
<p>Nice To Have:</p>
<ul>
<li>Completed sales training (Sandler, SPIN, DISC, TAS, Miller)</li>
</ul>
<p>What Will Make You Successful:</p>
<ul>
<li>Conviction and Commitment.&nbsp;You have an unshakable belief that BeyondTrust’s products will improve the world – one person at a time. Once you get it, you go all the way.</li>
<li>A True Team Player. You’re the best at what you do, and you know how to work with your teammates to get their best.</li>
<li>Energy and Enthusiasm. You believe in what we’re doing and won’t stop at anything to deliver on your goals.</li>
<li>Excellent Communication. You know what to say and more importantly, how to say it.</li>
<li>Ownership&nbsp;– you take ownership of your results and often look for ways to improve; you see challenges as opportunities instead of obstacles</li>
<li>Go-Getter. Willing to go the extra mile with a strong work ethic; self-directed and resourceful</li>
</ul>
<p>Better Together</p>
<p>Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.</p>
<p>We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who&nbsp;come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.</p>
<p>About Us</p>
<p>BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.</p>
<p>BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.</p>
<p>Learn more at <a href="http://www.beyondtrust.com/">www.beyondtrust.com</a>.&nbsp;</p>
<p>#LI-JC1</p>

      <title>OnTheGoSystems: Head of Content and Editorial</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Nevada</state>
      <skills>AI Content Creation,  SEO,  Editing, and AI Agents</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://onthegosystems.com">http://onthegosystems.com</a>
</p>

<p>At <strong>OnTheGoSystems</strong>, the company behind <a href="https://wpml.org/">WPML</a>, <a href="https://toolset.com/">Toolset</a>, and <a href="https://ptc.wpml.org/">PTC</a>, we’re looking for an experienced <strong>Head of Content and Editorial </strong>who knows what makes content great and can take ownership of content quality and performance.</p>
<p><strong>AI is a core part of how we work</strong>. AI can already produce content quickly and efficiently. What we need is someone with the experience, strong editorial judgment, and intuition to turn AI-generated content into high-quality, valuable content that resonates with our readers and delivers real business results.</p>
<p>We’re looking for someone who has experience working with a small team of skilled writers, setting high editorial standards, and making content successful. You should know what good writing looks like, understand why certain content works, and be able to improve it.</p>
<h2>What You’ll Work On</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Content strategy and editorial direction</strong> – identify what content we should create, for whom, and why.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Content quality and editing</strong> – review, improve, and refine content to make it clear, engaging, accurate, and valuable.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>AI-assisted content creation</strong> – use AI tools and workflows to produce high-quality content efficiently while maintaining strong editorial standards.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Content performance</strong> – track results, understand what makes content successful, and use data to improve it.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Content experiments</strong> – test new ideas, formats, and approaches, learn from failures, and build on what works.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Collaboration with marketing and product teams</strong> – understand our products, customers, and business goals to make sure our content supports them.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>What We’re Looking For</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>You’ve managed small teams of skilled writers and know how to improve and maintain high content quality.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You have excellent editing and copywriting skills. You can easily spot what works in content and what needs improvement.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You know how to use AI effectively to create and edit content.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You’re comfortable working with metrics and taking responsibility for content performance. You use data to understand what works and what doesn't.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You have strong editorial intuition built through years of experience. You’re comfortable trying new ideas, making decisions, and checking the results.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You’re curious and want to understand our products, customers, and business.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You’re hands-on and independent. You can take ownership of your work without detailed instructions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You have experience with technology, software, SaaS, or technical content.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>We are especially interested in people who have spent years working in high-quality editorial environments, where great writing, strong editorial judgment, and measurable results are essential.</p>
<p>We’re not looking for someone whose main experience is managing large volumes of low-quality content. We want someone who knows how to make good content exceptional.</p>
<h2>Why Join Us</h2>
<p>OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing <strong>since 2007</strong>. WPML powers more than <strong>1.5 million websites worldwide</strong>.</p>
<p>You’ll have real ownership of our editorial direction, work closely with our CEO, marketing, and product teams, and help shape how we create high-quality content with AI.</p>
<p>You’ll have the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and see the impact of your work through real results.</p>
<p>We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life.</p>
<p><strong>If you have years of editorial experience, love great writing, and are excited about shaping the future of content with AI, we’d love to hear from you.</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

      <title>Storyblok: Partner Manager - USA</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.</p>
<p>Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU</strong></p>
<p>You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:</p>
<ul>
<li>Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)</li>
<li>Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding</li>
<li>Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays</li>
<li>Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material</li>
<li>The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers</li>
<li>As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules</li>
<li>An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals</li>
</ul></div><p><strong>JOB SUMMARY</strong></p>
<p>The Partner Manager, USA is responsible for building and scaling a high-performing ecosystem of implementation and solution partners that directly supports the USA Enterprise sales motion. The role is tightly aligned with the USA Account Executive (AE) function and exists to accelerate pipeline creation, deal execution, and enterprise win rates through effective co-selling and co-delivery.</p>
<p>This role ensures partners are activated, deal-ready, and aligned to regional GTM priorities, enabling AEs to focus on closing complex enterprise opportunities.<br><br></p>
<p><strong>ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Directly contribute to USA revenue growth by generating partner-sourced enterprise opportunities and increasing partner influence in collaboration with direct sales team.</li>
<li>Build and execute (with USA AEs, BDRs, and Marketing) a regional partner GTM plan aligned to territory strategy and target account priorities.</li>
<li>Establish a USA co-selling cadence with AEs: account mapping, partner selection, joint customer engagement, and deal registration and progression.</li>
<li>Recruit, onboard, and activate a focused set of high-impact implementation partners (agencies/SIs) in priority USA markets; ensure clear partner coverage and avoid channel conflict.</li>
<li>Ensure partners are deal-ready: enablement, certifications, value messaging, mutual action plans, and delivery confidence for enterprise buyers and all of this is set to become repeatable.</li>
<li>Support enterprise sales cycles by bringing the right partner into discovery, solutioning, workshops, proposals, and executive engagements.</li>
<li>Partner with RevOps to maintain clean attribution and reporting for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, bookings, and forecast inputs.</li>
<li>Partner with Customer Success to ensure smooth handover to delivery partners and to identify partner-led expansion opportunities.</li>
<li>Represent the USA partner ecosystem at regional events and partner forums; drive joint field marketing where it produces pipeline.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years experience in partner management, alliances, channel sales, or ecosystem roles within B2B SaaS.</li>
<li>Proven track record driving measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes through partners in an enterprise co-selling motion.</li>
<li>Experience working closely with Enterprise AEs on territory plans, account strategy, qualification, and complex deal execution.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of USA agency/SI landscape and enterprise digital transformation buying patterns (Australia-first a plus).</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, CS, RevOps).</li>
<li>Analytical rigor: comfortable defining KPIs, running partner reviews/QBRs, and using data to focus investments.</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills with credibility across executive, marketing, and technical audiences.</li>
<li>Comfortable operating autonomously in a fast-growth, remote-first environment.<br><br><br></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><em>U.S. Base Salary Range: $92,430 - $140,000<br></em></strong><br><em>At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS</strong></p>
<p><span>Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space</span></p>
<p><strong>GENERAL TERMS</strong></p>
<p><em>Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. <em>You can find more information about our privacy policy</em><strong><em>&nbsp;</em></strong><em><a class="c-link" href="https://www.storyblok.com/legal/applicants-privacy-policy">here</a></em><em>.</em></em></p>
<p>All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain (<a class="c-link" href="http://storyblok.com/">storyblok.com</a>).</p>
<p><em>Here is a sneak peek of&nbsp;</em><em><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yxinDgI-WVU">Storyblok’s Visual Editor</a></em></p>
<p><em>If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email <a class="c-link" href="mailto:talent.acquisition@storyblok.com">talent.acquisition@storyblok.com</a></em></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/storyblok-partner-manager-usa">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/storyblok-partner-manager-usa</a></p>

<p>

</p>

<p>BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.</p>
<p>Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.</p>
<p>The Role</p>
<p>Identify, generate, qualify, and close new business for customers and prospects in a defined territory.&nbsp; Responsible for managing the full sales lifecycle, building the go-to-market plan (including direct and indirect business).&nbsp; <em><strong>Territories you will be managing are: North Carolina, South Carolina and Tennessee for State and Local government entities.</strong></em></p>
<p>What You’ll Do</p>

<li>Attend corporate trade shows and events</li>

<li>Schedule and conduct product demonstrations and detailed presentations to prospects, customers and partners</li>
<li>Lead RFP responses for your accounts</li>
</ul>
<p>What You’ll Bring</p>

<li>Bachelor’s degree</li>
<li>8+ years’ sales experience with a demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding annual quota</li>
<li>Experience with enterprise software, IT services, SaaS, IoT or related managed services sales to global organizations</li>
<li>Experience with Salesforce</li>
<li>Able to command sales message and sale process</li>
<li>Experience leveraging the channel to drive business</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills</li>

<p>Nice To Have</p>
<ul>
<li>Prior experience selling PAM software solutions</li>
<li>Completed 2 professional sales training courses (Sandler, SPIN, DISC, TAS, or Miller)</li>

</ul>
<p>Better Together</p>
<p>Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.</p>
<p>We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who&nbsp;come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.</p>
<p>About Us</p>
<p>BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.<br><br>BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.</p>
<p>Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="http://www.beyondtrust.com/">www.beyondtrust.com</a>.&nbsp;</p>

      <title>Pinterest: Integrated Marketing Lead, UCAN Programming & Industry</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY, US; Remote, US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pinterest:</strong></p>
<p>Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.</p>
<p>Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-life/pinflex/">flexibility</a> to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.</p>
<p>At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.</p>
<p>Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process <a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-philosophy-on-ai-in-hiring/">here</a>.</p></div><p>Pinterest's Global Business Organization partners with advertisers, agencies and the wider industry to grow Pinterest's business. This role owns how Pinterest shows up with key industry associations and on the industry's biggest stages, from 3C Ventures, the IAB, the ANA and the MMA to marquee moments like CES and POSSIBLE. You'll be the connective tissue between Pinterest's leaders and the external industry across the U.S. and Canada, shaping visibility, influence and reputation across the advertising and marketing landscape.</p>
<p>What you'll do:</p>
<ul>
<li>Serve as Pinterest's day-to-day contact for key industry associations — including 3C Ventures, the IAB, the ANA and the MMA — leading memberships and commitments, delivering against contractual obligations, and finding new ways to grow Pinterest's visibility and influence within these organizations.</li>
<li>Know the industry and these associations inside and out: ensure Pinterest is getting the most value out of each membership, and recommend where to deepen, sustain or exit a relationship when it's no longer earning its keep.</li>
<li>Partner with Sales leadership to make sure membership benefits (introductions, visibility, data, access) are actually being used and translating into value for the business.</li>
<li>Inform Pinterest's speakership strategy and lead execution across key U.S. and Canada industry moments — including CES and POSSIBLE — sourcing, pitching and securing speaking opportunities that match the right Pinterest voices to the right stages and ladder up to business priorities.</li>
<li>Develop programming — talking points, fireside chats, client panels and more — for Pinterest's owned events and industry events across the U.S. and Canada.</li>
<li>Support programming for occasional agency events (e.g., WPP Stream) and large client moments, such as an executive panel at a major client's company-wide gathering or a top-five agency holding company event.</li>
<li>Prepare and support internal spokespeople and executives for speaking engagements, developing briefs, talking points and narratives in partnership with Comms to establish a consistent, compelling Pinterest story across every stage moment.</li>
<li>Partner with senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing and Comms to prioritize the highest-impact opportunities and reconcile competing perspectives.</li>
<li>Track, measure and report on the value and impact of memberships, event investments and speaking engagements, and use those insights to recommend where to deepen, sustain or exit commitments.</li>
<li>Use AI to accelerate research, speaker briefing prep, event planning and reporting, while applying judgment and verification to establish correctness and quality.</li>
</ul>
<p>What we're looking for:</p>
<ul>
<li>Minimum of 8 years of experience in integrated marketing, industry relations, communications or event marketing, with expertise in sourcing and shaping speaking opportunities at major industry events.</li>
<li>Experience managing industry association memberships or similar external relationships, including evaluating their value and making recommendations on where to invest or pull back.</li>
<li>Experience preparing spokespeople and executives for stage moments, including developing briefs, talking points and narratives in partnership with communications teams.</li>
<li>Experience leading the end-to-end delivery of events and activations, including sponsorships, panels, logistics, budgets and timelines across multiple moments at once.</li>
<li>Experience building effective relationships with senior stakeholders, including Sales leadership, and reconciling perspectives to prioritize the highest-impact work with limited guidance.</li>
<li>Expertise in written and verbal communication, with the ability to represent a company credibly to external organizations, clients and agency partners.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate research, briefing and reporting, with a clear approach to validating accuracy and quality.</li>
<li>Strong track record of critical evaluation and verification of AI-assisted work, with high integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables.</li>
<li>Willingness to travel for key industry events, client events and speaking engagements as needed.</li>
<li>Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as marketing or communications, or equivalent experience.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Relocation Statement:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>In-Office Requirement Statement:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.</li>
<li>This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/month and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>#LI-REMOTE<br>#LI-JH4</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.</p>
<p><em><span>Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found <a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/pinterest-life/">here</a>.</span></em></p></div><div class="title">US based applicants only</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$120,321</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$247,718 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Inclusion:</strong></p>
<div>Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete&nbsp;<a href="https://forms.gle/sS24D4WboEKUZMQK6">this form</a> for support.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><em>By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.</em></div></div>

    <item>
      <title>Mercury: Creative Director - Brand Narrative</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
</p>

<p>In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, <a href="https://eamesfoundation.org/work/powers-of-ten-and-the-relative-size-of-things-in-the-universe/"><em>Powers of Ten</em></a> traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together.<a href="https://eamesfoundation.org/work/powers-of-ten-and-the-relative-size-of-things-in-the-universe/">&nbsp;</a></p>
<p>That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable.</p>
<p>We’re looking for a <strong>Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative</strong>, a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work.</p>
<p><strong>Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting.</strong> What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling.</p>
<p><strong>You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing.</strong> Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off.</p>
<p>You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.</p>
<h3>What you’ll do</h3>
<p>In your first year, your focus will be roughly <strong>70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Originate and lead big creative ideas.</strong> Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. Develop ideas that can take distinctive forms across film, social, out-of-home, digital, experiences, and partnerships.</li>
<li><strong>Bring ambitious concepts to life with your creative peers and the full studio.</strong> Work side by side with the Brand Design and Writing leads and their teams from the earliest explorations through delivery. Develop ideas together, exchange thoughtful critique, and make creative choices that draw on each discipline’s expertise. Stay hands-on, contribute through your own craft, and partner closely with Motion and Production throughout. For film, remain closely involved through scripts, visual development, production, and the final edit.</li>
<li><strong>Build audience and distribution thinking into the idea.</strong> Shape concepts around how people will discover, watch, and share the work. Work with marketing partners to consider channels and viewing contexts from the beginning, so the work belongs where people encounter it rather than simply being resized to fit.</li>
<li><strong>Push beyond the first good answer, and learn quickly.</strong> Lead thoughtful concept development and critique. Use rough scripts, prototypes, and AI tools to test ideas quickly, learn, and move the strongest work forward. Know when to keep exploring and when to commit, then protect what makes an idea interesting through feedback and production.</li>
<li><strong>Find opportunities before a brief arrives.</strong> Bring curiosity about Mercury’s products, customers, and the wider world. Develop proactive ideas and cultural opportunities that give the brand something meaningful to say or do.</li>
<li><strong>Help decide where creative ambition matters most.</strong> Partner early with Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Product Design, Comms, and Insights. Help identify which moments deserve our largest creative investment, present recommendations to senior leadership, and use results from marketing and insights partners to inform what comes next.</li>
<li><strong>Build and lead Brand Narrative.</strong> Define the team’s purpose, priorities, creative standards, and ways of working. Help hire and develop the team, shaping its structure and capabilities. Set clear expectations, and coach people to grow their judgment and conceptual strength.</li>
<li><strong>Create a culture where the best idea wins.</strong> Make room for experimentation, honest feedback, and contributions across disciplines. Lead with generosity and conviction, share ownership of the work, and help people challenge one another without making creativity a competition for credit.</li>
<li><strong>Build practices that strengthen the work.</strong> Establish a clear path from insight and an agreed brief to concept and execution, with useful critique and close collaboration throughout. Develop relationships with external creatives and agencies who can add a distinctive perspective or capability when needed.</li>
</ul>
<h3>What you’ll bring</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>A strong creative foundation in art direction, design, or copywriting.</strong> Your portfolio shows original concepts developed into ambitious, well-crafted work across multiple formats. You can explain what you contributed, how the idea evolved, and how collaboration made it better.</li>
<li><strong>Deep film experience.</strong> You’ve developed film-led ideas from concept through production, with strong instincts for story, scripts, performance, pacing, and sound. You understand how these choices work together to make an audience feel something, not just make a film look good.</li>
<li><strong>A track record of deep creative collaboration with design and writing peers.</strong> You’ve led ambitious multidisciplinary work from concept through production by building trusted partnerships. You bring a clear point of view, listen closely, work through creative disagreements constructively, and recognize when someone else’s approach makes the work stronger. You can show how your collaborators shaped the outcome, not just what you personally originated.</li>
<li><strong>Strong taste, cultural awareness, and product curiosity.</strong> You can get close to a complex business or product, find the human truth within it, and turn that understanding into something clear, surprising, and memorable.</li>
<li><strong>Experience developing creative people and shaping how a team works.</strong> You give specific, useful feedback, set a high bar with care, and create an environment where people can take creative risks. You’re excited to build a new function, including the everyday practices that give it a culture.</li>
<li><strong>Clear communication and sound judgment.</strong> You can rally people around an ambitious concept, explain why it deserves investment, and navigate competing perspectives without losing the idea. You take ownership in ambiguous situations and balance creative ambition with the need to move work forward.</li>
</ul>
<h3>What success looks like</h3>
<p>A year in, you’ll have led major launches and film-led campaigns from original concept through finished work, with Brand Design and Writing as creative partners from the beginning. The studio’s disciplines will have shaped the work together, with audience and distribution informing the creative approach.</p>
<p>Brand Narrative will have a clear identity, shared creative standards, and working practices that help people test and develop stronger ideas together. Alongside planned launches, you’ll have established a pipeline of proactive opportunities that gives Mercury more ways to express its product ambition with originality and cultural relevance.</p>
<p>Please include a portfolio featuring film-led work and broader campaign concepts. We’d love to understand your role in developing the ideas, the choices you made through production, and how you brought the work to life with others.</p>
<p>Mercury values diversity &amp; belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. <p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.</p>
<p>Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU</strong></p>
<p>You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:</p>
<ul>
<li>Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)</li>
<li>Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding</li>
<li>Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays</li>
<li>Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material</li>
<li>The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers</li>
<li>As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules</li>
<li>An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals</li>
</ul></div><p><strong>JOB SUMMARY</strong></p>
<p>2025 was a banner year for Storyblok as the EMEA team exceeded all quarterly targets we are seeking to strengthen our operation with a Enterprise Account Executive who can bring high levels of experience in supporting clients to build exceptional digital experiences.</p>
<p>The ideal candidate will be an evangelist who can speak on behalf of Storyblok at events and has experience with DXP ecosystem selling. They should also have a strong GSI network and enthusiasm to mentor colleagues in the team.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Storyblok is forecasting another year of record-breaking growth in 2026. This will be driven by AI disruption in digital experience. As a headless CMS, Storyblok is best positioned to enable customers to expose their content accurately to generative search engines like ChatGPT. Our recent product launches of Storyblok FlowMotion and Strata also present a game-changing reimagination for DXPs in the AI era. Your role will be pivotal in helping digital and marketing leaders navigate this rapidly changing landscape.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Directly contribute to the expansion of the assigned region through the generation of new Enterprise clients</li>
<li>Value selling working directly with executive buyers including Chief Marketing Officers and Heads of Digital&nbsp;</li>
<li>Build and implement with an extended team a go-to-market plan to deliver maximum revenue potential for your territory</li>
<li>Work with and supporting the BDR &amp; Partner team in outbound sales activities&nbsp;</li>
<li>Lead potential new customers through the sales journey and presentation of Storyblok’s solutions</li>
<li>Own your pipeline: proactively prospect and generate the majority of your own opportunities, with top performers sourcing 100% of their pipeline themselves.</li>
<li>Nurture a small number of priority accounts to generate expansions into new divisions as well as product upsells from the launch of Storyblok FlowMotion and Strata in 2026</li>
<li>Negotiation of commercial offers for customers</li>
<li>Navigate through the legal and procurement process in complex B2B SaaS sales</li>
<li>Maintain a healthy relationship with existing clients and support Customer Success in upselling into existing accounts</li>
<li>Evangelize the Storyblok vision through product demonstrations, in-market events, and account specific initiatives</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Proven record of success in closing large and complex SaaS Enterprise deals over $200kAbility to map out and strategically define account &amp; territory plansFamiliarity with Sales methodologies like Challenger Sales, SPIN Selling, Sandler, MEDDIC etc.</li>
<li>5 years of proven SaaS solution selling experience as an Account Executive</li>
<li>Evidence of relationship building skills with an ability to grow and nurture relationships</li>
<li>Some technical knowledge of the CMS space and digital experience ecosystem</li>
<li>Ability to switch the context and messaging between technical and marketing audiences</li>
<li>Must be fluent in the local language of the territory (speaking and writing)</li>
<li>Travel primarily within the assigned region, to foster client relationships and participate in events that contribute to the growth and success of Storyblok</li>
<li>Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><em>U.S. Base Salary Range: $112,000 - $170,000&nbsp;</em></strong><br><br><em>At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. <p>All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain (<a class="c-link" href="http://storyblok.com/">storyblok.com</a>).</p>

<li>Excellent (verbal, written, visual) communication skills, with proven ability to develop and present compelling narratives to broad audiences</li>
<li>Strong business judgment, with an owners’ mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity</li>
<li>Experience in building trusted relationships and influencing senior stakeholders</li>
<li>Ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization; including getting into the details to “become the expert” on an area of focus, then upleveling and clearly articulating the “so what” for others.</li>
