      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Georgia</state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6630/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, California, United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://apollographql.com">https://apollographql.com</a>
</p>

<p>At Apollo GraphQL, we’re on a mission to make it radically easier for engineering teams to ship fast, reliable products and services on top of the world’s data, powering everything from web to mobile to agentic experiences..</p>
<p>We’re looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who loves stepping into business‑critical challenges and turning them into clear, elegant architectures that customers can’t wait to build. As a Senior SE, you’ll be the technical quarterback on some of our most important opportunities: partnering with prospects and customers to design and scale their supergraph on GraphOS, and helping them prove out real impact in production.</p>
<p>You’ll join a tight‑knit global SE team that collaborates closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering—so the work you do doesn’t just close deals, it directly shapes Apollo’s roadmap and how we show up in the market.</p>
<p>At its core, this role connects customer problems, Apollo’s capabilities, and value: uncovering the real problem, translating technical options into business outcomes, building technical confidence, and reducing buying risk.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Own complex technical evaluations</strong> for strategic new and existing accounts: lead discovery, workshops, and solution design to deeply understand customer APIs, architectures, and constraints, and turn them into clear required capabilities and technical win plans.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Design and present multi‑system solution architectures</strong> that show how Apollo’s supergraph, GraphOS, and tooling fit into modern cloud‑native environments —meeting customers where they are while charting a safe, future‑proof path forward.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Lead compelling, value‑focused demos and PoCs</strong>, translating complex technical capabilities into simple, business‑aligned stories for audiences ranging from lead developers and architects to VP/C‑suite decision makers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>De‑risk and win complex deals</strong> by anticipating and resolving technical blockers (security, compliance, integration, performance), building customer confidence that Apollo will work in their environment, and partnering with AEs on value‑based selling, and close strategy.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Partner tightly with Sales, CS, Product, and Engineering</strong>: act as a trusted advisor throughout the account lifecycle, feed structured field insight back into roadmap and positioning, and contribute reusable reference architectures, playbooks, and patterns that the broader team can use at scale.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Elevate the team through enablement and AI‑augmented workflows</strong>: mentor junior SEs, share best practices, and actively use AI tooling (including agentic/MCP‑based workflows) to improve discovery, architecture design, and demo/PoC execution.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Who you are</h2>
<p>You’re an experienced, hands‑on Solutions Engineer (or architect in a similar customer‑facing role) who loves sitting at the intersection of code, architecture, and commercial impact. You’re just as comfortable whiteboarding a distributed system with staff engineers as you are explaining the “so what?” to a VP of Engineering or CIO, and you thrive when you can roll up your sleeves on a PoC, earn technical trust, and guide a customer from “evaluation” to “we can’t imagine building without this.”</p>
<p>You see Solutions Engineering as part of the go‑to‑market engine: your purpose is not just to “be technical” but to help progress qualified opportunities toward successful outcomes—new ARR, healthy renewals, and meaningful expansions.</p>
<h2>Minimum requirements</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>4+ years</strong> in a pre‑sales Solutions Engineering or equivalent technical customer‑facing role (sales engineer, field engineer, customer engineer, or architect) working on complex B2B SaaS or infrastructure products.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Deep domain expertise around APIs and integration</strong>, with prior experience working both with teams who build APIs and with teams who consume them, integrating into existing architectures and tool stacks (CI/CD, observability, cloud, API gateways, etc.).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Strong architecture and integration skills across modern web/cloud stacks</strong>—comfortable discussing REST/GraphQL, microservices, identity/security, and data flows, and designing multi‑system architectures that can be implemented in real‑world environments.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Proven track record owning complex technical evaluations end‑to‑end</strong>, including discovery, solution design, PoC implementation guidance, objection handling, and technical win for enterprise or upper‑mid‑market accounts.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Executive‑level communication and storytelling skills</strong>: able to move fluidly between deep technical detail and clear business value for developers, architects, product leaders, and executives, and to act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Sales process and value‑based selling fluency</strong>: comfortable with MEDDPICC, team selling with AEs/CS, and framing Apollo’s capabilities in terms of commercial impact.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Collaborative, low‑ego teammate</strong> who works well across Sales, Product, Engineering, and CS, mentors less‑tenured SEs, and prefers creating reusable assets over one‑off work.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Nice to have</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Hands‑on GraphQL experience</strong>, ideally including schema design, federation, or operating production GraphQL services—whether from a previous SE role, as an engineer, or through meaningful side projects.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Background as a <strong>software engineer or architect</strong>, with the ability to read code, reason about performance and scalability trade‑offs, and pair productively with customer engineering teams.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience selling or implementing <strong>developer‑focused platforms</strong> (APIs, integration platforms, data/analytics, observability, or adjacent infra) into large or regulated enterprises.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Familiarity with common <strong>security, compliance, and networking</strong> topics that come up in enterprise evaluations (SSO, RBAC, data residency, SOC 2, VPC/networking patterns).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Comfort in <strong>fast‑moving, high‑growth environments</strong>, where you help shape the playbook (including via AI/agentic tooling) rather than just follow it, and enjoy contributing to content, enablement, and broader GTM strategy.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>About Apollo</h3>
<p>Apollo helps teams build, operate, and scale the graphs that power modern applications. If you’ve streamed a show, booked a trip, or read the news online, there’s a good chance Apollo was working quietly behind the scenes. We support some of the largest and most sophisticated GraphQL platforms in the world.</p>
<p>But we’re not here just to maintain the status quo. Apollo is redefining how software teams build and ship - bringing clarity, speed, and leverage to increasingly complex systems. Our platform gives teams a single, coherent way to connect clients, services, and now AI-powered experiences, without drowning in endpoints or bespoke integrations.</p>
<p>Just as importantly, we’re building a company where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers. That means meaningful ownership, smart teammates, and tackling hard problems that actually matter. If you like moving fast, thinking deeply, and helping shape what comes next, you’ll feel right at home here.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/apollo-graphql-senior-solution-engineer-pre-sales">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/apollo-graphql-senior-solution-engineer-pre-sales</a></p>
</description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.</p>
<p>We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.</p></div><p><strong>Why You’ll Love This Role</strong></p>
<p>The Cloud Partner Sales Manager builds and executes joint go-to-market plans with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role grows partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue by connecting Cribl’s sales teams with CSP field, executive, and technical organizations and advancing co-sell, marketplace, and customer adoption opportunities.</p>
<p>You will act as the key connector between internal enterprise sales teams and external CSP ecosystems. By cultivating executive, field sales, and technical relationships, you will align key cloud sales plays, oversee joint account mapping, and lead co-selling initiatives to drive top-line pipeline growth and customer adoption.</p>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<p>This is a remote role with a preference for candidates located in the Northeast.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p><strong><br>As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Alliance strategy and governance: </strong>Develop multi-year partner plans with shared goals, milestones, and KPIs. Track performance against Strategic Collaboration Agreements (SCAs), including revenue, cloud consumption, co-investment, and program benefits; identify risks and course corrections.</li>
<li><strong>Co-selling and pipeline:</strong> Own regional partner-driven and partner-influenced targets. Lead joint account mapping, deal registration, pipeline reviews, and forecasting with Cribl and CSP sales teams. Align CSP sales plays with Cribl solutions to improve win rates and deal velocity.</li>
<li><strong>Marketplace and consumption:</strong> Use AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplaces to simplify procurement and support customer cloud commitments. Partner with Sales, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to accelerate onboarding, adoption, and consumption.</li>
<li><strong>Enablement and demand generation:</strong> Equip Cribl and CSP field teams to position Cribl’s value and solutions. Partner with Marketing on co-marketing, demand generation, and field events.</li>
<li><strong>Executive alignment and reviews: </strong>Build relationships with CSP executives, sales leaders, and technical architects. Lead regular business reviews and executive briefings, sharing scorecards, pipeline insights, progress against commitments, and actions to strengthen the partnership.</li>
<li>We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><br>If You’ve Got It - We Want It</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>5–10+ years in enterprise software sales, business development, or strategic alliances in SaaS or the ISV ecosystem.</li>
<li>Track record of achieving or exceeding partner-sourced or co-sell revenue targets with major cloud providers.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of cloud ecosystems, marketplaces, co-sell programs (such as AWS ACE, Microsoft Partner Center, or GCP Partner Advantage), and consumption-based business models.</li>
<li>Ability to build executive relationships and influence matrixed sales organizations.</li>
<li>Strong strategic, analytical, communication, and presentation skills; able to manage complex joint pipelines and translate technical solutions into business value.</li>
<li>Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience preferred.</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-PL1<br>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.<br><br>In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.<br><br>In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$130,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$150,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Bring Your Whole Self<br></strong><span><br></span><span>Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.</span></p>
<p><span>Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at </span><a href="https://cribl.io/about-us/"><span>cribl.io/about-us</span></a><span>.&nbsp;</span></p></div>

      <title>Upsun: Director, Product-Led Growth</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote • Anywhere
</p>

<h1><span><strong>About Upsun</strong></span></h1>
<p><span>Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It’s built for hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and people focus on the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale with confidence, without wrestling with backend infrastructure.</span></p>
<p><span>Upsun Dispatch, our newest offering, brings that same idea to the whole team. It’s the platform for governed collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional humans. Agents handle the volume in isolated sandboxes. People make the decisions that matter, with every approval and every cost on the record.</span></p>
<p><span>We give you your time back. You get:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Predictable performance, even at scale</span></li>
<li><span>Secure, compliant environments by default</span></li>
<li><span>Real-time observability and profiling built in</span></li>
<li><span>Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds</span></li>
<li><span>AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>The name says it all. “Up” stands for uptime, reliability, and acceleration. “Sun” reflects our follow-the-sun support: a 24x7, globally distributed team keeping the lights on while you rest. We believe software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.</span></p>
<p><span>Upsunners are a remote, global team, and we thrive in a multicultural one. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment, and our people span the whole experience spectrum. What ties us together is curiosity, a thirst for knowledge, and an eagerness for new ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together when the environment frees you to do your best work.</span></p>
<p><span>Our values:</span><br><span> We make a positive impact.</span><br><span> We aim for the stars.</span><br><span> We care for each other.</span></p>
<h1><span><strong>Impact of a Director, Product-Led Growth</strong></span></h1>
<p><span>As Director, PLG, you’ll lead the strategy, execution, and commercial success of Upsun’s product-led revenue engine. Upsun is expanding its portfolio with <strong>Upsun Dispatch</strong>, a strategic new offer that joins Upsun Cloud, and this role will turn that expansion into measurable growth.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will own the revenue target for product-led experiences, building a scalable engine across developer recruitment, freemium conversion, and customer retention. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering, you will bridge technical platform capabilities with market-driven execution to scale Upsun’s global footprint.&nbsp;</span></p>
<h1><span><strong>What to expect</strong></span></h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Own product-led revenue:</strong> Be accountable for ARR from self-serve experiences, from first signup through conversion, expansion, and retention.&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Drive growth goals:</strong> Build and execute PLG programs to achieve clear top-line ARR milestones and hit aggressive user acquisition targets with specific focus in Europe and North America.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Connect growth and product:</strong> Partner closely with the Head of Growth (Marketing), Head of User Acquisition and Conversion (Marketing)&nbsp; and Upsun Dispatch Product Managers (Product/Engineering) to translate product strategy into measurable customer and business outcomes.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Optimize the funnel:</strong> Define in-product monetization levers, optimize self-service funnels, and partner with Sales to refine Product-Led Sales (PLS) handoffs for enterprise accounts.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Build tight feedback loops:</strong> Analyze intent data, user behavior, and churn metrics to continuously iterate on user onboarding, NPS, and lifetime value.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h1><span><strong>What you bring</strong></span></h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p><span><strong>PLG and growth leadership:</strong> A track record as a Senior Product Manager or Director with growth and commercial revenue responsibilities at a developer-focused, SaaS, or cloud platform company driven primarily by a PLG model.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Strategic judgment:</strong> Ability to turn complex developer platform capabilities into intuitive self-service user experiences that drive clear, measurable business value.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Cross-functional execution:</strong> A record of leading cross-functional growth initiatives across Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Data-driven approach:</strong> Hands-on depth in growth analytics, conversion funnels, freemium-to-paid activation, and retention.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Developer and AI fluency:</strong> Practical understanding of modern developer workflows, cloud infrastructure, and how AI-assisted development tools are reshaping user expectations.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h1><span><strong>Bonus points</strong></span></h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Dual-funnel experience:</strong> Running both self-serve funnels (PLG) and enterprise sales handoffs (PLS).</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Platform background:</strong> Cloud infrastructure, PaaS, DevOps, or developer platforms.</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span><strong>Global scale: </strong>Scaling product-led revenue across remote-first, international teams.</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h1><span><strong>Where we hire</strong></span></h1>
<p><span>At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in <strong>Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States</strong>. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.&nbsp;</span></p>
<h1><span><strong>How we hire</strong></span></h1>
<p><span>We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>You can expect <strong>5 interviews on Google Meet</strong> to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment.&nbsp;</span></p>
<ol>
<li><span>45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Chief Marketing Officer)</span></li>
<li><span>60 Minutes with Team (IC)<br></span></li>
<li><span>60 Minutes with Team (Head of Growth)</span></li>
<li><span>45 Minutes with Executive (CFO)</span></li>
</ol>
<p><em>All roles require background checks.</em></p>
<h1><span><strong>What we offer</strong></span></h1>
<p><span> <strong>A product you can believe in</strong> - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud <strong>B Corp</strong>.</span></p>
<p><span><strong> An Award-Winning Workplace</strong> - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.</span></p>
<p><span>️ <strong>A culture that values your voice </strong>- Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.</span></p>
<p><span> <strong>A global team </strong>- Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives</span></p>
<p><span><strong> </strong><strong>Benefits and perks</strong> - Make the most of what matters to you</span></p>
<blockquote>
<p> Flexible PTO</p>
<p> Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)</p>
<p> Company stock options</p>
<p> Professional development budget</p>
<p> Office equipment budget</p>
<p>‍️ Wellness budget</p>
<p> Annual team gatherings</p>
<p> Inclusive parental leave</p>
<p>️ Remote work travel program</p>
</blockquote>
<h1><span><strong>You belong here</strong></span></h1>
<p><span>At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. </span><span>If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.<br></span></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upsun-director-product-led-growth">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upsun-director-product-led-growth</a></p>
</description>

<h1 class="x1ll2q23 x1a4oops x132q4wb">Appointment Setter</h1>
<p class="x12ofw9d"><strong>Vechter Home Solutions</strong></p>
<h2 class="x1ll2q23 x1a4oops x132q4wb">Job Description</h2>
<p class="x12ofw9d">Vechter Home Solutions is seeking a motivated, personable, and goal-oriented Appointment Setter to join our team. In this role, you will make outbound calls to homeowners, introduce our company and the solutions we offer, and schedule appointments for homeowners interested in learning more about improving their homes.</p>
<p class="x12ofw9d">As the first point of contact, you will play an important role in connecting families with opportunities to create cleaner, healthier, and more energy-efficient living environments. The ideal candidate is a confident communicator who enjoys speaking with people, building rapport, and helping homeowners take the next step toward improving their homes.</p>
<p class="x12ofw9d">No matter your previous experience, we are looking for someone with a positive attitude, a strong work ethic, and a willingness to learn and grow with our team.</p>
<h2 class="x1ll2q23 x1a4oops x132q4wb">Key Responsibilities</h2>
<ul class="x12ofw9d">
<li>Make outbound calls to homeowners to introduce Vechter Home Solutions and our services.</li>
<li>Engage homeowners in friendly, professional conversations to understand their interests and needs.</li>
<li>Clearly communicate the benefits of our home improvement solutions and encourage homeowners to learn more.</li>
<li>Schedule appointments for interested homeowners to speak with our team and receive additional information.</li>
<li>Accurately record call outcomes, homeowner information, and appointment details in our system.</li>
<li>Follow established call scripts, communication guidelines, and scheduling procedures.</li>
<li>Maintain a positive, professional attitude while meeting daily and weekly appointment-setting goals.</li>
<li>Follow up with homeowners as needed to confirm appointments and maintain engagement.</li>
<li>Work collaboratively with team members to support company growth and deliver a positive homeowner experience.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="x1ll2q23 x1a4oops x132q4wb">Qualifications</h2>
<ul class="x12ofw9d">
<li>Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.</li>
<li>Comfortable speaking with homeowners over the phone.</li>
<li>Friendly, professional, and confident approach to conversations.</li>
<li>Reliable, punctual, and self-motivated.</li>
<li>Ability to stay organized and manage time effectively.</li>
<li>Willingness to learn about our services, processes, and appointment-setting techniques.</li>
<li>Goal-oriented mindset with the ability to work toward performance targets.</li>
<li>Previous experience in appointment setting, customer service, telemarketing, or sales is a plus, but not required.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="x1ll2q23 x1a4oops x132q4wb">What We’re Looking For</h2>
<p class="x12ofw9d">We want team members who bring energy, professionalism, and a genuine desire to help people. Successful Appointment Setters are comfortable starting conversations, listening to homeowners, handling questions respectfully, and creating a positive first impression of our company.</p>
<p class="x12ofw9d">If you enjoy talking with people, thrive in a goal-driven environment, and want an opportunity to develop valuable communication and sales skills, this could be a great fit for you.</p>
<h2 class="x1ll2q23 x1a4oops x132q4wb">Why Join Vechter Home Solutions?</h2>
<ul class="x12ofw9d">
<li>Opportunity to grow your communication, customer service, and sales skills.</li>
<li>Training and guidance to help you learn the role and succeed.</li>
<li>A team-focused environment that values effort, professionalism, and results.</li>
<li>The opportunity to help connect families with solutions designed to support cleaner, healthier, and more energy-efficient homes.</li>
<li>Potential for professional growth as you develop your skills and experience.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="x1ll2q23 x1a4oops x132q4wb">Join Our Team</h2>
<p class="x12ofw9d">At Vechter Home Solutions, our Appointment Setters help open the door to better home solutions by connecting homeowners with the information and support they need. If you are motivated, dependable, and ready to make a difference one conversation at a time, we encourage you to apply!</p>

<p>

<div>
<p>Lucid Software is the leader in AI-driven work acceleration, helping teams see and build the future by turning ideas into reality.&nbsp; Its products include the Lucid Visual Collaboration Suite (Lucidchart and Lucidspark) and airfocus. The Lucid Visual Collaboration Suite, combined with powerful accelerators for cloud and process transformation, empowers organizations to streamline work, foster alignment, and drive business transformation at scale. We hold true to our core values: innovation in everything we do, passion &amp; excellence in every area, individual empowerment, initiative and ownership, and teamwork over ego. At Lucid, we value diverse perspectives and are dedicated to creating an environment and culture that is respectful and inclusive for everyone. Lucid is a hybrid workplace. We promote a healthy work-life balance by allowing employees to work remotely, from one of our offices, or a combination of the two depending on the needs of the role and team.</p>
<p>Lucid Software is ranked #13 on the list of most used business applications among Fortune 500 businesses, and some of the world's largest organizations, such as Google, GE, Siemens, VW, NBC Universal, JLR and T-Mobile, rely on Lucid's solutions to accelerate critical business workflows across product design, process planning, team and infrastructure visualisation. The company boasts more than 100 million users. Despite already having such a dominant position in the market, Lucid is continuing to grow at pace and is acquiring hundreds of thousands of new users each month.</p>
<p><strong>This is an Evergreen/Future Opportunities job posting. By applying, you are expressing interest in upcoming openings on our NA Enterprise team. If your background aligns with our core profile, a member of our Recruiting team will reach out for an informal conversation to explore your career goals and match you with the right team as roles open up.</strong></p>
<p>We’re looking for a strategic, high-performing Enterprise Expansion Account Executive (EAE) to unlock growth within our most valuable customers. This is a chance to shape how the world’s most recognizable companies collaborate, innovate, and transform.&nbsp;As an EAE, you’ll own the strategy and execution across some of Lucid’s largest accounts, driving meaningful impact for our customers while growing deep, lasting partnerships. You’ll have the autonomy to run complex enterprise deals while working alongside an elite team of BDRs, CSMs, and Solutions Engineers who share your drive for excellence.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Lead growth in your territory:</strong> Expand enterprise accounts through a blend of growth, renewals, and strategic new opportunities</li>
<li><strong>Be a trusted advisor:</strong> Partner with senior leaders at Fortune 500 companies to understand their goals and help them scale Lucid across the enterprise</li>
<li><strong>Drive complex, high-impact deals:</strong> Navigate multi-threaded sales cycles and craft win-win negotiations that elevate customer success</li>
<li><strong>Build powerful relationships:</strong> Create champions at all levels of the organization through consultative selling and thought leadership</li>
<li><strong>Coach and collaborate:</strong> Mentor your assigned BDR and collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams to deliver exceptional value</li>
<li><strong>Stay connected:</strong> Travel as needed (1–3 weeks per quarter) to strengthen customer relationships in person</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>10+ years of sales experience in tech/SaaS (as an Account Executive, Account Manager, or similar role), with 5+ years specifically selling complex enterprise software solutions and managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles</li>
<li>A proven track record of exceeding quotas</li>
<li>Strong knowledge of SaaS/cloud applications and their business value</li>
<li>Ability to collaborate across functions and lead cross-team sales efforts</li>
<li>Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills</li>
<li>Strength in prospecting, territory planning, and consultative selling</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Based in the Eastern US</li>
<li>Advanced skills in Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, and other sales enablement tools</li>
<li>Proven experience utilizing MEDDPICC or similar value-based selling methodology to address complex customer needs in enterprise sales</li>
<li>Passion for SaaS and the future of work</li>
</ul>
</div>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p>
<p><span>Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers.</p>
<p><strong><span>This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.</span></strong></p>
<p><strong>You should apply if:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li>
<li><strong>Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting:</strong> The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.</li>
<li><strong>You have innate curiosity in how businesses work:</strong> One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>You are a life-long learner: </strong>Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>You build genuine relationships with your customers: </strong>The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.</li>
<li><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong>Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>In this role, you will:&nbsp;</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.</li>
<li>Generate pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, as well as receive inbound leads from our account development team.</li>
<li>Target accounts with 11-30 vehicles.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience handling and owning transactional sales process with high volume demands.</li>
<li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Minimum requirements for this role:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>1+ years of experience in a closing sales role</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>An ideal candidate has:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Proven track record of consistent quota achievement</li>
<li>Experience selling in the commercial space - small to medium deals sizes</li>
<li>Experience with high-volume cold calling</li>
<li>Experience in fast-paced, transactional sales</li>
<li>Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process</li>
<li>SFDC familiarity</li>
</ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span>The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.</span></p>
<p><span>Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.</span></p></div><div class="title">Annual OTE Salary</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$106,050</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$151,500 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p>
<p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p>
<p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p>
<p><strong>Flexible Working&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><span>At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p>
<p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p>
<p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p>
<p><strong>Accommodations&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a href="mailto:accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com">accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com</a> or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p>
<p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p>
<p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s <a href="https://www.samsara.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information.</p>
<p><strong>Fraudulent Employment Offers</strong></p>
<p>Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our&nbsp;<a href="https://samsara.com/blog/avoiding-fake-job-offers">blog post here</a>.</p></div>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, United States
</p>

<h2><strong>Alloy is where you belong!</strong></h2>
<p>Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.<br><br>Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of <a href="https://www.inc.com/profile/alloy_ny">Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces</a>, <a href="https://www.forbes.com/companies/alloy/?list=americas-best-startup-employers&amp;sh=55c076453c61">Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers</a>, <a href="https://www.americanbanker.com/list/best-places-to-work-in-fintech-2022">Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker</a>, year after year.<br><br>Check out our investors and read more about us <a href="https://www.alloy.com/about">here</a>.</p>
<h2><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h2>
<p>This Senior Solutions Engineering role, similar to a Sales Engineering or Solutions Consultant role, sits within Alloy's pre-sales organization. You will be a partner who works closely with your account executive to close deals. While an account executive is managing the relationship and taking care of the business requirements, you will work closely with technical stakeholders to clear any technical hurdles. This includes custom demos, building and walking through UAT environments, designing and managing proof of concept exercises, architecture and security reviews, and ultimately scoping out your proposed solution to hand over to the implementation team.</p>
<h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>4+ years experience in a technical presales role, e.g. Sales Engineer/Solutions engineer/Solution consultant or similar, supporting complex enterprise level pre sales motions</li>
<li>Experience working with identity and fraud in the Fintech/Banking space</li>
<li>Superior presentation skills and a proven ability to convey intricate technical requirements and ideas to both tech savvy and business-minded audiences</li>
<li>Experience listening first and asking targeted followup questions</li>
<li>Experience and comfort being the bridge between sales, product, engineering, and professional services</li>
<li>Experience reading and understanding object-oriented code. Scripting/coding ability not required but a huge plus!</li>
<li>Experience working with APIs, including but not limited to making API calls using cURL, Postman, or related technologies</li>
<li>Comfort working in ambiguity while maintaining integrity</li>
<li>Familiarity with single/multi tenant, SSO, resiliency and encryption in AWS is a plus</li>
<li>Experience creating and running POCs with large datasets is a plus</li>
</ul>
<h2>Benefits and Perks!</h2>
<ul>
<li>Unlimited PTO and flexible work policy</li>
<li>Employee stock options</li>
<li>Medical, dental, vision plans with HSA (monthly employer contribution) and FSA options</li>
<li>401k with 100% match up to 4% of annual employee compensation&nbsp;</li>
<li>Eligible new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave&nbsp;</li>
<li>Home office stipend for new employees</li>
<li>Annual Learning &amp; Development annual stipend</li>
<li>Well-being benefits include access to ClassPass, OneMedical, and Spring Health&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately and opportunities for growth are abundant at our scaling company. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?</p>
<p>Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!</p>
<p><em>This position has a salary range of $160,000 to $185,000 base, plus a 70/30 split between base + variable compensation structure.</em></p>
<h2><strong>How to Apply</strong></h2>
<p><span>Apply right here. You've found the application!</span></p>
<p>Alloy is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and employer. We’re committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience and provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with visible and invisible disabilities. We encourage applicants to share needed accommodations with their recruiter.</p>
<p>All Alloy jobs are listed on our careers page. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an <a href="http://alloy.com/">alloy.com</a> email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you’re ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/alloy-senior-solutions-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/alloy-senior-solutions-engineer</a></p>

      <title>Pendo: Sr. Product Marketing Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<h2>The Team + The Role</h2>
<p>Pendo's Product Marketing team translates what we build into why it matters. The team works at the intersection of product, revenue, and marketing, owning the narratives, positioning, and go-to-market motions that drive pipeline and commercial outcomes. It operates as a small, senior team with high ownership, low overhead, and a strong bias toward work that moves the business forward.</p>
<p>Pendo is looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager to play a key role in our growing Enterprise business. You will partner closely across Product, Sales, and Marketing to package and position Pendo's offerings as powerful solutions for Enterprise clients. This is an individual contributor role for a builder who can create, test, adapt, and make an immediate impact in a fast-moving, AI-native environment.</p>
<p>This is a remote role in the United States. We have offices in San Francisco, CA, Raleigh, NC, or New York, NY.</p>
<h2>What this looks like day-to-day</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Enterprise positioning:</strong> Own and maintain clear, concise, and impactful solutions messaging for the Enterprise market. Translate Pendo's product capabilities into value-driven narratives that resonate with Enterprise buyers.</li>
<li><strong>Cross-functional partnership:</strong> Collaborate strategically with Product, PMM, Sales, and Marketing teams to package and position Pendo's offerings for Enterprise clients. Serve as a key conduit between Enterprise go-to-market teams and Product by bringing field feedback into product conversations.</li>
<li><strong>Flexible execution:</strong> Move fluidly across adjacent work as priorities shift, including solutions marketing, growth-hacker-style experiments, and demand-gen support. Adapt quickly rather than staying in a single fixed lane.</li>
<li><strong>AI-enabled GTM:</strong> Leverage AI tools and workflows, including building agents, to accelerate research, content creation, and go-to-market execution. Use AI as a practical multiplier for how you work and what you ship.</li>
<li><strong>Market research:</strong> Conduct in-depth research to define, understand, and articulate the distinct needs and opportunities within the Enterprise landscape for Pendo. Use that insight to shape messaging, campaign direction, and sales conversations.</li>
<li><strong>Sales partnership:</strong> Forge strong partnerships with the Enterprise Sales team to understand their requirements, challenges, and revenue opportunities. Participate in strategic Enterprise deals by providing product and solutions expertise.</li>
<li><strong>Testing and iteration:</strong> Rapidly test, learn, and adapt messaging and campaigns in a fast-changing environment. Use feedback from the market, Sales, and Product to improve the work quickly.</li>
<li><strong>Enterprise content:</strong> Develop compelling content and collateral for Enterprise audiences, including presentations, white papers, and case studies. Ensure materials are clear, persuasive, and aligned to the needs of Enterprise buyers.</li>
<li><strong>Enterprise strategy support:</strong> Elevate and accelerate Pendo's overall Enterprise marketing strategy and execution. Contribute strategically to competitive intelligence, pricing considerations, and enablement programs tailored for the Enterprise market.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Who You Are</h2>
<p>Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.</p>
<p>You're a builder, not a maintainer.</p>
<p>You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Sr. Product Marketing Managers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.</p>
<p>You're AI-curious - genuinely.</p>
<p>You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.</p>
<h2>Must-haves</h2>
<ul>
<li>A proven track record of building and shipping product marketing work, with depth of ownership that matters more than the number of years in seat.</li>
<li>Experience creating, testing, and adapting product marketing work in fast-moving, high-growth, startup, or similarly ambiguous environments.</li>
<li>AI fluency, including comfort working in an AI-shaped environment and using AI tools or workflows to improve research, content creation, and execution.</li>
<li>Ability to operate in ambiguity, move across shifting priorities, and flex into adjacent areas such as solutions marketing, growth, and demand generation.</li>
<li>Exceptional ability to translate technical product features into compelling, value-driven solutions for buyers.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, and developing targeted messaging.</li>
<li>Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively across Product, Sales, and Marketing teams.</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively.</li>
<li>Ability to travel occasionally.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Nice-to-haves</h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience building AI agents or workflows to accelerate product marketing or go-to-market work.</li>
<li>Experience supporting Enterprise marketing, Enterprise sales motions, or strategic Enterprise deals.</li>
<li>Experience contributing to competitive intelligence, pricing considerations, or enablement programs tailored for Enterprise markets.</li>
<li>Experience developing Enterprise-facing collateral such as presentations, white papers, and case studies.</li>
</ul>
<h2>About Pendo</h2>
<p>Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.</p>
<p><strong>Pendo Core Values:</strong> Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.</p>
<p><strong>Location:</strong> We welcome remote candidates for this role! If you happen to live near one of our office hubs, you’re always welcome to join our hybrid team in person a few days a week, but living near an office is not required for this position.</p>
<p><strong>Compensation:</strong> The expected salary range for this role to be performed in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY is $145,400 - $175,000, and in Raleigh, NC is $132,200 - $159,000.</p>
<p><strong>Benefits:</strong> Pendo offers highly competitive, employer-heavy coverage in the United States, including $0 premium options, strong 401(k) match, equity, and flexible time off.</p>
<p><strong>EEOC:</strong> We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.</p>
<p><strong>Accessibility:</strong> Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require an accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to: accommodation@pendo.io. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pendo-sr-product-marketing-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pendo-sr-product-marketing-manager</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Tebra: Senior Benefits Administrator</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@<a class="c-link" href="http://tebra.com/">tebra.com</a>, @<a class="c-link" href="http://patientpop.com/">patientpop.com</a>, or @<a class="c-link" href="http://kareo.com/">kareo.com</a>) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse.&nbsp;We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.</p></div><h1>About the Role</h1>
<p>We are seeking an experienced and analytical Senior Benefits Administrator to oversee the day-to-day administration and strategic alignment of our health and welfare plans. Reporting directly to the HR Operations Director, this role plays a pivotal part in managing our self-insured medical plan, monitoring plan performance, managing Third-Party Administrator (TPA) relationships, and ensuring compliance across all health and welfare offerings (medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401K and wellness).</p>
<p>The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in ERISA, HIPAA, and ACA compliance, strong data analytics capabilities to evaluate claim trends, and exceptional employee communication skills to deliver a seamless experience.</p>
<h1>Your Area of Focus</h1>
<h3><strong>Self-Insured Plan Oversight &amp; Financial Management</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Claims Analysis &amp; Tracking: Monitor ongoing medical and prescription drug claims performance; identify trends, high-cost claimants, and cost-driver patterns in partnership with plan actuaries and brokers.</li>
<li>Stop-Loss Administration: Coordinate stop-loss policy renewals, track claims reaching individual/aggregate stop-loss thresholds, and submit reimbursement filings to carriers.</li>
<li>TPA &amp; Vendor Governance: Oversee relationships with Third-Party Administrators (TPAs), Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs), and Benefits broker and carriers. Ensure operational execution according to SLAs.</li>
<li>Funding &amp; Reconciliations: Partner with Payroll and Accounting to manage weekly/monthly billing, claims funding requests, reserve requirements (IBNR tracking), and employee contribution and invoice reconciliations.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Health &amp; Welfare Plan Administration</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Open Enrollment: Lead the annual Open Enrollment process, including system updates, open enrollment communications, employee informational sessions, and post-enrollment audits.</li>
<li>Life Events &amp; Ongoing Administration: Manage day-to-day enrollment changes, qualifying life events (QLEs), dependent eligibility verifications, and COBRA processing.</li>
<li>Disability &amp; Leave Coordination: Support short-term/long-term disability programs and align benefit premiums during active FMLA/LOA periods.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Compliance &amp; Governance</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Regulatory Reporting: Ensure strict compliance with federal and state regulations, including ERISA, ACA (1094/1095 reporting), HIPAA, COBRA, and FMLA.</li>
<li>Plan Documentation: Maintain updated Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs), Summaries of Benefits and Coverage (SBCs), Plan Documents, and Form 5500 filings.</li>
<li>Nondiscrimination Testing: Coordinate annual 105(h) and Section 125 nondiscrimination testing with third-party compliance specialists.</li>
<li>Annual Benefits Audits: Lead annual 401K audit and execute dependent eligibility and enrollment audits throughout the year.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Employee Experience &amp; Communications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Escalated Claims Support: Act as the primary point of contact for complex, escalated employee claims issues, serving as an advocate while maintaining plan governance.</li>
<li>Benefits Communication: Draft clear, accessible employee communications explaining self-insured plan features, cost-saving tools (e.g., telehealth, centers of excellence), and wellness incentive initiatives.</li>
</ul>
<h1>Your Professional Qualifications</h1>
<h3><strong>Education &amp; Experience</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).</li>
<li>5 years of direct experience dedicated to health &amp; welfare plan administration.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience managing self-insured / self-funded medical plans, including working with stop-loss insurance, TPAs, and PBMs.</li>
<li>Professional Certifications (Preferred): CEBS (Certified Employee Benefit Specialist), SHRM-CP/SHRM-SCP, or PHR/SPHR.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Technical &amp; Analytical Skills</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>HRIS Proficiency: Experience administering benefits using Workday.</li>
<li>Data &amp; Excel Mastery: Advanced skills in MS Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data modeling) to analyze large sets of claims and census data.</li>
<li>Regulatory Depth: Deep functional knowledge of ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, COBRA, and IRS Section 125 rules.</li>
</ul>

      <title>PlanetScale: Brand Designer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - USA
</p>

<p>PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess/MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all sizes.</p>
<p>PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher.</p>
<p>We're looking for a Brand Designer to help shape and evolve the visual identity of PlanetScale across all touchpoints. In this role, you'll be a key member of our Marketing team, translating complex technical concepts into compelling visual stories that resonate with developers and technical decision-makers. You'll craft everything from in-person event experiences to web graphics, merch designs, and creative website assets that make databases feel exciting.</p>
<h2>What's the job to be done?</h2>
<p><strong>Visual Brand Development</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Design web graphics including technical diagrams, illustrations, and interactive visual assets that simplify complex database concepts.</li>
<li>Create compelling visual systems for campaigns, product launches, and marketing initiatives.</li>
<li>Design for multiple formats and contexts: digital, print, experiential, and merchandise.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>In-Person Experiences</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Design booth graphics, signage, and environmental branding for conferences, meetups, and community events.</li>
<li>Collaborate with the events team to create memorable, on-brand experiences that stand out</li>
<li>Design merch that developers actually want to wear and use.</li>
<li>Create branded collateral including banners, posters, stickers, and promotional materials.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Website and Digital Assets</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Design creative website components and landing pages.</li>
<li>Design data visualizations and technical diagrams that make complex information accessible.</li>
<li>Create social media graphics, blog post imagery, and other digital marketing assets.</li>
<li>Develop templates and design systems that enable the team to move quickly.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Brand Evolution</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Collaborate with marketing leadership to evolve and expand the PlanetScale brand identity.</li>
<li>Explore new visual directions while maintaining brand coherence.</li>
<li>Document design decisions and maintain brand guidelines.</li>
</ul>
<h2>These attributes best describe you.</h2>
<ul>
<li>A strong portfolio demonstrating versatile design skills across digital, print, and experiential design.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of design fundamentals: typography, color, composition, and visual hierarchy.</li>
<li>You've figured out where AI actually helps in a design workflow and built process around it.</li>
<li>Comfortable working in both brand and production modes. You can think big picture and execute in the details.</li>
<li>Strong communication skills with the ability to both articulate design decisions and understand direction.</li>
<li>Self-directed and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines.</li>
<li>Collaborative spirit with the ability to incorporate feedback while maintaining creative vision.</li>
</ul>
<h2>What else will help you be successful.</h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience designing for technical or developer-focused brands.</li>
<li>Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and other design tools.</li>
<li>Comfortable using AI to build a working first draft of a page rather than handing off a static mockup.</li>
<li>Understanding of design systems and component-based thinking.</li>
<li>Enthusiasm for learning about databases, infrastructure, and developer tools.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Why PlanetScale</h2>
<p>We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Brand Designer, you'll help shape how developers and engineering leaders perceive and interact with PlanetScale, translating the power of our platform into visual experiences that inspire and inform. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.</p>
<p>At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.</p>
<p>If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!</p>
<h2>Total Compensation and Pay Transparency</h2>
<p>An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.</p>
<p><strong>Base salary range:</strong> $170,000 - $220,000 USD</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Phoenix, AZ
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://www.atomicaz.com">http://www.atomicaz.com</a>
</p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><strong><span>REMOTE JOB OPPORTUNITY</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><strong><span>Bilingual Social Media Content Creator &amp; Customer Service Assistant</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><strong><span>Atomic Flooring / Atomic Construction</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal">Location: Remote — Latin America preferred<br>Pay: $250 USD per week<br>Schedule: Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week<br>Languages: Excellent English required; Spanish fluency strongly preferred</p>
<h2>About Our Company</h2>
<p class="MsoNormal">Atomic Flooring is a growing flooring and construction company serving the Phoenix, Arizona market. We help homeowners transform their spaces with quality flooring and professional service. We’re looking for a creative, dependable, and organized remote team member to help grow our online presence, create engaging social media content, communicate with potential customers, and manage incoming sales leads.</p>
<h2>What You’ll Do</h2>
<h2>Social Media Content Creation</h2>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpFirst"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Turn photos and video clips we provide into attractive, professional social media content.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Create short-form videos and Reels featuring completed flooring projects, before-and-after transformations, and product highlights.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Add captions, text overlays, music, transitions, and branding to make content engaging.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Create graphics, promotional posts, and special offers using tools such as Canva.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Write compelling captions in English, with Spanish content when appropriate.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Help manage our Facebook and Instagram accounts and maintain a consistent posting schedule.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Develop creative ideas for showcasing our work and attracting new customers.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Repurpose existing photos and videos into multiple pieces of marketing content.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpLast"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Monitor engagement and recommend ways to improve content and reach.</p>
<h2>Customer Service &amp; Lead Management</h2>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpFirst"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Respond promptly to incoming leads from our website, social media, text messages, and other sources.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Communicate professionally with potential customers by text, phone, email, and messaging apps.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Follow up with prospects who have requested information or estimates.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Ask basic questions about customers’ flooring projects and gather information our sales team needs.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Schedule estimates and appointments for our team.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Keep customer information and follow-up activities organized.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpLast"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Provide a friendly, professional customer experience that reflects our company well.</p>
<h2>Administrative &amp; Marketing Support</h2>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpFirst"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Assist with promotions, marketing campaigns, and business development.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Help organize leads, appointments, and customer communications.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Research marketing ideas, trends, and opportunities.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpMiddle"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Assist with administrative tasks as our business grows.</p>
<p class="MsoListBulletCxSpLast"><span><span>·<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span>Take initiative and help improve our marketing and customer service processes.</p>
<h2>Qualifications</h2>
<p class="MsoNormal"><strong>Required</strong></p>
