      <title>Customer.io: Mid-Market Account Executive, EMEA</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> EMEA Remote
</p>

<p>Hello, I’m Ricci, Sales Manager at&nbsp;<a href="http://customer.io/">Customer.io</a> in EMEA! We're expanding our sales team in the <strong>United Kingdom and Ireland</strong> and seeking motivated and successful Account Executives at the Mid-Market level to join us! This role offers a unique opportunity to take your sales career to the next level, with potential for upward mobility.</p>
<p>As an Account Executive, you’ll represent&nbsp;<a href="http://customer.io/">Customer.io</a>&nbsp;to prospective customers and drive growth within key market segments. This is a full-cycle sales role (prospect, demo, close), where you'll be fielding both inbound and outbound demand.</p>
<h3>About&nbsp;<a href="http://customer.io/">Customer.io</a></h3>
<p>Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day.&nbsp;<a href="http://customer.io/">Customer.io</a>&nbsp;powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.</p>
<h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Pipeline Development and Management</strong>: Build and manage a pipeline through self-sourced leads and SDR-supported leads to drive new customer acquisition.</li>
<li><strong>Full-Cycle Sales Execution</strong>: Lead the entire sales process from prospecting and discovery through demo and closing for deals typically under $50,000 ACV, focusing solely on new business acquisition within targeted accounts.</li>
<li><strong>Customer Needs Analysis and Solution Alignment</strong>: Conduct discovery calls to understand customer business challenges and goals. Position&nbsp;<a href="http://customer.io/">Customer.io</a>'s solutions to meet these needs effectively.</li>
<li><strong>Collaboration and Cross-Functional Feedback</strong>: Work closely with the SDR team for lead quality feedback and collaborate with Customer Success and Technical Support for a smooth hand-off post-sale.</li>
<li><strong>Performance Tracking and Reporting</strong>: Own and report on individual sales metrics, including pipeline status and progress towards targets, to support informed decision-making.</li>
<li><strong>High-Volume Prospecting</strong>: Engage in consistent cold and warm outreach to build and maintain a healthy top-of-funnel pipeline.</li>
<li><strong>Client Relationship Development</strong>: Nurture relationships within mid-sized accounts to uncover business needs and drive growth opportunities.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Qualifications</strong>:</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Experience:</strong>&nbsp;2+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B SaaS or MarTech sales, handling mid-market accounts</li>
<li><strong>Location:</strong> We are currently hiring for positions based in the UK and Ireland. Candidates must be located in one of these regions to be considered for the role.</li>
<li><strong>B2B SaaS or MarTech Experience</strong>: Proven success in&nbsp;<strong>new customer acquisition</strong>&nbsp;and closing deals within the B2B SaaS space, preferably MarTech</li>
<li><strong>Sales Methodology</strong>: Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar framework that supports consultative selling and discovery to close.</li>
<li><strong>Communication Skills</strong>: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and engaging presence to build rapport with new prospects.</li>
<li><strong>Problem Solving</strong>: Strong ability to identify customer business needs and position relevant solutions effectively to drive acquisition</li>
<li><strong>Deal Focus</strong>: Primarily handles mid-market accounts with shorter sales cycles and lower ACV deals</li>
<li><strong>Support</strong>: Works closely with our SDR team for lead generation, with a balance between inbound and self-sourced opportunities</li>
</ul>
<h3>Compensation &amp; Benefits</h3>
<p>We believe in transparency. We are offering a compensation package of $95,000 base + $95,000 variable for a total $190,000 OTE USD (or equivalent in local currency), subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.</p>
<p>We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including&nbsp;<strong>100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family</strong>. We also offer&nbsp;<strong>16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO</strong>, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.</p>
<p><a href="https://customer.io/careers#:~:text=our%20collective%20success.-,BENEFITS,-Our%C2%A0">See full benefits here →</a></p>
<h3>Our Process</h3>
<p>No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.</p>
<ol>
<li>30-minute video call with Recruiter</li>
<li>45-minute video call with Hiring Manager</li>
<li>60-minute Mock Call w/ Hiring Team</li>
</ol>
<p>All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.</p>
<p><a href="http://customer.io/">Customer.io</a>&nbsp;recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.</p>
<p>Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact&nbsp;<a href="mailto:jobs@customer.io">jobs@customer.io</a>.</p>
<h3><strong>Join us!</strong></h3>
<p>Check out our&nbsp;<a href="https://customer.io/careers/">careers page</a>&nbsp;for more information about why you should&nbsp;<a href="https://customer.io/about/">come work with us!</a>&nbsp;We are passionate about our core values of Empathy, Transparency, Responsibility, and Awkwardness and are looking for new coworkers to share and build that passion!</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-mid-market-account-executive-emea">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-mid-market-account-executive-emea</a></p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - USA
</p>

<h2>About the Role</h2>
<p>Cybercrime doesn't wait for anyone to catch up to it, and neither do we. As a second-line sales leader reporting to the VP of Enterprise Sales, you'll own the sales teams across your defined area, overseeing multiple frontline Sales Leaders and their teams, with a mandate to overachieve new annual recurring revenue quota for the region, not just meet it.</p>
<p>You'll be leading through one of the more exciting stretches in the company's history: we're growing 40%+ year over year, protecting more than 4,500 customers including over 25% of the Fortune 500, and expanding fast from email into identity, AI security, and insider threat. That means your teams have more surface area to sell, more room to build, and more impact to make than they would leading an area at a mature market leader.</p>
<h2>What You Will Do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Work with your leaders and their teams to run the full deal cycle on named enterprise accounts (&gt;3k mailbox organizations): first conversation, contract signature, and the upsell conversations that follow once they're a customer.</li>
<li>Recruit and hire a world-class team of enterprise sellers and leaders, on time and on budget, meeting the area's projected productive capacity and building a bench of future candidate relationships so you're never caught flat-footed by team changes.</li>
<li>Set clear productivity metrics and growth milestones for your leaders and sellers, and enable them to consistently hit them.</li>
<li>Instill a disciplined approach to pipeline generation, activating every resource available: field sales, marketing, channel partners, and sales development, to accelerate new business.</li>
<li>Build the sales execution strategy for your area and drive the execution and collaborative team selling that brings it to life.</li>
<li>Lead a data-driven business that develops each Leader and Account Executive in the areas that matter most for their skillset and their NARR results.</li>
<li>Partner closely with Sales Engineering Leadership to deliver outstanding product demonstrations and a repeatable proof-of-concept program, especially as our platform expands beyond email into identity, AI security, and insider threat.</li>
<li>Maintain and deepen relationships with key customers around value realization and retention: high renewal rates, fast upsell expansion, and strong referrals.</li>
<li>Forecast monthly and quarterly revenue to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and a consistent forecast methodology.</li>
<li>Grow strategic relationships with existing channel partners while developing new ones.</li>
<li>Run Quarterly Business Reviews that give a clear read on sales productivity, plan execution, and progress against strategic objectives.</li>
<li>Be the customer's advocate inside Abnormal, working with Sales Engineering, Product, and Marketing to get the right things prioritized so more revenue closes.</li>
<li>Identify, cultivate, and close new business at the executive level (CISO/CIO/CTO) in enterprise accounts across your designated territory.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Must Haves</h2>
<ul>
<li>10+ years of Enterprise Sales experience with a demonstrated track record of exceeding quota selling security, networking, and/or software solutions.</li>
<li>5+ years leading a sales team focused on new business and new logo growth, including 2+ years of second-line leadership experience managing frontline sales managers, not individual contributors directly.</li>
<li>Proven ability to lead and develop other leaders: coaching managers on pipeline discipline, performance management, and their own team-building, with a track record of promoting from within.</li>
<li>Experience owning strategic planning and execution across a multi-team or multi-region area, including territory design, headcount and capacity planning, and resource allocation to hit an area-level revenue target.</li>
<li>A genuine hunter mentality: direct experience managing teams responsible for creating new demand, new customer acquisition, and sourcing new pipeline.</li>
<li>A track record to back it up: consistent, sustained over-achievement, not a single good year.</li>
<li>Success closing complex Enterprise sales with multiple buying influences, ideally in new or emerging solution categories.</li>
<li>Experience managing and closing deals of $200K+, along with high-value transactions above $1M+.</li>
<li>A demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with partners and customers at the executive level.</li>
<li>Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical features into business value.</li>
<li>Fluency in consultative, value-based sales methodologies (Force Management, Challenger Sale, MEDDIC, etc.).</li>
<li>Comfort operating in a fast-paced, still-scaling environment where the playbook is being written as you go.</li>
</ul>

      <title>Celonis: Client Director - Financial Services</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, US, New York
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h4><strong>The Team</strong></h4>
<p>The Client Director is a senior member of our sales organization, responsible for the long-arc commercial trajectory of Celonis’s most strategically important accounts. You sit at the intersection of enterprise sales leadership and platform strategy—owning a focused portfolio of one to few large accounts generating significant ARR, and working in close partnership with Value Engineers, Client Value Partners (CVP), and Professional Services to grow, protect, and compound that revenue over multi-year horizons.</p>
<h4><strong>The Role</strong></h4>
<p>As the Client Director of our Financial Services accounts, your primary objective is to develop, maintain, and expand resilient sponsorship and sticky business critical use cases across the client’s business. You are accountable for moving accounts from solving individual pain points to an Enterprise AI platform of record—embedding the Celonis platform as a strategic pillar within the client’s operations.</p>
<p>You are the client’s most senior commercial partner, engaging at the C-suite level on business strategy, platform investment, and multi-year transformation. Where a CVP is deployed, you own the commercial relationship and expansion strategy; they own value realization and adoption.</p>
<h4><strong>The work you’ll do</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own the commercial relationship:</strong> Serve as the primary executive point of contact across the C-suite—CEO, CFO, CSCO, COO, CIO—building relationships that transcend any individual deal cycle and anchor Celonis to the customer’s long-term strategic agenda.</li>
<li><strong>Drive ARR and NRR growth:</strong> Develop and execute a structured expansion roadmap—identifying new business units, geographies, use cases, and platform capabilities that compound ARR over time. Lead commercial negotiations for expansions, renewals, and multi-year enterprise agreements in partnership with Deal Desk and Legal.</li>
<li><strong>Translate adoption into commercial momentum:</strong> Partner with the CVP and Value Engineering teams to convert adoption milestones and realized value into renewal confidence and expansion urgency. Own executive business reviews that are forward-looking and commercially anchored.</li>
<li><strong>Embed Celonis as a strategic platform:</strong> Position Celonis within the customer's AI strategy—connecting Process Intelligence to their LLM, automation, and agentic AI investments so the platform becomes a foundational data and orchestration layer, not a point solution.</li>
<li><strong>Protect through transformation:</strong> Proactively identify and mitigate commercial risk: sponsor departures, competitive displacement, implementation fatigue, and budget consolidation. Ensure multi-threaded executive relationships and a documented value story that survives the leadership transitions common in large enterprise accounts.</li>
<li><strong>Scale the practice:</strong> Codify account strategies, expansion motions, and transformation navigation approaches into reusable assets for the broader Strategic Accounts practice. Maintain disciplined account plan, pipeline strategy and coverage to any growth targets, and forecast accuracy across a small, complex account set.</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>The qualifications you need</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>12+ years in enterprise SaaS sales or strategic account management, with at least 5 years managing accounts with $5M+ ARR.</li>
<li>Deep industry expertise in Financial Services— with the credibility to engage customers on industry-specific challenges, benchmarks, and transformation priorities, not just platform capabilities.</li>
<li>Preferred direct experience with large financial institutions leading transformation initiatives or acting as a strategic consultant or Client Director.</li>
<li>Demonstrated track record of growing ARR within named accounts over multi-year horizons—expanding platform footprint, not just renewing contracts.</li>
<li>Executive presence and credibility at the C-suite level—able to lead strategic conversations with CFOs, COOs, and CIOs and influence large, complex buying decisions.</li>
<li>Experience navigating enterprise transformations—ERP consolidations, cloud migrations, M&amp;A, organizational restructuring—without losing commercial momentum.</li>
<li>Fluent in business case construction: ROI modeling, TCO analysis, and value benchmarking at a level that withstands CFO scrutiny.</li>
<li>Comfortable with long deal cycles and ambiguity; skilled at managing internal and external stakeholders across 12–24+ month expansion arcs.</li>
<li>Background in ERP, Supply Chain, Finance transformation, or AI-native enterprise platforms strongly preferred; familiarity with agentic AI, automation, or intelligent process orchestration a plus.</li>
<li>Proven ability to work in a team-selling model alongside value engineering, professional services, partners, and extended GTM teams like Growth, Industry, and Transformation experts.</li>
</ul>

Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and that the actual total compensation offer will be determined based on various factors, including, but not limited to, applicant's qualifications, skills, experiences, and location.</span></div><div class="title">The base salary range below is for the role in New York, based on a Full Time Schedule.  </div><div class="pay-range"><span>$211,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$250,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p>
<ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested">
<li><span>Pioneer Innovation:</span> Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.</li>
<li><span>Ownership from Day 1:</span> Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.</li>
<li><span>Unrivaled Family Support:</span> Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.</li>
<li><span>Work-Life Integration:</span> Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.</li>
<li><span>Continuous Growth:</span> Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.</li>
<li><span>Holistic Well-being:</span> Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.</li>
<li><span>Drive Sustainability:</span> Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.</li>
<li><span>Global Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</span> Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.</li>
<li><span>Value-Driven Impact:</span> Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About Us:</strong></p>
<p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, United States
</p>

<h1><strong>Enterprise Account Executive - East</strong></h1>
<h2><strong>Remote, United States</strong></h2>
<p><strong>JOB OVERVIEW</strong></p>
<p>The mission of the Account Executive, Enterprise is to source, develop, and close net new revenue within a named account territory consisting of enterprise prospect accounts headquartered in North America.&nbsp; This role requires a thoughtful, proactive hunter with a well established rolodex and&nbsp; deep industry expertise, to prospect, qualify and close new business.&nbsp; This role is perfect for an enterprise salesperson who can source net new customers and execute with passion, drive, and strong business acumen.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Develop a GTM sales strategy to build and grow Legion’s market leadership and achieve business targets</li>
<li>Understand client needs and align strategy</li>
<li>Build relationships with decision makers and stakeholders across target client base and participate in closing strategic opportunities when needed</li>
<li>Play a critical role in business planning, working closely with other senior executives to develop plans, resource requirements, and influence long-term business strategy</li>
<li>Work cross-functionally with sales leaders, marketing, and product teams to achieve and exceed company revenue targets</li>
<li>Close deals with enterprises and exceeding revenue targets</li>
<li>Develop granular account-level strategies to communicate Legion’s unique value proposition</li>
<li>Leverage industry expertise and Rolodex to build a pipeline of executive-level enterprise opportunities</li>
<li>Lead a deal through the entire sales lifecycle by building relationships and collaborating with key external and internal stakeholders</li>
<li>Craft a compelling business justification and ROI for each opportunity</li>
<li>Maintain accurate and timely customer, pipeline, and forecast data in Salesforce CRM</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3-5 years of enterprise technology sales experience&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience closing $1M ARR new business deals against a $2M+ annual quota</li>
<li>Strong application SaaS sales background</li>
<li>Superior negotiation, written, and verbal communication skills</li>
<li>A mix of large and small company experience. Early stage startup experience highly desired</li>
<li>Experience selling a Workforce Management (WFM) or Human Capital Management (HCM) software solution strongly preferred</li>
<li>Experience selling in the Retail, Hospitality, Distribution, Warehouse, and Healthcare industries is a plus</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience selling a Workforce Management (WFM) or Human Capital Management (HCM) software solution</li>
<li>Experience selling in the Retail, Hospitality, Distribution, Warehouse, and Healthcare industries</li>
<li>Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence</li>
<li>Personal passion and fervor for industry-leading next generation technology&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Ability to operate in an environment with limited&nbsp;</li>
<li>A great communicator who can distill powerful messages which resonate with customers</li>
<li>Track record of building positive relationships with peers</li>
<li>Continuous and thoughtful listener, able to learn from customers and leverage input</li>
<li>Strong personal work ethic focused on high priority issues; action and results oriented</li>
<li>Unquestionable integrity, credibility, and character; demonstrated high moral and ethical behavior</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>COMPENSATION &amp; BENEFITS</strong></p>
<p><em>Salary Range: Base Salary Range $135,000.00 - $185,000 + Commission + </em><em>Stock Equity</em></p>
<p>At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Benefits include, but are not limited to:</p>
<ul>
<li>$0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment</li>
<li>401k plan</li>
<li>Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays</li>
<li>Parental Leave&nbsp;</li>
<li>Equity&nbsp;</li>
<li>Monthly Wellness Reimbursement</li>
<li>Monthly Lunch on Legion</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>ABOUT LEGION</strong></h3>
<p>Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Our award-winning AI-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric and has proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.</p>
<p>If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.</p>
<h3><strong>BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p>There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.&nbsp; Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.</p>
<p>For more information, visit<a href="https://legion.co"> https://legion.co</a>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY</strong></h3>
<p>Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.</p>
<h3><strong>DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION</strong></h3>
<p>For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co&nbsp;</p>
<p>We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @<a href="http://legion.co">legion.co</a> domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span><em>Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.</em></span></p>
<h2>How We Determine What We Pay</h2>
<p><em>As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.</em></p>
<h1>Job Applicant Privacy Policy</h1>
<p>This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“<strong>Policy</strong>”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“<strong>Legion</strong>”, “<strong>we</strong>”, “<strong>us</strong>” and “<strong>our</strong>”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.</p>
<p>This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the&nbsp;<a href="https://legion.co/privacy-policy/">Legion Privacy Policy</a>&nbsp;applies.</p>
<div class="section-anchor position-relative"></div>
<ol class="ol-bold">
<li>
<p><strong>Types of Personal Information We Handle</strong></p>
<p>We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:</p>

</ul>

We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.</p>

<p>

</p>

<p>BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.</p>
<p>Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.</p>
<p>The Role</p>
<p>Identify, generate, qualify, and close new business for customers and prospects in a defined territory.&nbsp; Responsible for managing the full sales lifecycle, and building the go-to-market <br>plan (including direct and indirect business).&nbsp;</p>
<p>What You’ll Do</p>

<li>Establish and deliver a sales strategy that outlines a roadmap to quota attainment</li>
<li>Sales forecasting, lead generation, prospecting, and strategic relationship development</li>

<li>Attend corporate trade shows and events</li>
<li>Maintain sales pipeline activity in Salesforce</li>
<li>Schedule and conduct product demonstrations and detailed presentations to prospects, customers, and partners</li>
<li>Lead RFP responses for your accounts</li>
</ul>
<p>What You’ll Bring</p>
<ul>
<li>Must be located in the East of Saudi Arabia</li>
<li>Bachelor’s degree</li>
<li>8+ years’ sales experience with a demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding annual quota</li>
<li>Knowledge of the Italian top account and mid-market landscape</li>
<li>Experience with enterprise software, IT services, SaaS, IoT, or related managed services sales to global organizations</li>
<li>Experience with Salesforce</li>
<li>Already cyber security vendor on cloud/sub solutions channel oriented</li>
<li>Able to command sales message and sales</li>
<li>Experience leveraging the channel to drive business</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills</li>
<li>Ability to travel within the region</li>
</ul>
<p>Nice To Have</p>
<ul>
<li>Prior experience selling PAM software solutions</li>
<li>Completed 2 professional sales training courses (Sandler, SPIN, DISC, TAS, or Miller)</li>
<li>Strategic Account Management</li>
</ul>
<p>Better Together</p>
<p>Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.</p>
<p>We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who&nbsp;come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.</p>
<p>About Us</p>
<p>BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.</p>
<p>BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.</p>
<p>Learn more at <a href="http://www.beyondtrust.com/">www.beyondtrust.com</a>.&nbsp;</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p><strong>The Team:</strong></p>
<p>The Account Executive, a pivotal member of our enterprise sales team, is dedicated to driving growth by acquiring new clients across the region. This role is solely focused on expanding our footprint in the retail space. Leveraging top-tier products and effective sales strategies, the Account Executive collaborates closely with Value Engineers, Business Development Representatives, and other cross-functional teams to identify and capture high-value new business opportunities.</p>
<p><strong>The Role:</strong></p>
<p>The primary objective is to build and expand market presence by capitalizing on untapped opportunities in the region. As an Account Executive specializing in new business sales, this role is integral to our strategy for expanding market share through targeted client acquisitions. Key responsibilities include</p>
<p><strong>The work you’ll do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive New Business: Identify and develop new opportunities within a defined territory, targeting enterprise accounts to secure new logos.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Own the Sales Cycle: Manage the entire sales process—from prospecting and qualification to closing six-figure deals</li>
<li>Engage Strategic Stakeholders: Build relationships across multiple lines of business, engaging with C-level executives, operational leaders, and key decision-makers.</li>
<li>Deliver Tailored Solutions: Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and demonstrate how Celonis’ solutions can solve their strategic and operational challenges.</li>
<li>Showcase Value: Present use-case-specific pitches and demos, independently or in collaboration with Value Engineers, to highlight the measurable impact of Celonis solutions.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Partners: Work closely with Big 4 consulting firms, SaaS providers, and industry partners to enhance the value proposition for your prospects.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Leverage Team Support: Partner with your virtual team, including business development representatives, pre- sales, customer success, marketing managers, and partner managers, to drive success.</li>
<li>This role will be expected to spend the majority of their time in the field meeting with clients</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>The qualifications you need:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Proven SaaS Sales Experience: A strong track record of success in enterprise SaaS sales, with a focus on securing new business and consistently achieving revenue targets.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Expertise in Complex Sales: Experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles within large enterprise accounts.</li>
<li>Track record of selling enterprise-level software applications to C-level stakeholders.</li>

Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and that the actual total compensation offer will be determined based on various factors, including, but not limited to, applicant's qualifications, skills, experiences, and location.</span></div><div class="title">The base salary range below is for the role in California, based on a Full Time Schedule.  </div><div class="pay-range"><span>$140,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$165,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p>
<ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested">
<li><span>Pioneer Innovation:</span> Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.</li>
<li><span>Ownership from Day 1:</span> Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.</li>
<li><span>Unrivaled Family Support:</span> Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.</li>
<li><span>Work-Life Integration:</span> Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.</li>
<li><span>Continuous Growth:</span> Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.</li>
<li><span>Holistic Well-being:</span> Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.</li>
<li><span>Drive Sustainability:</span> Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.</li>
<li><span>Global Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</span> Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.</li>
<li><span>Value-Driven Impact:</span> Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.</li>

      <title>UCM Practice Growth Systems: 70-100K Potential for Practice Growth Advisor Sales Position  (Central or Eastern Time Zone)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>California</state>
      <skills>Sales, Relationship Management, Cold Calling, Sales Pitching, Client Relations, and  Relationship Building</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6265/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Southern California
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://ucmpracticegrowthsystems.com/">https://ucmpracticegrowthsystems.com/</a>
</p>

<p><strong>Summary</strong></p>
<p>NOTE: Applicants MUST read this entire job posting and complete all steps outlined below to be considered for this position.<br><br><strong>Our Mission</strong></p>
<p>At UCM Practice Growth Systems, we're a team on a mission. Dedicated to the glory of God, we aim to bring hope and healing to sick and suffering people through our partnership with upper cervical chiropractors.</p>
<p>We help chiropractic practices grow with proven patient acquisition systems, training and business growth consulting that let doctors focus on what matters most: helping more patients.</p>
<p>We're looking for a driven, relationship-oriented sales professional who shares our passion for helping doctors grow their practices and is excited about the opportunity to build meaningful relationships while generating new business.</p>
<h3>Your Role in Our Mission</h3>
<p>As a Practice Growth Advisor, your primary responsibility is to generate new revenue by identifying, engaging, and converting qualified upper cervical chiropractic practices into UCM clients.</p>
<p>This results-driven sales position requires someone who can confidently prospect, build relationships, conduct effective sales consultations, and close new business.</p>
<p>You won't simply wait for leads to come to you. You'll take ownership of developing your own pipeline (we provide the leads for you), creating sales opportunities, and consistently turning qualified conversations into new clients.</p>
<p>We believe great salespeople don't pressure prospects into buying. They identify real needs, build trust, provide valuable solutions, and guide prospects toward decisions that help their businesses succeed.</p>
<h3>What Success Looks Like</h3>
<p>Success in this position means consistently generating new business, maintaining a healthy sales pipeline, and converting qualified opportunities into paying clients.</p>
<p>New deals may include Practice Growth Memberships, Associate Recruitment Programs, Start Right Programs, website designs, and other UCM solutions.</p>
<p>A successful Practice Growth Advisor consistently closes 5 or more new deals per month, maintains a 40% conversion rate on qualified sales consultations, schedules at least 13 qualified outbound appointments, and successfully completes at least 12 of those appointments each month.</p>
<h3>Your Key Responsibilities</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p>New Revenue Generation<br>Consistently generate new business by identifying qualified prospects, conducting sales consultations, and closing deals to achieve monthly revenue and sales goals.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Outbound Prospecting &amp; Lead Generation<br>Proactively identify and engage potential clients through touchpoints; phone calls, texts, emails, social media messages, and other outreach strategies to build a consistent flow of qualified opportunities.&nbsp; PGA’s that consistently achieve 500 touchpoints per week get the best results.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Sales Pipeline Management<br>Take full ownership of your sales pipeline by tracking prospects, maintaining accurate CRM records, scheduling follow-ups, and moving opportunities efficiently through the sales process.&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Consultative Selling &amp; Closing<br>Build trust with prospective clients, identify their business challenges, recommend appropriate solutions, overcome objections, and confidently convert qualified opportunities into new clients.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Product &amp; Service Expertise<br>Develop a thorough understanding of UCM's growth memberships, products, services and pricing to effectively communicate their value and recommend solutions that align with each practice's needs.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Sales Performance &amp; Accountability<br>Consistently meet or exceed established KPIs, including new deals closed, consultation conversion rates, qualified appointments scheduled, and appointments completed.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Relationship Building &amp; Brand Representation<br>Establish meaningful relationships with chiropractic professionals while representing UCM's mission, core values, and commitment to ethical, relationship-based selling.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Industry Events &amp; Networking<br>Represent UCM at chiropractic conferences, college events, and industry gatherings to develop relationships, generate new opportunities, and expand the company's reach when needed.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Sales Training &amp; Continuous Improvement<br>Participate in sales role play coaching, call reviews, and professional development to continuously improve prospecting effectiveness, objection handling, and closing performance.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3>What We're Looking For</h3>
<p>Sales Experience and Skills</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or consultative selling.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Demonstrated success generating appointments through outbound prospecting.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong ability to build rapport and establish trust with business owners or decision-makers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience conducting qualifying calls, demo consultations, and closing conversations.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Confidence in overcoming objections and guiding prospects through purchasing decisions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong written and verbal communication skills.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience using CRM systems to manage leads, track activity, and maintain an organized pipeline.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ability to work independently, prioritize opportunities, and consistently achieve measurable sales goals.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Personal Characteristics</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Self-motivated: You take initiative and don't need constant supervision to generate opportunities.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Results-oriented: You enjoy working toward clear performance goals and being accountable for measurable outcomes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Relationship-focused: You genuinely care about understanding people and helping them succeed.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Persistent: You understand that successful sales require consistent outreach, follow-up, and resilience.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Coachable: You welcome feedback, embrace training, and continuously improve your approach.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Organized: You take pride in maintaining accurate records, reporting results daily and following through on commitments.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Mission-aligned: You're excited about helping chiropractic practices grow so they can serve more patients.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Compensation&nbsp;</h3>
<p>We offer a performance-based compensation structure that rewards successful business development and sales results.</p>
<p>First 90 Days – Paid Training and Performance Period</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>$3,000 monthly base compensation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>20% commission on deals personally generated and closed.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Structured training and guidance from our Director of Sales.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Opportunity to demonstrate sales ability, master our services, and build a productive pipeline.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>After 90 Days – Base + Commission</p>
<p>Upon successfully completing the initial performance period:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>$1,500 monthly base compensation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>50% commission on first-month membership revenue for eligible sales.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>25% commission on eligible one-time purchases.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Significant earnings potential based on individual sales performance with our sales career path.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>The initial 90-day evaluation includes successfully learning UCM's offerings, independently sourcing opportunities, closing at least 5 personally generated deals, maintaining accurate CRM records, and demonstrating alignment with company standards.</p>
<h3>Benefits</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Opportunities for professional growth and leadership advancement.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Company-sponsored professional and personal development training.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>50% contribution toward an eligible major medical insurance policy premium.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>100% reimbursement for eligible upper cervical chiropractic care after 90 days.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Company-paid travel expenses for approved business events.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Paid time off after 90 days, subject to company PTO policy.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Complimentary Financial Peace University participation after 180 days.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Eligibility for monthly profit sharing bonuses after 365 days.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>401(k) with a 4% company match after 365 days.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Employment, Payroll, and Work-Location Requirements</p>
<p>Applicants must be eligible to be employed directly through UCM Practice Growth Systems’ existing U.S. payroll and benefits programs.</p>
<p>UCM Practice Growth Systems is unable to:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Sponsor employment visas or work authorization.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Establish foreign payroll or a foreign legal entity.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Hire through an international employer-of-record service.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Provide country-specific benefits, tax administration, or employment arrangements.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Make exceptions to the eligibility requirements established by our payroll and benefits providers.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Candidates residing outside the United States must be legally permitted to work from their country of residence and must disclose their country and region of residence during the application process. Employment is contingent upon confirmation that the candidate’s location is supported by the company’s payroll, insurance, benefits, and employment arrangements.</p>
<p>Applicants must also be consistently available during Central or Eastern Time Zone business hours.</p>
<p>Flexible Hours:<br>Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday 8 AM to 5 PM Eastern time or 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern time &amp; Tuesdays&nbsp; 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM Eastern time. 60-minute lunch each day.</p>
<p>Meet the UCM Team<a href="https://uppercervicalmarketing.com/upper-cervical-marketing-team/"> https://uppercervicalmarketing.com/upper-cervical-marketing-team/</a> and Explore Our Core Values<a href="https://uppercervicalmarketing.com/about-us/"> https://uppercervicalmarketing.com/about-us/</a> at this link.</p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><strong>How to Apply</strong><br>Are you ready to step into a role where your work truly matters? If you share our dedication to bringing hope and healing to sick and suffering people for the glory of God, follow the link below:<br><br>To apply, go to <a href="https://talent.ucmpracticegrowthsystems.com/application-pga-wwr">https://talent.ucmpracticegrowthsystems.com/application-pga-wwr</a></p>
<p><strong>Hours: Full-time remotely</strong><br><strong>Job Type: Full-time</strong><br><strong>Expected hours: 40 per week</strong><br><strong>Language: English (Required)</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ucm-practice-growth-systems-70-100k-potential-for-practice-growth-advisor-sales-position-central-or-eastern">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ucm-practice-growth-systems-70-100k-potential-for-practice-growth-advisor-sales-position-central-or-eastern</a></p>
</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - Wisconsin, USA
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.</p>
<p>We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.</p></div><p><a href="https://share.synthesia.io/35a0c2a2-c772-4d2a-b571-808b7462c25f"><img src="https://image.synthesia.io/35a0c2a2-c772-4d2a-b571-808b7462c25f/thumbnail.gif" alt="Inside the Life of a Zscaler Enterprise Account Executive"> </a></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for an Account Executive to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. This role is based in the Wisconsin area, reporting to the Regional Director. You will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. By demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation, you will help cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers.</li>
<li>Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals.</li>
<li>Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs and contribute to comprehensive account planning.</li>
<li>Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client businesses and aligning technical solutions with their strategic goals.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.</li>
<li>You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</li>
<li>You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</li>
<li>You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.</li>
<li>You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving.</li>
<li>5+ years of full-cycle sales experience within the software or security industry.</li>
<li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.</li>
<li>Progressive selling experience engaging with enterprise accounts and selling at the C-Level.</li>
<li>Residency in or willingness to commute within the greater Wisconsin area.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Effectively leverage LLMs and Generative AI tools to boost productivity and sales effectiveness across research, prospecting, customer prep, and opportunity management.</li>
<li>Established relationships with current and prospective customers and a deep understanding of how technology facilitates high-level business goals.</li>
<li>Proficiency in strategic sales planning with a proven track record of closing net new logos.</li>
<li>Experience meeting or exceeding sales targets while leveraging channel partnerships.</li>
</ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.</p>
<p>The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/ bonus/ equity (if applicable) + benefits.</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$120,750</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$172,500 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.</p>
<p>Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:</p>
<div class="has-nudge">
<ul>
<li>Various health plans</li>
<li>Time off plans for vacation and sick time</li>
<li>Parental leave options</li>
<li>Retirement options</li>
<li>Education reimbursement</li>
<li>In-office perks, and more!</li>
</ul>
<div class="has-nudge">
<p>Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits&nbsp;<a href="https://www.zscaler.com/candidate-resource-hub">here</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.</p>
<p class="p1">Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. <em>See more information by clicking on the </em><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf"><em>Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal </em></a><em>link.</em></p>
<p>Pay Transparency</p>
<p>Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.</p>
<p>Zscaler is committed to providing reasonable support (called accommodations or adjustments) in our recruiting processes for candidates who are differently abled, have long term conditions, mental health conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zscaler-account-executive-enterprise-wisconsin">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zscaler-account-executive-enterprise-wisconsin</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Airtable: Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US
</p>

<p>Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless.&nbsp; That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses.</p>
<p>We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it.</p>
<p>As a Sales Manager for Strategic Accounts, you’ll own the performance of a team selling into some of the world’s largest organizations. You’ll be responsible for delivering ambitious revenue goals, hiring and developing exceptional Account Executives, and getting directly involved in the accounts and deals where your judgment and experience can make a difference.</p>
<p>If you’re excited by the challenge of building a high-performing team while staying close to the business, you’ll thrive here. You’ll be a trusted partner to senior customer executives, help your team navigate its most important opportunities, and work across Airtable to turn what you learn from customers into better ways of selling, operating, and ultimately serving them.</p>
<h1><strong>What you'll do</strong></h1>
<ul>
<li>Own your team’s revenue performance, setting ambitious goals and creating the focus, accountability, and operating rhythm needed to deliver against them.</li>
<li>Build and develop an exceptional team of Strategic Account Executives through thoughtful hiring, hands-on coaching, and regular, actionable feedback.</li>
<li>Stay close to your most important accounts and opportunities, helping shape deal and account strategy and building trusted relationships with senior customer executives.</li>
<li>Own forecasting and planning for your business, bringing rigor to pipeline management and using data and judgment to identify where your team needs to focus.</li>
<li>Partner across Sales, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, Product, and other teams to remove barriers, surface customer needs, and improve how we serve and sell to our largest customers.</li>
<li>Help shape the way the Strategic Sales organization operates, identifying opportunities to improve the structures, processes, and ways of working that enable the team to scale.</li>
</ul>
<h1><strong>Who you are</strong></h1>
<ul>
<li>You bring 8+ years of quota-carrying sales experience in technology, ideally SaaS, with a strong track record of selling to and closing large enterprise accounts.</li>
<li>You have people management experience and a track record of building and leading high-performing sales teams.</li>
<li>You’re an exceptional coach. You can diagnose what’s holding a seller or deal back, give clear and actionable feedback, and adapt your approach to help different people perform at their best.</li>
<li>You have strong commercial judgment. You know when to go deep on a deal, when to challenge your team’s thinking, and when to bring in the right stakeholders to change the trajectory of an opportunity.</li>
<li>You combine strategic thinking with operational rigor. You can see the bigger picture while staying close to pipeline, forecasting, account strategy, and the details that ultimately drive performance.</li>
<li>You’re a strong communicator and relationship builder. You can earn credibility with senior customer executives, create alignment across internal teams, and communicate clearly when priorities or perspectives differ.</li>
</ul>

<p>Our total compensation package also includes the opportunity to receive benefits and may include incentive compensation. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit offerings, please check out <a href="https://airtable.com/careers/life-at-airtable">Life at Airtable</a>.</p>

      <title>Zscaler: Account Executive, Enterprise - Southern CA</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state></state>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - California, USA
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.</p>
<p>We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.</p></div><p><a href="https://share.synthesia.io/35a0c2a2-c772-4d2a-b571-808b7462c25f"> <img src="https://image.synthesia.io/35a0c2a2-c772-4d2a-b571-808b7462c25f/thumbnail.gif" alt="Inside the Life of a Zscaler Enterprise Account Executive"> </a></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for an Account Executive to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. This role is based in the greater Southern CA area, reporting to the Regional Director. You will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. By demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation, you will help cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs and contribute to comprehensive account planning</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client businesses and aligning technical solutions with their strategic goals</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving</li>
<li>
<p>5+ years of full-cycle sales experience within the software or security industry</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Progressive selling experience engaging with enterprise accounts and selling at the C-Level</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Residency in or willingness to commute within the greater Southern CA area&nbsp;</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Established relationships with current and prospective customers and a deep understanding of how technology facilitates high-level business goals</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Proficiency in strategic sales planning with a proven track record of closing net new logos</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience meeting or exceeding sales targets while leveraging channel partnerships</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-Remote</p>
<p>&nbsp;#LI-WF1</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.</p>
<p>The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/ bonus/ equity (if applicable) + benefits.</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$117,250</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$167,500 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.</p>
<p>Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:</p>
<div class="has-nudge">
<ul>
<li>Various health plans</li>
<li>Time off plans for vacation and sick time</li>
<li>Parental leave options</li>
<li>Retirement options</li>
<li>Education reimbursement</li>
<li>In-office perks, and more!</li>
</ul>
<div class="has-nudge">
<p>Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits&nbsp;<a href="https://www.zscaler.com/candidate-resource-hub">here</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.</p>
<p class="p1">Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. <em>See more information by clicking on the </em><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf"><em>Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal </em></a><em>link.</em></p>
<p>Pay Transparency</p>
<p>Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.</p>
<p>Zscaler is committed to providing reasonable support (called accommodations or adjustments) in our recruiting processes for candidates who are differently abled, have long term conditions, mental health conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zscaler-account-executive-enterprise-southern-ca">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zscaler-account-executive-enterprise-southern-ca</a></p>
