      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>California</state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6590/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://zapier.com/es/">https://zapier.com/es/</a>
</p>

<p><strong>Location:</strong> EMEA<br><br>We're looking for a Motion Designer to join Brand Studio, the creative team behind how Zapier shows up in the world. Brand Studio is a small, high-ownership team embedded in Marketing, working at the intersection of brand, product, and enterprise positioning. We care deeply about craft, think strategically about systems, and move fast when the moment calls for it.</p>
<p>In this role you'll work closely with a team of brand designers and design ops, collaborate cross-functionally with PMM, Product Design, Web, and Social, and partner with external agencies on bigger productions. You'll help define how Zapier moves across every surface, and build the systems and tooling that let the whole org ship motion work independently without Brand Studio in the room every time.If you want to advance your career at a fast-growing, profitable, impact-driven company, read on…</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/">Our Commitment to Applicants</a></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/">Culture and Values at Zapier</a></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/">Zapier Guide to Remote Work</a></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/">Zapier Code of Conduct</a></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/">Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier</a></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About You</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>You can take a UI frame or a brand brief and turn it into a story that lands. You ask the right questions, understand the product well enough to know what the animation needs to communicate, and don't wait for a fully baked storyboard to get started</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You think in systems. You build mogrts files, component libraries, and motion guidelines that other people can use independently, and every project is an opportunity to make the next one ship faster</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You understand brand as well as UI: timing, easing, personality, the emotional register that makes motion feel ownable rather than generic</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You have a strong sense of sound and rhythm. You know how motion and sound work together, and you shape that relationship intentionally rather than as an afterthought</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You understand narrative. You think about motion the way a director thinks about a scene: setup, tension, resolution. You know when to breathe and when to accelerate, and you can articulate that thinking to stakeholders</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You manage up with creative insight, bringing your expertise into conversations proactively so stakeholders understand the why behind every creative choice</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You use AI as a genuine part of your practice, experimenting with video tools and sharing what you figure out so the whole team benefits</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You're energized by ambiguity, move fast, and don't wait for perfect conditions</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Things You’ll Do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Design and produce motion across product explainers, website animations, paid social video snippets, keynote and event motion, and campaign assets</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Draft simple storyboards yourself for straightforward projects so we can move fast without a separate brief-to-board cycle</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Work directly from UI frames provided by the product team to build polished product demo animations and feature explainers</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Build Zapier's motion design language: ownable branded motion patterns that establish how Zapier feels in motion across every surface</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Create motion guidelines, component libraries, and mogrts files that give partners and social teams repeatable building blocks to work from independently</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Explore tools like Jitter and Figma Motion to enable partners to generate on-brand animated assets without Brand Studio involvement every time</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Produce short video snippets for paid social testing across multiple angles and formats</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Support the recurring product video format and turn it into a scalable template for future launches</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>How to Apply</strong></h2>
<p>At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.</p>
<p>Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.</p>
<p>After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!</p>
<p>Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our <a href="https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct">code of conduct</a> provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.</p>
<p>Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can <a href="https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy">review our privacy policy here</a>.</p>
<p>Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact <a href="mailto:jobs@zapier.com">jobs@zapier.com</a>.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></h2>
<p>The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.</p>
<p><em>Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out</em><a href="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_lXQvKwuU4xXEbye7EW_En8iv1ZIMlQNmT7B2Mzbo24/edit?gid=0#gid=0"><em> this resource</em></a><em> for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.</em></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zapier-sr-motion-designer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zapier-sr-motion-designer</a></p>
</description>

      <title>ClickHouse: Principal Product Marketing Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state>California</state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6589/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://clickhouse.com/es">https://clickhouse.com/es</a>
</p>

<p>NOTE: this position can be remote anywhere within the United States.</p>
<p>As the Principal Product Manager for ClickHouse Cloud, you will be responsible for leading the development and delivery of the product working closely with engineering, customers, and stakeholders.</p>
<p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Define and drive the product roadmap for ClickHouse Cloud, with a focus on cloud-native database capabilities such as multi-region replication, distributed query execution, fault tolerance, storage tiering, and schema evolution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Collaborate with engineering to prioritize and deliver improvements to the core database engine, storage layer, and query optimizer, ensuring the Cloud offering keeps pace with open-source and enterprise use cases.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Engage directly with customers, gathering insights through interactions, feedback, and market research to guide product decisions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Work alongside design, marketing, operations, and sales teams to support feature launches, contribute to blog posts, and help shape product positioning and messaging.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Act as the primary point of contact for all product-related communications, effectively managing expectations and keeping stakeholders informed.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About You:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Minimum 8+ years of product management experience with a strong background in cloud-based SaaS products. Deep familiarity with database systems, distributed systems, or real-time analytics platforms is strongly preferred.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Hands-on experience with SQL and strong understanding of query execution, indexing strategies, partitioning, and performance tuning.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience working with databases such as ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or other columnar databases.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Understanding of modern data infrastructure: data lakes, ETL pipelines, CDC and data orchestration frameworks.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Demonstrated ability to work with engineering on low-level technical topics, such as schema management, query planning, storage engines, schema design.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience designing and delivering features such as database replication, consistency models, and backup/restore workflows.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of simplifying deep technical topics for non-technical audiences.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Experience working and scaling open source technologies</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Prior experience at a startup</p>
</li>
</ul>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h3><strong>Perks</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Flexible work environment</strong> - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Healthcare</strong> - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Equity in the company</strong> - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Time off</strong> - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>A USD$500 Home office setup </strong>if you’re a remote employee.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Global Gatherings </strong>– We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Culture - We All Shape It</h3>
<p>As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.</p>
<p>Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values <a href="https://clickhouse.com/company/careers">here</a>. Check out our<a href="https://clickhouse.com/blog"> blog posts</a> or follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true">LinkedIn</a> to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.</p>
<h3>Equal Opportunity &amp; Privacy</h3>
<p>ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.</p>
<p>Please see <a href="https://clickhouse.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice">here</a> for our Privacy Statement.</p>

</description>

      <title>StockX: Category Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, USA
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.</strong></p></div><h3><strong>Why you'll love this role</strong></h3>
<p>StockX has redefined the global marketplace for culture — where buyers and sellers transact with confidence on an always-on digital exchange. We are building the next frontier of creator-driven, culturally rich commerce that blends excitement, community, expertise, and transaction in one platform.</p>
<p>This initiative is designed to empower sellers and creators to build sustainable businesses while creating moments that drive deep engagement. To support this effort, we are forming a category-led Go-To-Market organization that scales with culture, category dynamics, and community expertise.</p>
<p>The Category Manager is a foundational hire tasked with owning the growth and strategic trajectory of a major category. You will serve as the chief operator, strategist, and market voice for your category — identifying opportunity, building pipelines, and driving seller and creator engagement from early stages through scale.</p>
<p>This role blends strategic planning, deep customer and market understanding, and hands-on execution, with full ownership of category growth outcomes. You will work closely with Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Operations to define and accelerate the path to liquidity, engagement, and monetization within your category.</p>
<h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3>
<h4><em>Category Strategy &amp; Ownership</em></h4>
<ul>
<li>Define the strategic vision and growth plan for your category on the platform</li>
<li>Become a deep expert on the category’s supply landscape, demand drivers, community channels, and competitive dynamics</li>
<li>Establish metrics and quarterly goals to measure and drive category performance</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><em>Supply &amp; Community Acquisition</em></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build a robust pipeline of sellers, creators, influencers, and shops within your category</li>
<li>Drive outbound outreach, onboarding, and enablement for high-potential sellers</li>
<li>Cultivate long-term relationships with strategic sellers and community leaders</li>
</ul>
<h4><em>Cross-Functional Go-To-Market Execution</em></h4>
<ul>
<li>Partner with our Account and Partnerships Managers to scale seller engagement and support</li>
<li>Collaborate with Category Marketing Managers to architect high-impact launches, moments, and campaigns</li>
<li>Represent category needs and insights to Product and Engineering to improve seller tools, features, and platform performance</li>
</ul>
<h4><em>Category Performance &amp; Analytics</em></h4>
<ul>
<li>Use data to diagnose growth opportunities, identify bottlenecks, and optimize playbooks</li>
<li>Track supply, engagement, retention, and revenue trends and adjust strategies in real time</li>
<li>Surface actionable insights to Growth leadership and cross-functional stakeholders</li>
</ul>
<h4><em>Culture &amp; Community Leadership</em></h4>
<ul>
<li>Act as the platform’s representative within your category’s ecosystem</li>
<li>Engage deeply with community norms, vernacular, and cultural drivers to inform both strategy and execution</li>
<li>Champion creator and seller needs internally to ensure authentic, category-led growth</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>About you</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Experienced GTM / Growth Operator:</strong> 5+ years in business development, partnerships, category management, or marketplace growth roles; experience in consumer platforms or two-sided marketplaces preferred</li>
<li><strong>Strategic Thinker + Doer:</strong> Comfortable defining vision while executing in ambiguous, fast-moving environments</li>
<li><strong>Relationship-Driven:</strong> Able to build trust quickly with sellers, creators, and internal partners</li>
<li><strong>Data Fluent:</strong> Makes decisions informed by data and measures what matters</li>
<li><strong>Community Minded:</strong> Understands cultural nuance, category subcultures, and trends that drive engagement</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Existing network within the assigned category (e.g., sneaker resellers, influencer communities, boutique shops)</li>
<li>Marketplace experience across both supply and demand sides</li>
<li>Experience with creator monetization platforms, community-driven commerce, or enthusiast ecosystems</li>
<li>Comfort with CRM tools, sales pipelines, analytics dashboards, and seller performance metrics</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Why This Role Matters</strong></h3>
<p>As one of the first Category Managers supporting this new commerce initiative, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Set the playbook for how categories scale on an emerging platform</li>
<li>Shape how StockX engages sellers, creators, and communities at scale</li>
<li>Build the foundation of a repeatable, category-centric GTM / Growth engine that expands into new verticals</li>
</ul>
<p>This role is both strategic and entrepreneurial, with meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence the trajectory of a high-potential new product.</p>
<div><em>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.</em></div>
<div><em>&nbsp;</em></div>
<div><em>Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $120,000 to $130,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary.&nbsp;</em></div><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="job-preview__description ">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="job-preview__description "><strong>About StockX</strong></div>
<div class="job-preview__description "><strong><br></strong>StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com.</div>
<div class="job-preview__description ">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="job-preview__description ">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="job-preview__description "><em>We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the job and the general nature and level of work performed by job holders within this job. However, this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position. StockX reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. <em>StockX may utilize AI to rank job applicant submissions against the position requirements to assist in determining candidate alignment.</em></em></div></div>

      <title>Customer.io: Events Marketing Manager, EMEA</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> EMEA Remote
</p>

<h3>About <a href="http://customer.io/">Customer.io</a></h3>
<p>Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.</p>
<h3>About the role</h3>
<p>Hi, my name is Rosie, Events Team Manager here at <a href="http://customer.io/">Customer.io</a>, and I am looking for an Events Marketing Manager to own our in-person events across EMEA. You'll lead live field events, hosted customer and prospect experiences, and sponsored conferences across the region, and run our monthly EMEA webinar. You'll partner closely with Demand Gen, Content, Design, Partnerships, and EMEA Sales to create events that feel polished, thoughtful, and unmistakably "us" - tailored to EMEA markets rather than a copy-paste of NA programming. You'll ramp alongside our Events Manager, who currently supports the region, and take full ownership of EMEA within your first 90 days.</p>
<p><strong>This role includes 15%+ travel for EMEA field events, conferences, and onsite support.</strong></p>
<h3>What we value</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Human-centered experiences.</strong> You create events that feel thoughtful, relevant, and genuinely useful - built for EMEA audiences.</li>
<li><strong>Collaborative energy.</strong> You work smoothly across teams and time zones, and make alignment feel easy.</li>
<li><strong>Insight-driven decisions.</strong> You let data guide you while keeping the attendee experience at the center.</li>
<li><strong>Action with intention.</strong> You move quickly, adapt gracefully, and learn from every event.</li>
<li><strong>Operational clarity.</strong> You bring structure, calm, and consistency to fast-moving, cross-market work.</li>
</ul>
<h3>What you’ll do</h3>
<p><strong>Event planning &amp; coordination</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own and manage the EMEA in-person events calendar - field events, hosted experiences, sponsored conferences, and activations across the region</li>
<li>Partner with the Events Team and Demand Gen to define goals, audiences, formats, and success metrics specific to EMEA markets</li>
<li>Evaluate EMEA sponsorships, speaking slots, and event formats against goals</li>
<li>Work closely with cross-functional partners to ensure every event feels cohesive with global campaigns while staying relevant to EMEA audiences</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Execution &amp; project management</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Manage day-to-day logistics: vendor coordination, timelines, run-of-show, speaker prep, and on-the-ground support for EMEA events</li>
<li>Partner with Content, Brand, Product Marketing, and Sales to develop compelling event assets and presentations</li>
<li>Oversee registration flows, pre-event communication, and the attendee experience from first touch to follow-up</li>
<li>Step in wherever needed to keep events running smoothly, calmly, and on-brand</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>EMEA webinars (about one per month)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Run our monthly EMEA webinar end to end - topic and speaker selection, registration, promotion, and follow-up - timed and localized for a European audience</li>
<li>Partner with Content and Product Marketing to adapt or build webinar content that lands with EMEA audiences</li>
<li>Build and optimize registration pages, forms, and workflows for EMEA campaigns</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Audience growth &amp; promotion</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Execute multi-channel promotional plans across email, social, and partner channels for EMEA audiences</li>
<li>Collaborate with Demand Gen, Marketing Ops &amp; Sales to ensure EMEA lead capture, routing, and follow-up happen correctly and quickly</li>
<li>Manage attendee communication throughout the event lifecycle</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Performance &amp; optimization</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Track EMEA event performance - pipeline, revenue, deal acceleration, and event engagement</li>
<li>Share insights and recommendations to continually improve ROI and attendee experience across the region</li>
<li>Maintain documentation, templates, and repeatable workflows that make running EMEA events smoother and more scalable</li>
<li>Partner with ops to ensure clean attribution and accurate reporting across systems</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What success looks like</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Regional ownership:</strong> EMEA events and webinars run smoothly, predictably, and feel built for the region</li>
<li><strong>Engagement growth:</strong> Attendance and engagement steadily increase across EMEA field events and webinars</li>
<li><strong>Sales alignment:</strong> EMEA Sales and Marketing feel tightly connected and supported by event-driven pipeline</li>
<li><strong>Sharper insights:</strong> You surface insights that help the program get sharper, smarter, and more efficient over time</li>
<li><strong>Better playbooks:</strong> EMEA-specific playbooks, templates, and processes get better and help the team move faster</li>
</ul>
<h3>What we're looking for</h3>
<p>You're a hands-on, highly organized marketer who loves building great experiences and understands how events translate into revenue. You're comfortable owning a region end to end - you stay grounded under pressure, thrive in a distributed environment, and enjoy the cross-market collaboration required to make EMEA events exceptional.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Based in the UK or Ireland</strong> (London or Dublin ideal)</li>
<li>4+ years in event marketing within B2B SaaS</li>
<li>Experience running in-person events across formats (field events, hosted experiences, conferences), ideally across multiple EMEA markets</li>
<li>Experience running webinars, and real excitement about doing both: a busy in-person calendar plus about one webinar a month</li>
<li>Strong project management skills - you juggle timelines, tasks, and teams (and time zones) with ease</li>
<li>Experience collaborating with Sales and supporting event-driven follow-up</li>
<li>Comfortable with marketing automation tools (<a href="http://customer.io/">Customer.io</a>, Marketo, etc.) and Salesforce</li>
<li>Familiarity with webinar platforms (Livestorm, Zoom, Sequel) and event management tools</li>
<li>Understanding of lead capture, UTMs, and event pipeline attribution</li>
<li>Ability to partner with Rev/Marketing Ops to troubleshoot data flows and ensure clean reporting</li>
<li>Comfortable with 15%+ travel</li>
</ul>
<h3>Compensation &amp; Benefits</h3>
<p>We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $93,000 - $110,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.</p>
<p>We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including <strong>100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family</strong>. We also offer <strong>16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO</strong>, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.</p>
<p><a href="https://customer.io/careers#:~:text=our%20collective%20success.-,BENEFITS,-Our%C2%A0">See full benefits here →</a></p>
<h3>Our Process</h3>
<p>No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.</p>
<ul>
<li>30-minute video call with Recruiter</li>
<li>30-minute video call with member of the Events team</li>
<li>30-minute video call with Hiring Manager</li>
<li>60-minute Case Study Review video call with potential teammates</li>
</ul>
<p>All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.</p>
<p><a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.</p>
<p>Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official <a href="http://customer.io/">Customer.io</a> letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact <a href="mailto:jobs@customer.io">jobs@customer.io</a>.</p>
<h3>Join us!</h3>
<p>Check out our&nbsp;<a href="https://customer.io/careers/">careers page</a>&nbsp;for more information about why you should&nbsp;<a href="https://customer.io/about/">come work with us!</a> We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now.</p>
<p></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-events-marketing-manager-emea">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-events-marketing-manager-emea</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Abnormal: Account Executive, SLED (Sacramento only)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - USA
</p>

<h2>About the Role</h2>
<p>Cybercrime doesn't wait for anyone to catch up to it, and neither do we. Abnormal AI is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to join our SLED team, selling behavioral AI security solutions into large, complex State, Local, and Education agencies within a defined territory.</p>
<p>We didn't bolt AI onto old security tools. We built our platform from AI up, to catch the human-targeted attacks that legacy tools miss, and public sector organizations need that protection as much as anyone.</p>
<p>The ideal candidate is local to the <strong>Sacramento area</strong> and brings experience selling <strong>cybersecurity solutions</strong> into <strong>large public sector environments</strong>, particularly Enterprise-level SLED organizations, along with:</p>
<ul>
<li>Proven hunter focused on selling to large state and local government agencies, with a disciplined approach to early pipeline development and prospecting.</li>
<li>Skilled at leveraging all five demand generation pillars: AE prospecting, SDRs, marketing, channel partnerships, and customer referrals.</li>
<li>Strong qualifier with the ability to uncover public sector pain points and map them to compelling, value-driven solutions.</li>
<li>Effective presenter who tailors demos and messaging to resonate with government stakeholders and address their specific challenges.</li>
<li>Process-oriented with a consistent sales methodology and strong time management skills to manage multiple deals efficiently.</li>
<li>Data-disciplined, maintaining accurate and up-to-date account and opportunity data across systems.</li>
<li>Experienced in building business cases that quantify ROI and value for diverse public sector audiences, including IT, procurement, and leadership.</li>
<li>Knowledge sharer who captures and organizes customer insights and lessons learned to support team learning.</li>
<li>Skilled at guiding public sector customers through complex internal buying processes, including procurement and RFP cycles.</li>
<li>Resilient and resourceful, with a strong track record of success in early-stage environments.</li>
<li>Effective at leveraging internal teams such as Sales Engineering, Marketing, BDRs, Product, and Customer Success to drive results in the SLED space.</li>
</ul>
<h2>What You Will Do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Sell Abnormal AI solutions to large Enterprise SLED agencies with a mandate to overachieve new annual recurring revenue quota, not just hit it.</li>
<li>Run the full deal cycle in your accounts: first conversation, technical evaluation, contract signature, and the upsell conversations that follow once they're a customer.</li>
<li>Prospect and build new business opportunities to keep your pipeline ahead of target.</li>
<li>Sell a platform that's actively expanding underneath you: what started as email security now covers identity, AI security, and insider threat, giving you more surface area to bring value to every agency.</li>
<li>Partner with Customer Success to protect timely renewals and surface expansion opportunities.</li>
<li>Keep your data sharp across Salesforce, Highspot, and Close Plan, because accurate pipeline is how the whole team plans and wins.</li>
<li>Be the customer's advocate inside Abnormal, working with Sales Engineering, Product, and Marketing to get the right things prioritized so more revenue closes, faster.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Must Haves</h2>
<ul>
<li>Enterprise SLED Account Hunter: 8+ years of direct (not overlay) enterprise sales experience prospecting and closing large, complex SLED accounts.</li>
<li>A proven track record of both closing new account logos and growing existing accounts through cross-sell and upsell within the State of California.</li>
<li>Negotiation skill that holds up against large organizations and complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.</li>
<li>A track record to back it up: consistent over-quota performance, ideally top 5% of your sales org.</li>
<li>Technical fluency across security, email, cloud, and AI, enough to hold your own in a conversation with a security or IT leader.</li>
<li>Cybersecurity or security-adjacent SaaS sales experience, selling subscription software to CISOs and security personnel.</li>
<li>A builder's mindset: you've thrived somewhere early-stage, an underdog, or up against bigger incumbents, and you know how to build territory with limited resources.</li>
<li>Comfort selling within a company that's still writing its next chapter. We're growing 40%+ year over year, protecting more than 4,500 customers including over 25% of the Fortune 500, and expanding fast from email into identity, AI security, and insider threat. That means more to sell, more to learn, and more room to make your mark than a mature market leader can offer.</li>
</ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United Kingdom (Remote) 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3>
<p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><p>We’re excited to hire someone <strong>based in London</strong>, where we’re looking to grow our sales presence.</p>
<h3><strong>About The Role<br></strong></h3>
<p>Our team is still early in its evolution, operating with a start-up mindset within a scaling company. We're building stronger processes, a clearer operating model, and the foundation for our next stage of growth. We’re looking for someone who wants to help&nbsp;<em>create</em> that future—not just operate within it.<br><br>As a Senior Account Executive reporting directly to the Head of Sales, you’ll be a key driver of our outbound engine. You’re a strategic seller who owns the full cycle, thrives on proactive outreach, and isn’t phased by cold calls or pipeline creation. You combine discipline with initiative, independence with collaboration, and urgency with long-term relationship-building.<br><br>Your territory spans Mid-Market and Enterprise customers, blending short-cycle and long-cycle opportunities. But make no mistake: <strong>outbound is the heartbeat of this role.<br></strong></p>
<p><strong><br>Things you will do:<br></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Outreach + engagement</strong>: contact leads via email, cold calls, conferences, and more. Manage inbound and referral leads.</li>
<li><strong>Lead gen + prospecting:</strong> research potential customers, generate leads, and build a consistent outbound sales pipeline. Attend industry events and develop connections to drive future sales growth.</li>
<li><strong>Qualification + closing</strong>: run discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to qualify and close new customers. Build proposals and RoI cases that convince qualified prospects to buy Listen. Negotiate contract terms when needed.</li>
<li><strong>Process improvement:</strong> improve our internal sales processes (slides, call scripts, meeting templates, contract terms, CRM workflows, metrics, dashboards, etc.). Run weekly “Sales Review” meetings company-wide to review deals and answer questions.</li>
<li><strong>Cross-team work</strong>: work with Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to consistently delight customers. Work with our co-founding team on all things sales and revenue-related.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you already bring to the table:<br></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5–8+ years of quota-carrying closing experience in B2B SaaS</li>
<li>Experience selling into <strong>enterprise or upper mid-market accounts</strong></li>
<li>Proven ability to run <strong>consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles</strong></li>
<li>Track record of closing <strong>meaningful deals ($50K–$250K+)</strong> and expanding accounts</li>
<li>Strong discovery and storytelling skills</li>
<li>Comfortable balancing inbound + outbound pipeline generation</li>
<li>Highly organized and proactive in managing deals end-to-end</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We <strong>move as one team</strong>, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters <strong>strong bonds</strong> grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We <strong>champion our diverse customer base</strong> by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we<strong> hold high expectations </strong>for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.</p></div>

      <title>Airtable: Account Executive, Corporate</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US
</p>

<p>Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work.<br><br>Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless.&nbsp; That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses.<br><br>We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it.</p>
<p>As a Corporate Account Executive, you’ll work with a portfolio of SMB and Mid-Market customers across a wide range of verticals and industries. That means the best outcomes rarely come from running a standard playbook. We need someone who finds that energizing, someone curious enough to understand how a complex organization actually operates, disciplined enough to orchestrate complex,multi-threaded sales cycles, and resourceful enough to bring the right people in at the right moment.</p>
<p>If you’re excited by the challenge of turning an initial opportunity into a strategic relationship, navigating increasingly complex deals, and finding new ways for Airtable to create value across an organization, you’ll thrive here. We hire Corporate AEs with growth in mind: you’ll get the exposure, coaching, and increasing deal complexity you need to ramp quickly toward becoming an Enterprise Account Executive.</p>
<h1><strong>What you'll do</strong></h1>
<ul>
<li>Turn Airtable’s large self-service user base into new business, using existing adoption and proven use cases to uncover and develop high-potential opportunities.</li>
<li>Build relationships with leaders across functions and industries, understanding what matters to them and finding opportunities to expand Airtable’s impact as their organizations grow.</li>
<li>Own and prioritize your book of business, developing thoughtful account plans and finding your way from an initial champion to stakeholders across the organization.</li>
<li>Lead complex sales cycles from first conversation through close, bringing in Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and other partners at the right moments to move opportunities forward.</li>
<li>Become a trusted advisor to prospects: understand their business objectives and bring Airtable’s flexibility to life through compelling use cases that show how the platform can solve their problems and transform the way their teams work.</li>
</ul>
<h1><strong>Who you are</strong></h1>
<ul>
<li>You bring 1-3 years of quota-carrying closing experience at a technology company</li>
<li>You’ve successfully closed deals with mid-market and larger organizations (50-3,000 FTEs), with a track record of hitting or exceeding your sales goals.</li>
<li>You can run a structured sales process (e.g., Force Management) with rigor and self-awareness. You know where your deals stand, what needs to happen next, and which stakeholders to bring in at the right moments to move them forward.</li>
<li>You’re a strong communicator and relationship builder. You build credibility with business leaders and executives, develop the trust needed to move opportunities forward, and create alignment across g stakeholders at each stage of the sales lifecycle.</li>
<li>You’re an adaptable seller. You’re comfortable moving across industries, use cases, and buyer personas, and you know how to make your approach relevant to each.</li>
</ul>
<h1><strong>What we offer</strong></h1>
<p>Compensation awarded to successful candidates will vary based on their work location, relevant skills and experience. The on-target earnings range for this role is $182,800 to $238,100 for all office and remote locations.</p>
<p>Our total compensation package also includes the opportunity to receive benefits and may include incentive compensation. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit offerings, please check out <a href="https://airtable.com/careers/life-at-airtable">Life at Airtable</a>.</p>

      <title>Kyro AI: Sales Development Representative</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Alabama</state>
      <skills>Sales Management, Sales,  Client Relationship Management, Communication Skills, Client Relations, Sales Enablement, and  Stakeholder Communication</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Contract</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6563/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Texas
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://kyro.ai">https://kyro.ai</a>
</p>

<p>Sales Development Representative (SDR)</p>
<p>Location: Remote, non-US based, working US Central Time business hours<br>Experience: 1-3 years in a B2B SDR/BDR role<br>Employment type: Full-time<br>Reports to: Product Manager - Growth</p>
<p>ABOUT KYRO AI<br>When a major storm knocks out power, utilities race to mobilize crews and get the lights back on. Kyro AI builds the software behind that effort: workforce and contractor management for electric utilities, storm restoration contractors, and aggregators. We are headquartered in Plano, Texas, and were spun off from Think Power Solutions, so we pair long-standing utility expertise with the pace and ownership of a product company.<br><br><a href="https://kyro.ai/">https://kyro.ai/</a></p>
<p>WHY JOIN KYRO<br>- Work that matters: our platform helps communities get power back after storms and keeps a critical, regulated industry compliant.<br>- A growing product suite: StormShield for storm restoration, Kyro Capital for contractor invoice factoring, KORY (our AI copilot), and contractor onboarding and verification.<br>- Credibility from day one: you sell with the backing of real utility relationships and domain know-how.<br>- Close to leadership: direct access to the CEO and product team, and what you hear from customers shapes the roadmap.<br>- Room to grow: a clear path from SDR to Account Executive.<br>- Flexibility: fully remote team.</p>
<p>THE ROLE<br>As an SDR, you are the first conversation most utilities and contractors have with Kyro. You will work two segments with very different buying motions:</p>
<p>Utilities (enterprise): You will talk to storm response, emergency management, contractor management, supply chain, and procurement leaders. Cycles are long, involve multiple stakeholders, and are often tied to RFIs/RFPs. A win is a qualified discovery meeting or demo handed to the account team.</p>
<p>Contractors (SMB to mid-market): You will talk to owners, operations managers, and storm coordinators at line, vegetation, and restoration contractors. Cycles are shorter, phone-first, and owner-led. A win is a demo held and the contractor signed up and onboarded.</p>
<p>WHAT YOU'LL DO<br>- Prospect outbound: research target utilities and contractors, build account lists, and reach decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn.<br>- Own the follow-up: run multi-touch cadences, chase no-shows and stalled conversations, and make sure every lead has a dated next step.<br>- Respond to inbound leads the same business day and qualify them before they go cold.<br>- Qualify with rigor: confirm need, timeline, decision process, budget, and compliance requirements before booking.<br>- Book and confirm demos, send reminders, and hand off with clear notes.<br>- Drive conversions: stay with contractors after the demo until they sign up and start onboarding; keep utility opportunities moving to the next stage.<br>- Keep the CRM clean: log every activity, stage change, and next step.<br>- Feed the product team: share objections, competitor mentions, and feature requests from the field.</p>
<p>HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED<br>Success is measured on demos held and the conversions that follow. Activity counts are leading indicators, not the goal. KPIs: demos booked, demos held, demo-to-opportunity rate, conversions (contractors signed up and onboarded; utility opportunities advanced to proposal or pilot), pipeline sourced, speed to lead, follow-up coverage (share of open leads with a dated next step), and outreach activity. Targets are set separately for each segment; utility credit weighs meetings and pipeline more than closed conversions.</p>
<p>WHAT YOU BRING<br>- 1-3 years as an SDR or BDR in B2B sales, ideally SaaS, with a record of hitting or beating meeting and demo quotas<br>- Disciplined follow-up across phone, email, and LinkedIn without being reminded<br>- Confident cold calling, including with field-oriented buyers who rarely live in their inbox<br>- Clear, concise written communication<br>- Hands-on experience with a CRM and a sales engagement tool (HubSpot, Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar)<br>- Comfort with metrics: you track your own funnel and know where deals stall<br>- Ability to learn a technical, regulated domain quickly<br>- Self-directed and organized in a fully remote setting<br>- Native English speaker, available during US Central Time business hours</p>
<p>NICE TO HAVE<br>- Experience selling into utilities, energy, construction, field services, or regulated industries<br>- Familiarity with storm restoration, line work, vegetation management, or contractor ecosystems<br>- Exposure to both enterprise (long-cycle) and SMB or self-serve sales motions<br>- Experience selling workforce management, compliance, or fintech products<br>- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience</p>
<p>COMPENSATION AND PROBATION<br>- Competitive market base plus uncapped commission. Base is paid bi-weekly and commission quarterly.<br>- Accelerators: 1.5x at 101-125% of quota, 2.0x above 125%.<br>- The first six months are probationary, with performance reviews at 3 and 6 months against ramped KPI targets (demos held, conversions, follow-up coverage). <br>- If targets are not met, Kyro may extend the probationary period or end employment. - - Employment remains at-will during and after probation.</p>
<p>WHAT WE OFFER<br>- Competitive base and variable pay<br>- A fully remote role<br>- A clear path to Account Executive for SDRs who consistently hit target<br>- Direct exposure to product and leadership at a company shaping how utilities run storm response</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyro-ai-sales-development-representative">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyro-ai-sales-development-representative</a></p>
</description>

<p>

</p>

<p>Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.</p>
<p>We’re looking for a Sr. Manager, Corporate Sales to lead and scale Webflow’s strategic , full-cycle sales motion within our West Coast Corporate segment. In this role, you will drive strategy and execution for a team of Account Executives responsible for prospecting, pipeline generation, and closing new business, while ensuring a seamless, efficient, and high-performing sales process.</p>
<p>You will recruit, develop, and coach top-performing AEs, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and excellence. You will work closely with key cross-functional partners across Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, and Customer Success to build and refine programs that accelerate revenue growth, optimize funnel efficiency, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.</p>
<p>The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and a hands-on leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, is passionate about developing talent, and is eager to build a best-in-class Corporate segment that drives meaningful impact for Webflow’s customers and business.</p>

<li>Full-time</li>
<li>Permanent</li>
<li>Exempt</li>

<ul>

<li>Zone B: $276,000 - $325,000</li>
<li>Zone C: $255,000 - $300,000</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Canada (figures cited below are in CAD and pertain to workers in ON &amp; BC, Canada)
<ul>
<li>319,000 - 375,000</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>

Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends<em><br></em></p>

<p>As a Sr. Manager, Corporate Sales you’ll …</p>

<li>Provide hands-on support by joining client meetings, leading key conversations, and coordinating internal resources to remove obstacles.</li>

<li>Partner with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams to align on sales strategies and operational processes.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Customer Success to ensure a seamless handoff and exceptional customer experience between pre-sales and post-sales stages.</li>
<li>Identify product and technology gaps through customer interactions and communicate insights to Webflow’s Product and Leadership teams.</li>
<li>Regularly report on team performance, key metrics, customer insights, challenges, and sales forecasts.</li>
<li>Travel up to 25% - primarily for onboarding, industry events, and internal offsites</li>
</ul>

<ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> US-Remote
</p>

<p>Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we’ve been focused on building a world-class technology solution that creates an experience of delight and ease for physicians, and that our users love.</p>
<p><span>Elation is looking for an Account Executive with a keen interest in helping Elation grow its acquisition efforts to independent physician practices. This is a quota carrying role where we’re looking for a hungry, goal-oriented sales professional to take our team to the next level.</span></p>
<p>The primary function of this role will be to partner with our sales leadership team to drive and nurture prospect engagement as we build Elation’s customer portfolio.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<p>Full-Cycle Sales Process Management: Lead a comprehensive sales process that encompasses creative lead generation, discovery, product demonstrations, negotiations, and closings. Be proactive in identifying new opportunities to build the sales pipeline and achieve sales objectives.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Virtual Product Demonstrations:</strong> Conduct compelling and effective product demonstrations virtually to prospects of our award winning EHR and billing solutions, clearly articulating the value and benefits of our solutions tailored to their specific needs.</li>
<li><strong>Sales Pipeline Development:</strong> Maintain a robust sales pipeline by generating meetings from inbound leads and self-generated cold prospecting efforts.&nbsp; Follow best practices for both inbound and outbound pipeline development and consistently meet outbound pipeline generation goals.</li>
<li><strong>Relationship Building:</strong> Forge strong relationships with potential clients through consistent follow-up, understanding their unique needs, and positioning our solutions as key to addressing those needs.</li>
<li><strong>Collaboration with Internal Teams:</strong> Coordinate with the Customer Experience (CX) and Product Development teams to ensure a seamless transition from sale to implementation and to provide feedback on product improvements and market needs.</li>
<li><strong>Salesforce documentation:</strong> Accurately document all sales activities, pipeline updates, and client communications, in SFDC ensuring timely and accurate visibility into your efforts and results.</li>
<li><strong>Continuous Learning and Development:</strong> Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and product knowledge to enhance your sales presentations and effectiveness.</li>
<li><strong>Cultural Ambassador:</strong> Internalize company culture and represent this externally</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Qualifications:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor’s degree required</li>
<li>2+ years in a full sales cycle quota-carrying sales role; within the healthcare industry preferred</li>
<li>Ability to conduct product demonstrations in an inside sales/virtual sales environment</li>
<li>Ability to build pipeline through cold outreach in an inside sales/virtual sales environment</li>
<li>Strong intrapersonal skills</li>
<li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills</li>
<li>Proficiency with sales tools such as Salesforce (SFDC), Groove/Outreach, Gong or similar tools.</li>
<li>Hardworking, persistent, and dependable</li>
<li>Positive and enthusiastic</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Salary: $75,000 - $90,000 +&nbsp; variable ranging from $75,000 - 90,000 (uncapped commission)</strong></p>
<hr>
<p>Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.</p>
<p>We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.</p>
<p>Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, East Coast USA
</p>

<p>Collibra is the Enterprise AI Control Plane. Built over eighteen years of meta-data and ontology engineering, Collibra governs context and control across any data storage system, AI model, and AI agent.&nbsp; Collibra delivers clarity and context to AI leaders who need data certainty at the speed of AI. A 5x Forrester Wave Leader and 2x Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, Collibra serves more than 700 customers, including 78 of the Fortune 500, and governs more than 2 billion assets.</p>
<p>Collibra Public Sector LLC is the purpose-built subsidiary that serves US federal government agencies and the Defense Industrial Base. Collibra Public Sector is a FOCI-mitigated entity with a DCSA facility clearance. Collibra Public Sector personnel service clients in some of the most demanding mission organizations. Collibra Public Sector products, people and partners are uniquely positioned to deliver software and services solutions to the US federal market.</p>
<h3><strong>Join Collibra Public Sector</strong></h3>
<p>Collibra is looking for a proven General Manager to create and execute the overall business strategy to achieve long-term profitable growth that outpaces competitors and peers. Responsibilities include recruiting and leading a high-performing team that integrates sales, consulting services, support, legal, operations, marketing, product management, and product delivery. The General Manager will set the direction for the subsidiary to comply with government-required mandates such as CMMC. The General Manager will identify untapped market areas and build plans to capture those opportunities.</p>
<h3><strong>Successful outcomes</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Operate as a true GM leading sales, services, support that aligns parent-company dependencies into a single, accountable operating rhythm</li>
<li>Optimize post-sales execution by driving consistent deployments, adoption, and renewal readiness across Public Sector accounts</li>
<li>Manage overall expense to revenue targets</li>
<li>Spend the company’s money wisely to invest in new opportunities</li>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Company Description</p>
<p>At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.</p>
<p>We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to<strong> enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care. </strong></p>
<p><strong>We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer </strong>programs spanning the <strong>full care continuum</strong>, including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.</p>
<p>For almost <strong>two decades,</strong> Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.</p></div><p><strong>Brief Overview&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p></p>
<p>As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will play a key role in driving commercialization of Amwell’s solutions. This role focuses on executing high-impact go-to-market initiatives, enabling enterprise sales teams, supporting strategic deals and RFP responses, and translating complex product capabilities into differentiated, outcome-driven messaging.</p>
<p>This role is ideal for an experienced product marketer who can operate independently, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and partner closely with Product, Sales, and Marketing leaders to deliver measurable commercial impact.</p>
<p></p>
<p><strong>Core Responsibilities&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p></p>
<p>Commercial Leadership</p>
<p>· Develop and refine platform positioning that differentiates solutions in the payer market</p>
<p>· Define go-to-market strategy including target segments, launch sequencing, and success metrics</p>
<p>· Coordinate cross-functional launch activities across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success</p>
<p>· Lead execution of go-to-market initiatives for new products, capabilities, and market expansions within the payer segment</p>
<p>· Develop thought leadership for payer market trends</p>
<p>· Partner with Product and Commercial leadership on pricing and packaging strategy to support scalable commercialization.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Sales, RFP &amp; Field Enablement</p>
<p>· Develop launch messaging, sales tools, and enablement materials aligned with established positioning</p>
<p>· Partner with Sales and proposal teams to support RFP responses with differentiated messaging and positioning</p>
<p>· Develop executive-ready materials for strategic opportunities and client presentations</p>
<p>· Maintain reusable messaging frameworks that accelerate RFP response development</p>
<p>· Develop payer-facing sales materials and supporting resources that help health plan clients communicate program value to their employer group customers</p>
<p>· Incorporate field feedback to continuously improve sales tools and messaging</p>
<p>· Track and analyze launch and enablement performance to continuously improve commercialization outcomes.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Messaging &amp; Competitive Intelligence</p>
<p>· Translate complex product and clinical capabilities into clear, outcome-driven messaging</p>
<p>· Maintain and evolve competitive battlecards and positioning guidance</p>
<p>· Monitor payer and digital health market trends and synthesize insights that inform messaging and field enablement</p>
<p>· Cross-Functional Collaboration</p>
<p>· Partner with Product teams to understand roadmap priorities and upcoming launches</p>
<p>· Collaborate with Performance Marketing to ensure campaign messaging aligns with payer positioning</p>
<p>· Work with Customer Success and clinical teams to develop proof points and outcomes-driven narratives</p>
<p>· Coordinate with Sales Enablement to support internal training and field readiness</p>
<p></p>
<p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p>
<p></p>
<p>• 8+ years of product marketing or related B2B marketing experience</p>
<p>• Deep fluency in healthcare IT, digital health, or payer markets</p>
<p>• Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise sales organizations and complex deal cycles</p>
<p>• Proven ability to translate technical capabilities into clear buyer value</p>
<p>• Experience developing sales enablement and go-to-market materials for multi-stakeholder buying environments</p>
<p>• Strong cross-functional leadership and project management skills • Excellent written and verbal communication skills</p>
<p>What Success Looks Like</p>
<p>• High-impact launches executed with strong field adoption</p>
<p>• Sales teams equipped with differentiated messaging and materials</p>
<p>• RFP responses supported with consistent, compelling positioning</p>
<p>• Employer-facing enablement materials effectively used by health plan clients</p>
<p>• Competitive insights regularly refreshed and actionable</p>
<p></p>
<p><strong>Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell.&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren’t just aspirations – they are how we work, every day.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages, a virtual-first work environment, work-life flexibility, including Summer Fridays and designated Mental Health Days, as well as opportunities to stretch and learn – to name a few. It’s our people who truly differentiate us. Ask anyone and they’ll tell you – you’ll never work with more passionate, more driven and more caring team members.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>We champion a culture of respect and inclusion, accountability and integrity, innovation and collaboration. At Amwell, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career—improving healthcare for millions, growing alongside incredible teammates, and being valued for who you are.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Flexible Personal Time Off (Vacation time)</li>
<li>401K match</li>
<li>Competitive healthcare, dental and vision insurance plans</li>
<li>Paid Parental Leave (Maternity and Paternity leave)</li>
<li>Employee Stock Purchase Program</li>
<li>Free access to Amwell’s Telehealth Services, SilverCloud and The Clinic by Cleveland Clinic’s second opinion program</li>
<li>Free Subscription to the Calm App</li>
<li>Tuition Assistance Program</li>
<li>Pet Insurance&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Salaried, Exempt Roles</strong></p>
<p>The typical base salary range for this position is $136,170 - $166,430.&nbsp; The actual salary offer will ultimately depend on multiple factors including, but not limited to, knowledge, skills, relevant education, experience, complexity or specialization of talent, and other objective factors.&nbsp; In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and employee performance. Long-term incentive and short-term variable compensation may be offered as part of the compensation package dependent on the role. Some roles may be commission based, in which case the total compensation will be based on a commission and the above range may not be an accurate representation of total compensation.</p>
<p>Further, the above range is subject to change based on market demands and operational needs and does not constitute a promise of a particular wage or a guarantee of employment. Your recruiter can share more during the hiring process about the specific salary range based on the above factors listed.</p>
<div>
<h3>Fraud Prevention Notice</h3>
<p>As part of Amwell's commitment to maintaining a secure and trusted hiring process, Amwell uses fraud detection capabilities within its hiring platform to help identify potentially suspicious, fraudulent, or unauthorized activity during the recruitment process.</p>
<p>These tools are designed to help protect candidates, Amwell, and the integrity of the hiring process by identifying indicators that may be associated with impersonation, account misuse, or other forms of recruiting fraud. Information generated through fraud detection is reviewed by authorized personnel and is not used as the sole basis for hiring decisions.</p>
<p>Personal information collected or processed in connection with fraud detection will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws and Amwell's Applicant Privacy Notice.</p>
</div>

<p><span>As part of Amwell's commitment to&nbsp;maintaining&nbsp;a secure and trusted hiring process, candidates for this role&nbsp;are required to&nbsp;complete an identity verification step through Greenhouse Identity Verification powered by CLEAR during the interview process.</span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Identity verification is used solely to confirm a candidate's identity and help prevent fraud and impersonation within the hiring process. It is not a background check and does not independently&nbsp;determine&nbsp;hiring decisions.</span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Because this role has been&nbsp;designated&nbsp;as requiring identity verification, completion of the verification process is a condition of continuing in the recruitment process. Candidates who do not complete the identity verification process will not be eligible to advance to&nbsp;subsequent&nbsp;stages of consideration for this role.</span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Personal information collected as part of the identity verification process will be handled&nbsp;in accordance with&nbsp;applicable privacy laws and Amwell's Applicant Privacy Notice.</span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
