      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div><span><strong>About Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.</span></div></div><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is seeking an Enterprise Account Executive for a high-impact sales role focused on driving new business and expanding relationships within large enterprise accounts. AEs at Glean are responsible for landing and managing multi-million dollar, often global, accounts by leveraging Glean’s differentiated AI technology and foundational knowledge graph to deliver tangible business outcomes for customers.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>You will:</strong></span></div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><span>Source and close net new logos within a given territory</span></li>
<li><span>Have the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and identify executive sponsors and champions</span></li>
<li><span>Research and understand the business objectives of your customers and have the ability to perform a value drive sales cycle</span></li>
<li><span>Collaborate with internal partners to move deals forward and ensure customer success&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>You will consistently deliver ARR revenue targets and drive success through a metric based approach</span></li>
<li><span>Develop and execute sales strategies and tactics to generate pipeline, drive sales opportunities and deliver repeatable and predictable bookings</span></li>
<li><span>Provide timely and insightful input back to other corporate functions</span></li>
<li><span>Create ROI and business justification reports based off of a data driven approach</span></li>
<li><span>Run tight POCs based off of business success criteria</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div><span><strong>About you:</strong></span></div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><span>6+ years of closing experience in Sales with a track record of being a top performer</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to learn, pitch and demonstrate a highly technical product and have the ability to adapt in a fast growing and changing environment&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Have clear examples of closing complex deals and selling into complex organizations</span></li>
<li><span>Effectively use a repeatable method for uncovering greenfield opportunities and building out a new territory&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Previous experience building relationships and selling face to face to C level executives</span></li>
<li><span>Knowledge of best of breed softwares and a technical understanding of integrations, APIs, infrastructure management, security and analytics</span></li>
<li><span>Experience selling technical SaaS and cloud based software solutions</span></li>
<li><span>Basic understanding of search infrastructure is a plus</span></li>
<li><span>You have previous experience working with multiple teammates including SEs, BDRs, PMs, Executives &amp; Engineers</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and using MEDDIC and Challenger (or similar) methodologies is a plus.</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div><span><strong>Location:<br></strong></span></div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><span>This role is remote (must be located in Ohio Valley: Ohio, Michigan, Tennessee, Kentucky, Kansas, Missouri, or Indiana)</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div><span><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>The OTE range for this role is $280,000 - $300,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>#LI-REMOTE</span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>AI-First Mindset at Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. <strong>As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. </strong>Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/privacy"><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></a>. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>.</span></div>
<div><span><br>By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>, and I agree to the terms.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></div></div>

      <title>Animalz: (Developmental) Content Editor</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>New York</state>
      <skills>Technical Writing, Content Writing, and  Editing</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0017/3233/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://animalz.co">https://animalz.co</a>
</p>

<p>We are looking for a freelance developmental editor to review B2B SaaS content written by our in-house and freelance writers. You’ll focus on long-form content, from SEO/AEO/GEO to thought leadership, though editors are occasionally called upon to review copy for LinkedIn, landing pages, or other formats.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Editors at Animalz play a key role in ensuring the work we deliver meets our internal bar for quality and helps our clients meet their business goals. You sit between writers and copyeditors, and while you should be able to edit prose at the line level, your primary focus is editing for substance. Does the piece of content you’re editing effectively execute the brief? Is it aligned with the client’s business goals and tailored for their audience? Is it structurally and logically sound?&nbsp;</p>
<p>To ensure each piece of content we deliver answers these questions, you’ll review content and provide writers with actionable feedback, from big-picture guidance down to inline edits. You’ll be dedicated to a specific pool of customers so you can get deeply familiar with their business and brand and provide feedback that takes into account their holistic strategy, not just each individual piece.&nbsp;</p>
<h2>Requirements</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Experience writing and editing diverse forms of content for B2B tech, especially long-form content (blog posts, ebooks, guides, etc.)&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Working knowledge of SEO and AEO/GEO best practices. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should know the basics</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ability to deliver actionable feedback. You can communicate why changes should be made, balancing candor with respect</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ability to quickly get up to speed on new industries, companies, and products</p>
</li>
<li>

      <country>🇦🇱 Albania, 🇦🇷 Argentina, 🇧🇦 Bosnia and Herzegovina, 🇧🇬 Bulgaria, 🇧🇷 Brazil, 🇨🇴 Colombia, 🇲🇩 Moldova (Republic of), 🇲🇰 North Macedonia, 🇲🇽 Mexico, 🇵🇪 Peru, 🇵🇭 Philippines, 🇷🇴 Romania, 🇷🇸 Serbia, and 🇿🇦 South Africa</country>
      <state>Wyoming</state>
      <skills>Ad Design, Copywriting, Facebook Paid Ads, Video Production, Generative AI, and AI Content Creation</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/5952/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/">https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/</a>
</p>

<h2>Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer</h2>
<p><strong>Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial</strong></p>
<p>Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands.</p>
<p><strong>This is not a conventional graphic-design role.</strong> We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools.</p>
<p>You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials.</p>
<h3>The work</h3>
<p>You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals.</p>
<p>Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell.</p>
<ul>
<li>Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents.</li>
<li>Decide what each batch should test and why.</li>
<li>Source and analyse strong visual and structural references.</li>
<li>Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction.</li>
<li>Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads.</li>
<li>Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level.</li>
<li>Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop.</li>
<li>Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance.</li>
<li>Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output.</li>
<li>Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests.</li>
<li>Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch.</li>
</ul>
<h3>What you must be good at</h3>
<ul>
<li>Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy</li>
<li>Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation</li>
<li>Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit</li>
<li>Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page</li>
<li>Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production</li>
<li>Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation</li>
<li>Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools</li>
<li>Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish</li>
<li>Fast, organised batch production</li>
<li>Reading creative performance and choosing the next test</li>
</ul>
<h3>You are probably not right for this role if</h3>
<ul>
<li>Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context.</li>
<li>You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism.</li>
<li>You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work.</li>
<li>You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision.</li>
<li>You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production.</li>
<li>You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples.</li>
<li>You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback.</li>
</ul>
<h3>What success looks like</h3>
<p>Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow.</p>
<h3>Compensation</h3>
<p>The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at <strong>USD $2,000</strong>. If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay <strong>USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month</strong>, based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator.</p>
<p>We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output.</p>
<h3>How to apply</h3>
<p><strong>Do not send a generic cover letter.</strong> Message Simon on WhatsApp at <strong>+353 86 349 5073</strong> and begin with: <strong>I make the work.</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed.</li>
<li>For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel.</li>
<li>Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable.</li>
<li>Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed.</li>
<li>List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset.</li>
<li>Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test.</li>
<li>State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial.</li>
</ol>
<p>Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer</a></p>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, US 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://redditinc.com/">https://redditinc.com/</a>
</p>

<div class="job__header">
<div class="job__title">
<h1 class="section-header section-header--large font-primary">Senior Product Adoption Strategist (Shopping)</h1>
<div class="job__location">
<div>Remote - United States</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="job__description body">
<div>
<div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text">
<div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first">
<div class="p-rich_text_block">
<div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 116 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<p><strong>Location:&nbsp;</strong>NYC</p>
<p>We’re assembling a collaborative team of individuals to drive Reddit Ads product adoption within our Global Sales organization and with advertisers. The Product Adoption team’s mission is to accelerate and scale the adoption of priority products and features to drive advertiser success and revenue growth. We are looking for our next team member who can help us to innovate and scale across our major adoption programs.&nbsp;</p>
<p>In this role, you will be responsible for scaling Shopping product adoption across Large Customer Sales and Mid-Market advertisers worldwide. You will partner with Sales to pitch, onboard, activate, and grow advertisers on our Shopping product solutions and activate high-priority business opportunities. building global ads product adoption programs for advertisers and agencies. Your close partners will also include Product, PMM, Strategy &amp; Ops, Enablement, and Marketing Science.&nbsp;</p>
<p>You will drive the activation of our Shopping ads products to meet our customers' performance goals. You will work directly with account teams and advertisers to pitch, onboard, and activate across our Shopping solutions. Additionally, you will advocate for advertiser Shopping product needs, opportunities, and gaps within Reddit’s R&amp;D organization.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Why Join Reddit’s Product Adoption Team?</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Innovative Environment: Be part of a newly reimagined team at one of the most dynamic platforms worldwide, contributing to groundbreaking strategies that drive growth.</li>
<li>Career Advancement: Significant opportunities for career development and mobility as you help shape the future of product adoption at Reddit.</li>
<li>Collaborative Culture: Join a group of thoughtful, smart, and adaptable individuals who value collaboration and support each other's growth.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive Growth: Lead efforts to scale the adoption of Reddit’s Shopping ads products, increasing advertiser engagement and revenue.</li>
<li>Develop Channel Strategies: Create and implement sales strategies tailored to Shopping ads programs in support of Large Customer Sales (LCS) and Mid-Market advertisers and sales teams worldwide.</li>
<li>Engage Clients: Work directly with advertisers to identify, pitch, activate, onboard, and grow clients with strategic product opportunities.</li>
<li>Enable Sales: Customize enablement for sales by channel and ensure that teams have the necessary knowledge, training, collateral, and market insights to effectively position and implement&nbsp;Reddit's Shopping ad products.</li>
<li>Leverage Partners: Work with 3P partners to accelerate Shopping ads growth.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Foster Feedback Loop: Advocate for advertiser needs and identify opportunities and gaps, providing feedback to PMM and Product teams to inform ongoing product development.</li>
<li>Measure results: Partner with Sales and Strategy &amp; Operations leadership to track progress to goal and identify steps that can be taken to accelerate outcomes.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Basic Qualifications:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in digital advertising, sales, marketing strategy, operations, or relevant industries</li>
<li>Industry Experience: A strong background in product adoption, growth, or sales strategy within the digital advertising industry.</li>
<li>Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with partner teams, leveraging cross-functional expertise to drive program success.</li>
<li>Proficient in Google Suite and Salesforce.</li>
<li>Passion for understanding client needs and delivering solutions that drive their success.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Direct Shopping product and/or eCommerce experience&nbsp;</li>
<li>Analytical Skills: Solid familiarity with data analysis techniques and tools such as Mode, Tableau, and Salesforce to track key metrics and outcomes.</li>
<li>Project Management: Excellent program and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives concurrently.</li>
<li>Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of clearly articulating strategies and outcomes to internal and external stakeholders.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs</li>
<li>401k with Employer Match</li>
<li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li>
<li>Family Planning Support</li>
<li>Gender-Affirming Care</li>
<li>Mental Health &amp; Coaching Benefits</li>
<li>Flexible Vacation &amp; Paid Volunteer Time Off</li>
<li>Generous Paid Parental Leave &nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div class="job__pay-ranges">
<div class="pay-range">

<div class="body">

<p>This job posting may span more than one career level.</p>
<p>In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and will also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.redditinc.com/careers/">https://www.redditinc.com/careers/</a>.</p>
<p>To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. <p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p>
<p>During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us.
